AccessGate.title: Access Gate
AccessGate.description: A gate that allows access to or exit from a path to a transport vehicle.

accessGateIdentifier.title: Access Gate.Access Gate Identifier
accessGateIdentifier.description: Identifier of the gate. For example: 'A5'.

AccessGate.aircraftDep.title: Each Access Gate may be used by one and only one Boarding Gate
AccessGate.aircraftDep.description: A preparation of an aircraft for departure including acquiring baggage, checking in passengers, loading baggage and cargo onto the aircraft and preparing the aircraft up to when it is ready to depart the stand to begin the leg.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A record of monetary receipts and payments relating to a particular period and purpose where money is a medium of exchange and hence a unit of accounting, and a store of value.

AccountableDoc.title: Accountable Document
AccountableDoc.description: A Form of payment which utilizes a previously issued accountable travel document (ticket, EMD, coupon, etc.) which has an outstanding credit value.

docTypeText.title: Accountable Document.Document Type Text
docTypeText.description: Type of Accountable Document. For example: T, E and M or E-ticket, EMD, MCO.

ticketIdentifier.title: Accountable Document.Ticket Identifier
ticketIdentifier.description: MCO, Ticket or EMD reference number, indicating a previously issued document

Ack.title: Acknowledgement
Ack.description: A simple communication from one party to another party acknowledging the receipt or collection of a previous communication. For example: Confirmation of receipt of an inventory release or an updated order. The acknowledgement may also provide information indicating the status of the information conveyed in the previous communication.

ActionCode.title: Action_ Code
ActionCode.description: Define list of action codes allowed.

ActionCodeEnum.title: Action Code
ActionCodeEnum.description: The code of the action Valid Values: Add - Add action allowed; Delete - Delete action allowed; Update - Update action allowed

AddlName.title: Additional Name
AddlName.description: An additional name derived from an individual's mother or father's surname as required by various states. For example: Father Surname, Smith and Mother Surname, Park.

AddlName.name.title: Additional Name.Name
AddlName.name.description: A name as defined by the Type Code.

AddlNameTypeCode.title: Additional Name Type_ Code
AddlNameTypeCode.description: This will define allowable additional name types. Father Surname Mother Surname

AddlNameTypeCodeEnum.title: Additional Name Type Code
AddlNameTypeCodeEnum.description: This will include a codelist with defined types of additional names. Valid Values: Father Surname - This is the individuals fathers name surname which is part of the individuals full surname.; Mother Surname - This is the individuals mothers name surname which is part of the individuals full surname.

AffinityArrivalRequest.title: Affinity Arrival Request
AffinityArrivalRequest.description: An arrival location and time information for affinity shopping requests.

AffinityDepRequest.title: Affinity Departure Request
AffinityDepRequest.description: A Departure location and time information for affinity shopping requests.

AffinityOriginDest.title: Affinity Origin Destination
AffinityOriginDest.description: A set of Origin and Destination information supporting an affinity shopping request.

AffinityShoppingCriteria.title: Affinity Shopping Criteria
AffinityShoppingCriteria.description: A wide search defining a range of criteria such as specific interest, destination attributes, defined budget, date ranges or destination ranges.

budgetAmount.title: Affinity Shopping Criteria.Budget Amount
budgetAmount.description: Total budget for all Passengers (Payers) for a journey request.

journeyDistanceCriteria.title: Each Affinity Shopping Criteria may supplies one and only one Journey Distance Criteria
journeyDistanceCriteria.description: A shopping filter criteria based on total Journey distance.

keywordPref.title: Each Affinity Shopping Criteria may supplies one or more Key Value Properties
keywordPref.description: Affinity query keyword(s) with optional preference level.

Agency.title: Agency
Agency.description: An organization that acts on behalf of another organization or an individual.

AgencyCodeEnum.title: Agency Code
AgencyCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA handling agency organizations.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: A member of staff of an Agency.

agency.title: Each Agent must be employed by one and only one Agency
agency.description: An organization that acts on behalf of another organization or an individual.

agentIdentifier.title: Agent.Agent Identifier
agentIdentifier.description: Identifier of an agent as assigned by his/her agency.

Agent.bagActivity.title: Each Agent may be responsible for one or more Handling Agents
Agent.bagActivity.description: A condition in which things are happening or being done to a bag, such as 'scan a bag'.

Aggregator.title: Aggregator
Aggregator.description: An organization that distributes a seller's shopping request to multiple airlines and aggregates subsequent responses. For example: Farelogix.

Agreement.title: Agreement
Agreement.description: A record of agreement between parties for exchange of value under specified terms and conditions.

agreementIdentifier.title: Agreement.Agreement Identifier
agreementIdentifier.description: Identifier of the agreement that is the foundation for the settlement or clearance being processed. In One Order and NDC this is the 'Order ID'. Carrier assigned identifier, which uniquely identifies a specific Order across several messages.

Agreement.term.title: Each Agreement may comprise one or more Terms
Agreement.term.description: A condition under which an agreement is reached.

Aircraft.title: Aircraft
Aircraft.description: A transport vehicle which is certified as airworthy by a competent aeronautical authority.

aircraftRegistrationIdentifier.title: Aircraft.Aircraft Registration Identifier
aircraftRegistrationIdentifier.description: Alphanumeric identification assigned by the appropriate licensing authority to an individual aircraft. Hyphens contained within the registration must not be included. For example: GBOAC, N46573, ZZ123.

msnIdentifier.title: Aircraft.MSN Identifier
msnIdentifier.description: Manufacturer's Serial Number which is a unique identifier assigned at the time of the manufacture of the aircraft and remains constant regardless of the civil registration.

otherIdentifier.title: Aircraft.Other Identifier
otherIdentifier.description: Alternative identifier utilized by an operator other than the aircraft registration identifier. This may be an abbreviated registration such as the last two characters of the aircraft registration identifier and may be painted on the external surface of the aircraft such as the tip of the tail fin, nose or landing gear doors.

registrationGroupCode.title: Aircraft.Registration Group Code
registrationGroupCode.description: In certified documentation individual or groups of aircraft may be expressed in common sections. This is usually specified in the page header or footer and cross refers to an effective page.

tailNumberText.title: Aircraft.Tail Number Text
tailNumberText.description: Abbreviated version of the unique aircraft registration identifier, such as without country code.

Aircraft.tailAssignment.title: Each Aircraft may can apply to one or more Previous Aircrafts
Aircraft.tailAssignment.description: An assignment of a well-identified aircraft to a dated operating flight leg

AircraftArrival.title: Aircraft Arrival
AircraftArrival.description: A handling of the arrival of an aircraft from passenger disembarkation, baggage unloading and reuniting passengers with their luggage.

arrivalBaggageHandlingBay.title: Each Aircraft Arrival may use one or more Baggage Handling Baies
arrivalBaggageHandlingBay.description: The area where baggage is assembled as soon as the luggage is removed from an aircraft.

AircraftDep.title: Aircraft Departure
AircraftDep.description: A preparation of an aircraft for departure including acquiring baggage, checking in passengers, loading baggage and cargo onto the aircraft and preparing the aircraft up to when it is ready to depart the stand to begin the leg.

boardingGate.title: Each Aircraft Departure may use one and only one Access Gate
boardingGate.description: A gate that allows access to or exit from a path to a transport vehicle.

depBaggageHandlingBay.title: Each Aircraft Departure may use one or more Baggage Handling Baies
depBaggageHandlingBay.description: The area where baggage is assembled prior to it being loaded onto an aircraft.

depTerminal.title: Each Aircraft Departure may use one and only one Terminal
depTerminal.description: A departure and/or arrival building for aircraft, passengers or freight at a station for any transport mode.

AircraftGroup.title: Aircraft Group
AircraftGroup.description: A Group of aircraft operating together under the same ownership, belonging to the same aircraft type and having a set of configuration data in common.

aircraftName.title: Aircraft Group.Aircraft Name
aircraftName.description: Internal name given by the carrier to this aircraft type. Aircraft type as it appears on the load sheet.

aircraftSubtypeName.title: Aircraft Group.Aircraft Subtype Name
aircraftSubtypeName.description: Series or subtype also referred to as suffix in the IATA SIM manual.

fuelDensityWeightUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Fuel Density Weight Unit Code
fuelDensityWeightUnitCode.description: Fuel density weight unit used for aircraft calculation. When missing standard aircraft weight unit is used.

indexConversionConstantValue.title: Aircraft Group.Index Conversion Constant Value
indexConversionConstantValue.description: Constant (C) used as denominator in the index calculation formula to convert moment values expressed in aircraft moment units into index values.

indexOffsetConstantValue.title: Aircraft Group.Index Offset Constant Value
indexOffsetConstantValue.description: Constant (K) used in the index calculation formula as a plus value to avoid negative index figures.

leadingEdgeMeasure.title: Aircraft Group.Leading Edge Measure
leadingEdgeMeasure.description: Horizontal distance in aircraft length units from the reference datum to the location of the Leading Edge.

liquidVolumeUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Liquid Volume Unit Code
liquidVolumeUnitCode.description: Liquid volume unit used for aircraft calculation.

macMeasure.title: Aircraft Group.MAC Measure
macMeasure.description: Length of Mean Aerodynamic Chord/ Reference Chord (RC) in aircraft length units.

momentWeightUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Moment Weight Unit Code
momentWeightUnitCode.description: Moment weight unit used for aircraft calculation. When missing standard aircraft weight unit is used.

refArmMeasure.title: Aircraft Group.Reference Arm Measure
refArmMeasure.description: Selected Station around which all index values are calculated expressed in aircraft length units from the aircraft reference datum.

volumeUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Volume Unit Code
volumeUnitCode.description: Volume unit used for aircraft calculation. Overrides unit defined against the carrier.

weightUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Weight Unit Code
weightUnitCode.description: Weight unit used for aircraft calculation. Overrides unit defined against the carrier.

AircraftGroup.areaUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Area Unit Code
AircraftGroup.areaUnitCode.description: Area unit used for aircraft calculation. When missing square of length unit is used.

AircraftGroup.lengthUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Length Unit Code
AircraftGroup.lengthUnitCode.description: Length unit used for aircraft calculation.

AircraftGroup.momentLengthUnitCode.title: Aircraft Group.Moment Length Unit Code
AircraftGroup.momentLengthUnitCode.description: Moment length unit used for aircraft calculation. When missing standard aircraft length unit is used.

AircraftGroupConfiguration.title: Aircraft Group Configuration
AircraftGroupConfiguration.description: A specific configuration of an aircraft group.

fleetBalanceArmMeasure.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Fleet Balance Arm Measure
fleetBalanceArmMeasure.description: Standard empty balance arm that may be utilized for all aircraft registrations of a group.

fleetIndexValue.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Fleet Index Value
fleetIndexValue.description: Standard empty index that may be utilized for all aircraft registrations of a group.

fleetMacPercent.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Fleet MAC Percent
fleetMacPercent.description: Standard empty %MAC that may be utilized for all aircraft registrations of a group.

fleetWeightMeasure.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Fleet Weight Measure
fleetWeightMeasure.description: Standard empty weight that may be utilized for all aircraft registrations of a group.

startWeightTypeCode.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Start Weight Type Code
startWeightTypeCode.description: Method of starting weight calculation (Basic Weight (BW), Dry Operating Weight (DOW)).

AircraftGroupConfiguration.defaultInd.title: Aircraft Group Configuration.Default Indicator
AircraftGroupConfiguration.defaultInd.description: Defines the default aircraft group configuration.

AircraftGroupConfiguration.dowItem.title: Each Aircraft Group Configuration may includes one or more DOW Items
AircraftGroupConfiguration.dowItem.description: An Item that can be considered as part of the Dry Operating Weight buildup of an aircraft or aircraft group as per company specifications e.g. Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Containers, Pallets, Potable Water, Library, ... Other items are included in the total traffic load weight.

AircraftGroupConfiguration.supplementary.title: Each Aircraft Group Configuration may use one or more Supplementary Information Requirements
AircraftGroupConfiguration.supplementary.description: A requirement to add specific data to the supplementary information (SI) area of each applicable load sheet (provisional, final, ACARS,...).

AircraftRegistrationIdentifier.title: Aircraft Registration_ Identifier
AircraftRegistrationIdentifier.description: The complete alphanumeric identification assigned by the appropriate licensing authority to an individual aircraft. Hyphens contained within the registration shall not be included. E.g. G-BOAC, N46573, ZZ123.

AirflowRateBaseCode.title: Airflow Rate Base_ Code
AirflowRateBaseCode.description: Specifies Airflow Rate Base code list (H (per Hour), M (per Minute)).

AirflowRateBaseCodeEnum.title: Airflow Rate Base Code
AirflowRateBaseCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Airflow Rate Base Code BDT. Valid Values: H - Per Hour; M - Per Minute

Airline.title: Airline
Airline.description: An organization operating aircraft for commercial purposes which offers air transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by the civil aviation authority of the state in which it is established. Note that the unique identifier of an Airline is a composite of the Airline Designator Code and its Name. It is common only to use Airline Designator Code when the duplicate coded airlines operate in different air spaces.

Airline.bagActivity.title: Each Airline may be responsible for one or more Operating Carriers
Airline.bagActivity.description: A condition in which things are happening or being done to a bag, such as 'scan a bag'.

Airline.flight.title: Each Airline may operate aircraft to fulfill one or more Operating Airlines
Airline.flight.description: A sequence of flight legs designed to meet the demands of the flight services operating under the same operational flight number, making efficient use of available aircraft for the repositioning of aircraft, and ensuring conformance with the use of flight numbers as defined by regulations.

Airline.transportService.title: Each Airline may provide one or more Administrating Airlines
Airline.transportService.description: An airline that decides to provide a transport service.

AirlineAlliance.title: Airline Alliance
AirlineAlliance.description: A partnership between two or more airlines participating in a commercial relationship, where a commonly identifiable product is marketed under a single commercial name or brand with reciprocal frequent flyer benefits.

airlineAllianceCode.title: Airline Alliance.Airline Alliance Code
airlineAllianceCode.description: Used to specify the alliance based on PADIS Code List (code list defined in 9906). For example: 700 Star Alliance, 701 One World Alliance, 702 Sky Team, 703 Wings.

allianceMember.title: Each Airline Alliance may have one or more Airlines
allianceMember.description: An organization operating aircraft for commercial purposes which offers air transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by the civil aviation authority of the state in which it is established. Note that the unique identifier of an Airline is a composite of the Airline Designator Code and its Name. It is common only to use Airline Designator Code when the duplicate coded airlines operate in different air spaces.

tradeName.title: Airline Alliance.Trade Name
tradeName.description: Registered name the alliance is trading under. For example: One World Alliance.

AirlineAlliance.websiteUri.title: Airline Alliance.Website URI
AirlineAlliance.websiteUri.description: Website address where information explaining the nature and offerings of the alliance can be found.

AirlineAllianceCriteria.title: Airline Alliance Criteria
AirlineAllianceCriteria.description: A set of airline alliance specific filter criteria for shopping requests.

AirlineBagRefIdentifier.title: Airline Bag Reference_ Identifier
AirlineBagRefIdentifier.description: Baggage identifier used for internal usage only (typically used as Julian date on 3 numeric) Example: 100 (100th Julian day)

AirlineCabinType.title: Airline Cabin Type
AirlineCabinType.description: An airline specific information related to the standard 'Cabin Types' or subset of the latter utilized by the airline.

priorityNumber.title: Airline Cabin Type.Priority Number
priorityNumber.description: Highest to lowest class where a departure control system automatically re-grades passengers to accommodate over-sales during the load planning process.

AirlineCriteria.title: Airline Criteria
AirlineCriteria.description: A set of Airline specific filter criteria for shopping requests.

AirlineDesigCode.title: Airline Designator_ Code
AirlineDesigCode.description: Either the IATA-defined 2-character code or the ICAO-defined 3-character code of an airline, as per the length of the value.

AirlineDesigCodeEnum.title: Airline Designator Code
AirlineDesigCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 762 airline codes, or of ICAO airline codes.

AirlineLoadInfo.title: Airline Load Information
AirlineLoadInfo.description: An Information distinguishing different categories of cargo used for load planning characterized by Airline specific codes in addition to codes defined in AHM510.

airlineLoadInfoCode.title: Airline Load Information.Airline Load Information Code

AirlineProfile.title: Airline Profile
AirlineProfile.description: A distribution profile of an airline which describes which types of shopping requests may be processed by a particular carrier.

airlineProfileFilterCriteria.title: Each Airline Profile must be used by one and only one Airline Profile Filter Criteria
airlineProfileFilterCriteria.description: A set of Criteria to filter airline profile response information.

associatedMediaUrlUri.title: Airline Profile.Associated Media URL URI
associatedMediaUrlUri.description: URL used to retrieve media associated with the airline profile, including the airline logo.

associationMembershipText.title: Airline Profile.Association Membership Text
associationMembershipText.description: Free text description of group or alliance for which the profile is related. For example: 'Member of Star Alliance'.

profileOwner.title: Each Airline Profile must is responsible for one and only one Carrier
profileOwner.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

profileUrlUri.title: Airline Profile.Profile URL URI
profileUrlUri.description: Link to Airline Profile Source File. Alows a large Airline Profile file to be distributed over FTP, FTPS, as agreed bilaterally with Profile Owner. Note, this element should not be used if explicitly providing the Airline Profile Data Items.

AirlineProfileDataItem.title: Airline Profile Data Item
AirlineProfileDataItem.description: A Single set of data elements contained within the airline profile.

posGeographicFilterCriteria.title: Each Airline Profile Data Item may contains one or more Geographic Filter Criterias
posGeographicFilterCriteria.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

AirlineProfileDataItem.actionTypeCode.title: Airline Profile Data Item.Action Type Code

AirlineProfileDataItem.offerFilterCriter.title: Each Airline Profile Data Item may have one or more Offer Filter Criterias
AirlineProfileDataItem.offerFilterCriter.description: A set of filter criteria based on offer preferences/criteria.

AirlineProfileDataItem.seqNumber.title: Airline Profile Data Item.Sequence Number
AirlineProfileDataItem.seqNumber.description: Global sequence number of this record in the Airline Profile.

AirlineProfileFilterCriteria.title: Airline Profile Filter Criteria
AirlineProfileFilterCriteria.description: A set of Criteria to filter airline profile response information.

allProfilesInd.title: Airline Profile Filter Criteria.All Profiles Indicator
allProfilesInd.description: If TRUE, all available profiles from all profile owners are requested.

mediaUrlInd.title: Airline Profile Filter Criteria.Media URL Indicator
mediaUrlInd.description: When TRUE, only a URL to an airline profile location should be provided.

AirlineRefIdentifier.title: Airline Reference_ Identifier
AirlineRefIdentifier.description: Airline Reference identifier is a character string that is managed by the carrier.

Airport.title: Airport
Airport.description: A facility where air transportation originates, stops and / or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off and/or maintenance, re-stocking or re-fueling takes place.

inboundFlight.title: Each Inbound Flight may be the finish of one or more Arrival Aiports
inboundFlight.description: A sequence of flight legs designed to meet the demands of the flight services operating under the same operational flight number, making efficient use of available aircraft for the repositioning of aircraft, and ensuring conformance with the use of flight numbers as defined by regulations.

outboundFlight.title: Each Outbound Flight may be the start of one or more Departure Airports
outboundFlight.description: A sequence of flight legs designed to meet the demands of the flight services operating under the same operational flight number, making efficient use of available aircraft for the repositioning of aircraft, and ensuring conformance with the use of flight numbers as defined by regulations.

ALaCarteOfferItem.title: A La Carte Offer Item
ALaCarteOfferItem.description: A Container of one Service (excluding flights) or Service Bundle which is priced per unit. A La Carte Offer Items are optional, and the quantities of these can be selected for any of the eligible passengers and segments.

aLaCarteOfferItemIdentifier.title: A La Carte Offer Item.A La Carte Offer Item Identifier
aLaCarteOfferItemIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies an Offer within the context of one message.

unitPrice.title: Each A La Carte Offer Item must supplies one and only one Price
unitPrice.description: An amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

ALaCarteOfferItem.flightService.title: Each A La Carte Offer Item must contains one and only one Service
ALaCarteOfferItem.flightService.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

ALaCarteOfferItem.pax.title: Each A La Carte Offer Item may is eligible for one or more Passengers
ALaCarteOfferItem.pax.description: An individual, except members of the crew, carried or to be carried with the consent of the carrier, on board any transport vehicle such as aircraft, train, bus, ship.

ALaCarteOfferItem.paxJourney.title: Each A La Carte Offer Item may is eligible for one or more Journeys
ALaCarteOfferItem.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

AllianceCode.title: Alliance_ Code
AllianceCode.description: Additional BDT to specify alliance codes.

AllianceCodeEnum.title: Alliance Code
AllianceCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Alliance Code BDT.

Amount.title: Amount
Amount.description: An amount is a number of monetary units specified in a currency.

AreaUnitCodeEnum.title: Area Unit Code
AreaUnitCodeEnum.description: List of Area Unit Codes. Subset of UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Valid Values: CMK - Square Centimeter; FTK - Square Foot; INK - Square Inch; MTK - Square Meter

AsymmetricalLoadLimitation.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation
AsymmetricalLoadLimitation.description: A Maximum load acceptable on each side of the compartment floor in relation with each other.

leftSideValue.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation.Left Side Value
leftSideValue.description: Maximum value permitted on the left side in relation to the value specified against Right Side. The nature of the relationship (Weight or Linear Load) is a property of the table containing the asymmetrical load limitation.

rightSideValue.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation.Right Side Value
rightSideValue.description: Maximum value permitted on the right side in relation to the value specified against Left Side. The nature of the relationship (Weight or Linear Load) is a property of the table containing the asymmetrical load limitation.

AsymmetricalLoadLimitationTable.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation Table
AsymmetricalLoadLimitationTable.description: A Set of related asymmetrical load limitations.

asymmetricalLoadLimitation.title: Each Asymmetrical Load Limitation Table must contains at least one Asymmetrical Load Limitations
asymmetricalLoadLimitation.description: A Maximum load acceptable on each side of the compartment floor in relation with each other.

linearLoadInd.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation Table.Linear Load Indicator
linearLoadInd.description: Indicator of the nature of the limitations relationship i.e. Linear Load or Weight.

rangeFromCode.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation Table.Range From Code
rangeFromCode.description: Starting value of a range for which the specific table applies. Might be numeric in case range type 'balance arm' or alphanumeric in case of range type 'ULD position'.

rangeToCode.title: Asymmetrical Load Limitation Table.Range To Code
rangeToCode.description: End value of a range for which the specific table applies. Might be numeric in case range type 'balance arm' or alphanumeric in case of range type 'ULD position'.

AuthenticationStatusCode.title: Authentication Status_ Code
AuthenticationStatusCode.description: The authentication status code of the logistics item status

AuthenticationStatusCodeEnum.title: Authentication Status Code
AuthenticationStatusCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment a baggage authentication codes Valid Values: Identified - Identified, Bag has been identified against produced bag inventory; IDProduced - Identity Produced, bag identity has been produced; Qualified - Qualified, bag has been qualified against planned criteria and resource; Recognised - Recognised, bag has been recognised (Seen); Verified - Verified, bag has been verified against policies (max min height, weight, etc)

AvailablePeriod.title: Available Period
AvailablePeriod.description: An Earliest and Latest Period than an option is available or may be used.

earliestAvailablePeriodDateTime.title: Available Period.Earliest Available Period Date Time
earliestAvailablePeriodDateTime.description: Offer/ Order term (condition) for the Earliest time an item is Available or May be Used.

latestAvailablePeriodDateTime.title: Available Period.Latest Available Period Date Time
latestAvailablePeriodDateTime.description: Offer/ Order term (condition) for the Latest time an item is Available or May be Used.

AvailablePeriod.term.title: Each Available Period must have one and only one Term
AvailablePeriod.term.description: A condition under which an agreement is reached.

Bag.title: Bag
Bag.description: A piece of luggage associated with a passenger, packed for traveling, and necessary or appropriate in connection with a journey. Business Identifier Fields: - [Bag Tag] (All Identifiers) - [Bag Segment] (All Identifiers)

bagDimension.title: Each Bag may have one and only one Bag Dimension
bagDimension.description: A measurable extent of a particular bag, such as length, or height.

bagException.title: Each Bag may is refering to between zero and ninety nine Bag Exceptions
bagException.description: A bag that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule. E.g. a bag that is too heavy for normal process.

bagLocationCity.title: Each Bag may has last known one and only one City
bagLocationCity.description: A City, town, or postal station (i.e. a postal service territory, often used in a military address, or metropolitan area).

bagLocationCountry.title: Each Bag may has last known one and only one Country
bagLocationCountry.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

bagLocationRegion.title: Each Bag may has last known one and only one Country Sub-Division
bagLocationRegion.description: An area of land which is a sub-division within a country, such as a state, a county, a canton, a province, etc.

bagPhysicalProperty.title: Each Bag must have one and only one Bag Physical Property
bagPhysicalProperty.description: A property used to characterize a bag, such as weight, color.

bagPosition.title: Each Bag may have one and only one Geospatial Location
bagPosition.description: A location with geographic or spatial coordinates, on the surface of the Earth or in the air. For example: Longitude and Latitude.

Bag.bagSegment.title: Each Bag may refers to between zero and ninety nine Bag Segments
Bag.bagSegment.description: maximum multiplicity 99 in line with maximum number of segments in a bar-coded boarding pass.

BagActivity.title: Bag Activity
BagActivity.description: A condition in which things are happening or being done to a bag, such as 'scan a bag'.

actualDateTime.title: Bag Activity.Actual Date Time
actualDateTime.description: Actual date and time of the activity.

baggageProcess.title: Each Bag Activity may be refering to one and only one Baggage Process
baggageProcess.description: A (current) baggage process details. A process is a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end.

handlingAgent.title: Each Bag Activity may refer to one and only one Agent
handlingAgent.description: A member of staff of an Agency.

handlingStation.title: Each Bag Activity may supplies one and only one Station
handlingStation.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

offStationInd.title: Bag Activity.Off-Station Indicator
offStationInd.description: If true, the current activity is carried out off station - also known as remotely. For example: hotel bag drop.

paxStatus.title: Each Bag Activity may be refering to one and only one Passenger Status
paxStatus.description: A status of a passenger at a particular time during a process.

screeningDeviceIdentifier.title: Bag Activity.Screening Device Identifier
screeningDeviceIdentifier.description: Identifier, as defined by the manufacturer or airport, of the machine that has undertaken the screening activity and determined the screening result.

screeningMethodCode.title: Bag Activity.Screening Method Code
screeningMethodCode.description: Code of the function interaction screening method.

BagActivity.accessGate.title: Each Bag Activity may supplies one and only one Access Gate
BagActivity.accessGate.description: A gate that allows access to or exit from a path to a transport vehicle.

BagActivity.operatingCarrier.title: Each Bag Activity must have one or more one and only one Airline
BagActivity.operatingCarrier.description: An organization operating aircraft for commercial purposes which offers air transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by the civil aviation authority of the state in which it is established. Note that the unique identifier of an Airline is a composite of the Airline Designator Code and its Name. It is common only to use Airline Designator Code when the duplicate coded airlines operate in different air spaces.

BagBasicCode.title: Bag Basic_ Code
BagBasicCode.description: The bag basic code of the physical property measurement

BagBasicCodeEnum.title: Bag Basic Code
BagBasicCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 743b Attachment a basic codes Valid Values: B - Single Item in a box; K - Cabin sized baggage carry on.

BagColorCode.title: Bag Color_ Code
BagColorCode.description: The bag color code of the physical property measurement

BagColorCodeEnum.title: Bag Color Code
BagColorCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 743b Attachment a color codes Valid Values: BE - Beige/Cream/Ivory; BK - Black; BN - Brown/Tan/Taupe/Bronze/Silver/Copper; BU - Blue; GN - Green/Olive/Jade; GY - gray/silver/aluminum; MC - Two of more solid colors excluding trim.; PC - Print/Pattern/Floral/Spotted/Tapestry/Stripe/Plaid/Checked; PU - Purple/Violet/Lilac; RD - Red/maroon/pink/burgundy; WT - White Clear; YW - yellow/orange/gold; ZZ - Color

BagDescriptiveCode.title: Bag Descriptive_ Code
BagDescriptiveCode.description: The bag descriptive code of the physical property measurement

BagDescriptiveCodeEnum.title: Bag Descriptive Code
BagDescriptiveCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 743b Attachment A: Categories 'Non-zippered Bags' to 'Items Not Shown Elsewhere'. Valid Values: 01 - Horizontal design, generally a hard shell that secures without a zipper, may have retractable handle-all sizes.; 02 - Upright design, generally a hard shell that secures without a zipper, may have retractable handle-all sizes. Add K for cabin size; 03 - Horizontal design suitcase that secures without a zipper, rigid frame, non expandable, may have reinforced corners, rounded or contoured top. Add L for leather material. Add T for tweed material.; 05 - Horizontal design suitcase that secures without a zipper, rigid frame/soft side/expandable. Add L for leather material. Add T for tweed material.; 06 - Briefcase; 07 - Pilot's bag/document case may have retractable handle.; 08 - Military style bag; 09 - Plastic/Laundry bag. If bag contains single item, use codes 01-99; 10 - Cardboard/wooden box-with miscellaneous contents. If box contains single item, use codes 01-99 with Descriptive Element B; 12 - Storage container with miscellaneous contents. May have handle and/or wheels; 20 - Hanging/folding garment bag/Suit Carrier may have wheels and retractable handle; 22 - Upright design, Soft material, may have retractable handle-all sizes. Add K for cabin size. Add L for leather material. Add T for tweed material.; 22D - Upright design, combined hard and soft material, may have retractable handle-all sizes. Add K for cabin size.; 22R - Upright design, durable, plastic, moulded or pre-formed material that secures with zipper, may have retractable handle-all sizes. Add K for cabin size.; 23 - Horizontal design suitcase that secures with zipper and may have retractable handle; 25 - Gym/sport bag-all sizes (may have shoulder strap and retractable handle); 26 - Small overnight bag or lap top bag generally carried onboard; 27 - Stands upright may be expandable in height, often has wheels; 28 - Matted woven bag; 29 - Backpack/Rucksack with or without frame may have retractable handle and wheels; 50 - Hat Box; 51 - Courier Bag/Box/Package; 52 - Trunk/Sample/Display case-often custom made (Describe Item); 53 - Art or Display portfolio; 54 - Tube-without sporting equipment; 55 - Duty free articles; 56 - Cosmetic/Beauty case, any style; 57 - Kennel/Pet container; 58 - Ice chest/Cooler bag; 59 - Tool/Tackle box; 60 - Fishing rod(s)/poles/sticks (with or without container); 61 - Firearm(s); 62 - Golf bag and/or Clubs-Specify colour and brand of golf bag, when available (Describe Item); 63 - Bicycle and/or accessories (Describe Item); 64 - Sleeping bag/Bed roll/Tent (Describe Item); 65 - Surf Equipment (Describe Item), e.g. Wind, Kite, Boogie, etc.; 66 - Skis and/or ski poles (with or without container) Nordic walking Poles. Specify colour and brand of skis/poles-not the container; 67 - Snow boards/other sledding devices (with or without container). Specify colour and brand of item-not the container; 68 - Ski boots and/or boot bag. Specify colour and brand of boots, when available; 69 - Sporting equipment not listed elsewhere (Describe Item); 71 - Child/Infant car seat; 72 - Child/Infant equipment not listed elsewhere (Describe Item) e.g. infant carrier, playpen, crib; 73 - Full size Pram/Baby Carriage/Jogger; 74 - Umbrella Stroller; 75 - Wheeled Sporting Items (Describe Item), e.g. skateboards, scooters, roller blades; 81 - Audio/Video/Visual/Photo equipment (Describe Item) e.g. television, DVD, video players and games, multimedia radio, tape/cassette/CD player, amplifier, speakers; 82 - Computer/Communication equipment-e.g. PC computer/monitor/keyboard/laptop computer/notebook computer/printer/computer game(s)/telephone/fax machine-(Describe Item); 83 - Electrical Appliances (Describe Item); 85 - All Music Instruments (Describe Item); 89 - Camping/Folding/Collapsible Chair; 90 - Baggage trolley; 92 - Security removed items, describe item; 93 - Shopping bag e.g. paper, straw, plastic, nylon; 94 - Wheel Chair, powered or manual and accessories (seat, wheel etc); 95 - Orthopaedic Devices other than wheelchairs and wheelchair accessories (seat, wheel, etc); 96 - Bedding Bag may contain pillows, blankets, duvet etc...; 97 - Specialist Dive B

BagDimension.title: Bag Dimension
BagDimension.description: A measurable extent of a particular bag, such as length, or height.

lengthMeasure.title: Bag Dimension.Length Measure
lengthMeasure.description: A measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of an object. Measure. Unit. Code must be CMT (centimeters).

BagDimension.bag.title: Each Bag Dimension must define the physical boundary of one and only one Bag
BagDimension.bag.description: A piece of luggage associated with a passenger, packed for traveling, and necessary or appropriate in connection with a journey. Business Identifier Fields: - [Bag Tag] (All Identifiers) - [Bag Segment] (All Identifiers)

BagDimension.heightMeasure.title: Bag Dimension.Height Measure
BagDimension.heightMeasure.description: A measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top. Measure. Unit. Code must be CMT (centimeters).

BagDimension.widthMeasure.title: Bag Dimension.Width Measure
BagDimension.widthMeasure.description: A measurement or extent of the bag from side to side; the lesser of two or the least of three dimensions of the bag. Unit must be CMT (centimeters).

BagDisclosureRuleTypeCode.title: Bag Disclosure Rule Type_ Code
BagDisclosureRuleTypeCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the Baggage Disclosure Rule Type.

BagDisclosureRuleTypeCodeEnum.title: Bag Disclosure Rule Type Code
BagDisclosureRuleTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Bag Disclosure Rule Type. Valid Values: D - Disclosure with no US DOT Reservation; N - No Disclosure or US DOT Reservation; Other - Other; Y - Disclosure and US DOT Reservation

BagDropDevice.title: Bag Drop Device
BagDropDevice.description: A piece of equipment provided to allow checked-in luggage to be handed over to baggage handling. May be used as a self-service device or be used by a manned check-in desk.

bagDropDeviceIdentifier.title: Bag Drop Device.Bag Drop Device Identifier
bagDropDeviceIdentifier.description: Identifier of the bag drop device.

BagDropDevice.checkInArea.title: Each Bag Drop Device may be located within one and only one Check-In Area
BagDropDevice.checkInArea.description: A place provided where facilities exist enabling passengers and / or their luggage to be checked-in.

BagException.title: Bag Exception
BagException.description: A bag that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule. E.g. a bag that is too heavy for normal process.

BagExternalFeatureCode.title: Bag External Feature_ Code
BagExternalFeatureCode.description: The bag external feature code of the physical property measurement

BagExternalFeatureCodeEnum.title: Bag External Feature Code
BagExternalFeatureCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 743b Attachment a external feature codes Valid Values: C - Combination Locks; H - Retractable Handle; S - Straps to close secure; W - Wheels Rollers; X - No external descriptive elements

BaggageActivityCode.title: Baggage Activity_ Code
BaggageActivityCode.description: The baggage activity code of the process interaction

BaggageActivityCodeEnum.title: Baggage Activity Code
BaggageActivityCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Baggage XML Function Activity Codes Valid Values: Acquire - Acquire Bag. A party or system is attempting to acquire a bag. See movement status code for success.; Deliver - Deliver Bag. A party or system is attempting to deliver a bag. See movement status code for success.; Identify - Identify Bag. A party or system is attempting to produce or re-produce a bags identity. See Authentication status code for success.; Load - Load Bag. A party or system is attempting to load a bag into a ULD or Aircraft Hold. See Containerisation status code for success.; Move - Move Bag. A party or system is attempting to move a bag. See movement status code for success.; Offload - Offload Bag. A party or system is attempting to offload a bag from a ULD or Aircraft. See Containerisation status code for success.; Produce - Produce Bag Identity. A party or system is attempting to produce or re-produce a bags identity. See Authentication status code for success.; PutAway - Put Away Bag. A party or system is attempting to put away a bag into storage. See Storage Status code for success.; Qualify - Qualify Bag. A party or system is attempting to qualify a bag against a plan. See Authentication status code for success.; Receipt - Receipt Bag. A party or system is attempting to receipt a bag in storage position. See Storage Status code for success.; Reclaim - Reclaim Bag. A party or system is attempting to reclaim a bag. See movement status code for success.; Recognize - Recognise Bag. A party or systems is attempting to recognise or scan a bag. See Authentication status code for success.; Reconcile - Reconcile Bag. A party or system is attempting to reconcile a bag. See Bag Containerisation codes for success.; Remove - Remove Bag. A party or system is attempting to remove a bag from a ULD or Aircraft (as a result of a request). See Containerisation status code for success.; Route - Route Bag. A party or system is attempting to route a bag. See movement status code for success.; Screen - Screen Bag. A party or system is attempting to screen a bag. See Bag Screening Status codes for success.; Sort - Sort Bag. A party or system is attempting to sort a bag. See Sortation status code for success.; Verify - Verify Bag. A party or system is attempting to verify a bag against business rules. See Authentication status code for success.; Withdraw - Withdraw Bag. A party or system is attempting to withdraw a bag from storage. See Storage Status code for success.

BaggageAllowance.title: Baggage Allowance
BaggageAllowance.description: An amount of checked or carry-on luggage the airline will allow per passenger.

baggageAllowanceIdentifier.title: Baggage Allowance.Baggage Allowance Identifier
baggageAllowanceIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of this Baggage Allowance.

dimensionAllowance.title: Each Baggage Allowance may can have one or more Dimension Allowances
dimensionAllowance.description: A Baggage dimension allowance with application information.

weightAllowance.title: Each Baggage Allowance may can have one or more Weight Allowances
weightAllowance.description: A baggage weight allowance with application information.

BaggageAllowance.typeCode.title: Baggage Allowance.Type Code
BaggageAllowance.typeCode.description: Type of Baggage Allowance. For example: Checked or CarryOn.

BaggageAllowance.paxJourney.title: Each Baggage Allowance must be allowed by one and only one Passenger Journey
BaggageAllowance.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

BaggageAllowance.ticket.title: Each Baggage Allowance must have one and only one Ticket
BaggageAllowance.ticket.description: An accountable document issued by or on behalf of a carrier which includes notices and the flight and passenger coupons.

BaggageClaim.title: Baggage Claim
BaggageClaim.description: An infrastructure facility and space allocated for retrieval of baggage.

baggageClaimIdentifier.title: Baggage Claim.Baggage Claim Identifier
baggageClaimIdentifier.description: Identifier of baggage reclaim unit. For example: 'T1A'.

BaggageClaimIdentifier.title: Baggage Claim_ Identifier
BaggageClaimIdentifier.description: An indicator set by the airline to unload a loaded bag, Should be set with the authorization to load set to NO.

BaggageDisclosure.title: Baggage Disclosure
BaggageDisclosure.description: A Disclosure information specifically related to baggage.

baggageDisclosureIdentifier.title: Baggage Disclosure.Baggage Disclosure Identifier
baggageDisclosureIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies a Bag Disclosure within the message.

checkInChargesInd.title: Baggage Disclosure.Check In Charges Indicator
checkInChargesInd.description: If TRUE, additional taxes, fees and charges may be collected at check-in. Typically determined regionally.

fixedPrePaidInd.title: Baggage Disclosure.Fixed Pre Paid Indicator
fixedPrePaidInd.description: Allows POA to tell the ORA if the ORA may alter the POA's pre-paid baggage charges. If TRUE, prepaid charge may NOT be altered If FALSE, prepaid charge MAY be altered.

ruleTypeCode.title: Baggage Disclosure.Rule Type Code
ruleTypeCode.description: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Reservation or Disclosure baggage rule. For example: Y, Disclosure AND US DOT Reservation.

BaggageHandlingBay.title: Baggage Handling Bay
BaggageHandlingBay.description: An infrastructure facility in a recessed, enclosed or bounded area for baggage handling.

baggageHandlingBayIdentifier.title: Baggage Handling Bay.Baggage Handling Bay Identifier
baggageHandlingBayIdentifier.description: Identifier of the baggage handling bay.

BaggageHandlingBay.aircraftDep.title: Each Baggage Handling Bay may be used by one or more Departure Baggage Handling Baies
BaggageHandlingBay.aircraftDep.description: An area where baggage is assembled prior to it being loaded onto an aircraft.

BaggageHandlingBay.station.title: Each Baggage Handling Bay must be part of one and only one Station
BaggageHandlingBay.station.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

BaggageHandlingBay.aircraftArrival.title: Each Baggage Handling Bay may be used by one or more Arrival Baggage Handling Baies
BaggageHandlingBay.aircraftArrival.description: An area where baggage is assembled as soon as the luggage is removed from an aircraft.

BaggageHandlingBayIdentifier.title: Baggage Handling Bay_ Identifier
BaggageHandlingBayIdentifier.description: The Baggage handling bay identifier of the infrastructure facility. #A redefined Handling Bay_ Identifier

BaggagePricingCriteria.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria
BaggagePricingCriteria.description: A set of Baggage pricing specific filter criteria for shopping requests, including baggage type, charges, and settlement information.

baggageOptionCode.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria.Baggage Option Code
baggageOptionCode.description: Specifies the type of baggage. For example: CarryOnBag, CheckedBag.

fixedPrepaidInd.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria.Fixed Prepaid Indicator
fixedPrepaidInd.description: When TRUE, the ORA may alter the POA's prepaid baggage charges.

includeSettlementInd.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria.Include Settlement Indicator
includeSettlementInd.description: When TRUE, the POA is requested to return the settlement value for the baggage.

optionalChargesCode.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria.Optional Charges Code
optionalChargesCode.description: Allowance catalog requested. For example: C (Catalog Only).

requestedActionCode.title: Baggage Pricing Criteria.Requested Action Code
requestedActionCode.description: Requested action to take for this information. For example: 131 DISPLAY ONLY.

BaggageProcess.title: Baggage Process
BaggageProcess.description: A (current) baggage process details. A process is a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end.

baggageProcessCode.title: Baggage Process.Baggage Process Code
baggageProcessCode.description: Code of the process interaction baggage code.

BaggageProcessCode.title: Baggage Process_ Code
BaggageProcessCode.description: The baggage process code of the process interaction

BaggageProcessCodeEnum.title: Baggage Process Code
BaggageProcessCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment A Process Source Indicator Codes Valid Values: L - Departing Process; T - Transfering Process; X - Arrivals (Terminating) Process

BaggageStandardWeights.title: Baggage Standard Weights
BaggageStandardWeights.description: An approved baggage standard weights to be used for weight and balance calculation.

baggageStandardWeightsVariationCode.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Baggage Standard Weights Variation Code
baggageStandardWeightsVariationCode.description: Variation code. For example: Standard, Domestic, International, Charter.

bagsPerPaxQty.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Bags Per Passenger Quantity
bagsPerPaxQty.description: Average number of bags of checked baggage expected per passenger.

bagVolumeMeasure.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Bag Volume Measure
bagVolumeMeasure.description: Average bag volume of checked baggage.

bagWeightPerPaxMeasure.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Bag Weight Per Passenger Measure
bagWeightPerPaxMeasure.description: Average bag weight of checked baggage per passenger.

weightPerBagMeasure.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Weight Per Bag Measure
weightPerBagMeasure.description: Standard weight of checked baggage per bag.

weightPerPaxMeasure.title: Baggage Standard Weights.Weight Per Passenger Measure
weightPerPaxMeasure.description: Standard weight of checked baggage per passenger.

BaggageTypeCode.title: Baggage Type_ Code
BaggageTypeCode.description: Additional BDT to specify baggage type code.

BaggageTypeCodeEnum.title: Baggage Type Code
BaggageTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Baggage Type. Valid Values: CarryOn - CarryOn; Checked - Checked

BagIncident.title: Bag Incident
BagIncident.description: An Event that occurs spontaneously about a bag, and to which the organization is required to respond.

BagMaterialCode.title: Bag Material_ Code
BagMaterialCode.description: The bag material code of the physical property measurement

BagMaterialCodeEnum.title: Bag Material Code
BagMaterialCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 743b Attachment a. material codes Valid Values: D - Dual Combined hard and soft material.; L - Leather; M - Metal - e.g. aluminum or sheet steel; R - Rigid - Durable, plastic, molded or formed.; T - Tweed

BagPhysicalProperty.title: Bag Physical Property
BagPhysicalProperty.description: A property used to characterize a bag, such as weight, color.

basicCode.title: Bag Physical Property.Basic Code
basicCode.description: Basic code of the physical property measurement. Refer to resolution 743b basic element codes.

descriptiveCode.title: Bag Physical Property.Descriptive Code
descriptiveCode.description: Descriptive code of the physical property measurement. Refer to resolution 743b description codes.

descriptivePictureUri.title: Bag Physical Property.Descriptive Picture URI
descriptivePictureUri.description: Descriptive picture of physical property measurement.

externalFeatureCode.title: Bag Physical Property.External Feature Code
externalFeatureCode.description: External feature of the physical property measurement. Refer to resolution 743b external element codes.

materialCode.title: Bag Physical Property.Material Code
materialCode.description: Material code of the physical property measurement. Refer to resolution 743b description codes.

BagPhysicalProperty.colorCode.title: Bag Physical Property.Color Code
BagPhysicalProperty.colorCode.description: Color of the physical property measurement. Refer to resolution 743b color codes.

BagPhysicalProperty.weightMeasure.title: Bag Physical Property.Weight Measure
BagPhysicalProperty.weightMeasure.description: A measurement of the heaviness of a bag. Only checked weight supported. Unit must be KGT (kilograms).

BagRuleCode.title: Bag Rule_ Code
BagRuleCode.description: BDT to represent Bag Rule code list.

BagRuleCodeEnum.title: Bag Rule Code
BagRuleCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the currency application code Type BDT. Valid Values: D - Disclosure with NO US DOT Reservation; N - No Disclosure or US DOT Reservation; Other - Other; Y - Disclosure and US DOT Reservation

BagSegment.title: Bag Segment
BagSegment.description: A movement of a bag over a Dated Operating Segment.

bagSegmentException.title: Each Bag Segment may is refering to between zero and ninety nine Bag Segment Exceptions
bagSegmentException.description: An exception for a bag on a particular segment of travel.

currentSegmentInd.title: Bag Segment.Current Segment Indicator
currentSegmentInd.description: Indicates if this is the segment currently being flown, and for which bag events are being published. A segment is considered to open at check-in or at previous segment close, and to close when bags have arrived or moved to transfer.

loadSeqNumberOrdinal.title: Bag Segment.Load Sequence Number Ordinal
loadSeqNumberOrdinal.description: Sequence number in which the baggage item was loaded into the stowage device.

segmentSecurity.title: Each Bag Segment may is handle according to one and only one Segment Security Control
segmentSecurity.description: A set of principles or procedures according to which something is done on a particular segment of travel.

serviceOffer.title: Each Bag Segment may is refering to one and only one Segment Service Offer
serviceOffer.description: An offer that applies to a particular segment of travel.

BagSegmentException.title: Bag Segment Exception
BagSegmentException.description: An exception for a bag on a particular segment of travel.

BagStatus.title: Bag Status
BagStatus.description: A status of a bag at a particular time in a process.

authenticationStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Authentication Status Code
authenticationStatusCode.description: Code of the bag authentication status.

containerizationStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Containerization Status Code
containerizationStatusCode.description: Code of the bag containerization status. Includes bag irregularities in loading. A baggage irregularity is a (baggage process) that is irregular in form or nature.

movementStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Movement Status Code
movementStatusCode.description: Code of the bag movement status.

screeningResultReason.title: Each Bag Status may have one and only one Bag Incident
screeningResultReason.description: An Event that occurs spontaneously about a bag, and to which the organization is required to respond.

screeningResultStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Screening Result Status Code
screeningResultStatusCode.description: Code of the bag screening result status.

sortationStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Sortation Status Code
sortationStatusCode.description: Code of the bag sortation status.

storageStatusCode.title: Bag Status.Storage Status Code
storageStatusCode.description: Code of the bag storage status.

BagTag.title: Bag Tag
BagTag.description: A small piece of paper, fabric, plastic or similar material attached to an bag and giving information about it.

airlineBagRefIdentifier.title: Bag Tag.Airline Bag Reference Identifier
airlineBagRefIdentifier.description: Baggage identifier used for internal usage only (typically used as Julian date on 3 numeric). For example: 100 (100 th Julian day).

issuingAgency.title: Each Bag Tag may be provided by one and only one Agency
issuingAgency.description: An organization that acts on behalf of another organization or an individual.

issuingAgent.title: Each Bag Tag may be provided by one and only one Agent
issuingAgent.description: A member of staff of an Agency.

issuingAirline.title: Each Bag Tag must be issued by one and only one Airline
issuingAirline.description: An organization operating aircraft for commercial purposes which offers air transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by the civil aviation authority of the state in which it is established. Note that the unique identifier of an Airline is a composite of the Airline Designator Code and its Name. It is common only to use Airline Designator Code when the duplicate coded airlines operate in different air spaces.

tagExpediteInd.title: Bag Tag.Tag Expedite Indicator
tagExpediteInd.description: Indicator of whether this is a expedite tag.

tagFallbackInd.title: Bag Tag.Tag Fallback Indicator
tagFallbackInd.description: Indicator of whether this is a fallback tag.

tagInterlineInd.title: Bag Tag.Tag Interline Indicator
tagInterlineInd.description: Indicator of whether this is a interline tag.

transponderIdentifier.title: Bag Tag.Transponder Identifier
transponderIdentifier.description: Unique Transponder identifier, known as TID for Transponder identification.

uuidIdentifier.title: Bag Tag.UUID Identifier
uuidIdentifier.description: Unique Globally Unique identifier, known as GUID. G = RFC UUID unique id (version 4).

BagTag.issuingCarrier.title: Each Bag Tag may be provided by one and only one Carrier
BagTag.issuingCarrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

BagTag.printer.title: Each Bag Tag must be issued by one and only one Printer
BagTag.printer.description: A device for printing text or pictures or barcodes, especially one linked to a computer.

BagTag.scanner.title: Each Bag Tag may be read by one and only one Scanner
BagTag.scanner.description: A device that scans objects and converts them or extracts of them into digital data. Different types of scanner are a document scanner, a barcode reader and a biometric scanner.

BagTagIdentifier.title: Bag Tag_ Identifier
BagTagIdentifier.description: The tag identifier of the label document

BalanceOutputCode.title: Balance Output_ Code
BalanceOutputCode.description: Specifies Balance Output codes (Basic Index, Dry Operating Index, Dead load MAC, MAC - at zero fuel weight,...) based on PADIS Code List.

BalanceOutputCodeEnum.title: Balance Output Code
BalanceOutputCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for Balance Output codes (Basic Index, Dry Operating Index, Dead load MAC, MAC - at zero fuel weight,...)

BalanceOutputRequirement.title: Balance Output Requirement
BalanceOutputRequirement.description: A Requirement to put specific balance information on specific types of load sheet (provisional, final, ACARS,...).

balanceOutputRequirementCode.title: Balance Output Requirement.Balance Output Requirement Code
balanceOutputRequirementCode.description: Balance Output code (Basic Index, Dry Operating Index, Dead load MAC, MAC - at zero fuel weight,...) based on PADIS Code List.

BalanceOutputRequirement.remark.title: Each Balance Output Requirement may supplies one or more Remarks
BalanceOutputRequirement.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

BalanceOutputRequirement.finalInd.title: Balance Output Requirement.Final Indicator
BalanceOutputRequirement.finalInd.description: Indicates that output is required on the final EDP load sheet (AHM517).

BalanceOutputRequirement.preliminaryAcar.title: Balance Output Requirement.Preliminary ACARS Indicator
BalanceOutputRequirement.preliminaryAcar.description: Indicates that output is required on the preliminary ACARS load sheet (AHM518).

BalanceOutputRequirement.preliminaryInd.title: Balance Output Requirement.Preliminary Indicator
BalanceOutputRequirement.preliminaryInd.description: Indicates that output is required on the preliminary EDP load sheet (AHM517).

BankTransfer.title: Bank Transfer
BankTransfer.description: A Bank Account payment method definition. Customer bank accounts for payments, either for paper checks or electronic funds transfer.

accountTypeText.title: Bank Transfer.Account Type Text
accountTypeText.description: Account Type. For example: Checking, Savings, Investment

bankIdentifier.title: Bank Transfer.Bank Identifier
bankIdentifier.description: Routing Number. For example: 0260-0959-3. Note: This is the code assigned by authorities to financial institutions; sometimes called bank routing number.

subCode.title: Bank Transfer.Sub Code
subCode.description: Defines what type of Bank Transfer is currently used for payment to provide a more detailed definition of what the payment actually is.

BankTransfer.ownerName.title: Bank Transfer.Owner Name
BankTransfer.ownerName.description: Name the bank account is held under. For example: JOHN SMITH.

BayGrouping.title: Bay Grouping
BayGrouping.description: A grouping of ULD positions (Stack/String) used as a method of maximizing the ULD capacity of a lower hold by not using intermediate locks.

bayGroupingIdentifier.title: Bay Grouping.Bay Grouping Identifier
bayGroupingIdentifier.description: Identifies a Bay (ULD) Grouping (String/Stack) in an aircraft. As per AHM565 Bay Groupings are identified by joining the identifiers of the first and last bay in the group separated by a hyphen. For example: 12L-21L.

BayGrouping.colorCode.title: Bay Grouping.Color Code
BayGrouping.colorCode.description: Color coding utilized to identify a specific ULD grouping or configuration.

BayGrouping.hold.title: Each Bay Grouping must be used by one and only one Hold
BayGrouping.hold.description: A space in an aircraft confined by ceiling, floor, walls and bulkhead, used for carrying load.

BayGrouping.lateralArmFromMeasure.title: Bay Grouping.Lateral Arm From Measure
BayGrouping.lateralArmFromMeasure.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the left hand edge of the Bay Grouping. Enter values as negative.

BayGrouping.lateralArmToMeasure.title: Bay Grouping.Lateral Arm To Measure
BayGrouping.lateralArmToMeasure.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the right hand edge of the Bay Grouping. Enter values as positive.

BayGrouping.maximumWeightMeasure.title: Bay Grouping.Maximum Weight Measure
BayGrouping.maximumWeightMeasure.description: Maximum permitted weight for the Bay Grouping.

BayGrouping.missingRestraintRule.title: Each Bay Grouping may use one or more Missing Restraint Rules
BayGrouping.missingRestraintRule.description: A restriction on weight applicable when one or more locks are inoperable or missing.

BayLock.title: Bay Lock
BayLock.description: A Lock used by a ULD Position.

lockPositionCode.title: Bay Lock.Lock Position Code
lockPositionCode.description: Position of lock relative to the ULD position.

Bdc.title: BDC
Bdc.description: An information for use in NDC Interline: The carrier whose baggage allowances and charges apply.

analysisResultCode.title: BDC.Analysis Result Code
analysisResultCode.description: In concert with BaggageDeterminingCarrier data field, specifies the reason for the carrier code in the AirlineID element. Encoding Scheme: IATA PADIS Code List for data element RES.

bagRuleCode.title: BDC.Bag Rule Code
bagRuleCode.description: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Reservation or Disclosure baggage rule. For example: Y, Disclosure AND US DOT Reservation.

reasonText.title: BDC.Reason Text
reasonText.description: Reason for selection of the Baggage Determining Carrier. For example: Regulatory (application of regulation or resolution), Deferral (deferral by ORA), Bilateral (bilateral agreement).

Bdc.responseParameters.title: Each BDC must engage one and only one Response Parameters
Bdc.responseParameters.description: An information related to how response results should be returned.

BdcAnalysisResultCode.title: BDC Analysis Result_ Code
BdcAnalysisResultCode.description: Additional BDT to specify BDC analysis result code.

BdcAnalysisResultCodeEnum.title: BDC Analysis Result Code
BdcAnalysisResultCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the BDC Analysis Result Code Type BDT.

BilateralTimeLimit.title: Bilateral Time Limit
BilateralTimeLimit.description: A bilaterally agreed limitation or restriction of time.

BilateralTimeLimit.descText.title: Bilateral Time Limit.Description Text
BilateralTimeLimit.descText.description: Additional text to supplement a specified time limit.

BilateralTimeLimit.orderItem.title: Each Bilateral Time Limit must apply to one and only one Order Item
BilateralTimeLimit.orderItem.description: An individually priced item within an Order, made up of one or more Services. May or may not be a selected Offer Item (e.g. non-chargeable Services available on request such as a wheelchair).

BilateralTimeLimit.serviceDefinition.title: Each Bilateral Time Limit must have one and only one Service Definition
BilateralTimeLimit.serviceDefinition.description: A description and characteristics of a non-flight product or service that can be separately sold and delivered. E.g. bag, seat, meal on a flight.

BilateralTimeLimit.order.title: Each Bilateral Time Limit must apply to one and only one Order
BilateralTimeLimit.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

BilateralTimeLimit.timeLimitDateTime.title: Bilateral Time Limit.Time Limit Date Time
BilateralTimeLimit.timeLimitDateTime.description: Date and time of the time limit.

BinaryObject.title: Binary Object
BinaryObject.description: A binary object is a sequence of binary digits (bits).

characterSetCode.title: Binary Object.Character Set. Code
characterSetCode.description: The character set of the binary object if the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type is text.

encodingCode.title: Binary Object.Encoding. Code
encodingCode.description: Specifies the decoding algorithm of the binary object.

fileName.title: Binary Object.File. Name
fileName.description: The filename of the binary object.

mimeCode.title: Binary Object.MIME. Code
mimeCode.description: The Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) media type of the binary object.

uniformResourceIdentifier.title: Binary Object.Uniform Resource. Identifier
uniformResourceIdentifier.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier that identifies where the Binary Object is located.

BinaryObject.value.title: Binary Object.Content
BinaryObject.value.description: A finite sequence of binary digits (bits)

BinaryObject.format.title: Binary Object.Format
BinaryObject.format.description: The format of the binary content.

BoardingPass.title: Boarding Pass
BoardingPass.description: Boarding pass is a type of accountable document which is used electronically or physically as proof of authorisation/authentication of right to board a flight.

aircraftScheduledDateTime.title: Boarding Pass.Aircraft Scheduled Date Time
aircraftScheduledDateTime.description: The Scheduled Date and Time of Departure of the aircraft at the terminal or departure gate at an airport.

boardingPassFormatedPaxName.title: Boarding Pass.Boarding Pass Formated Passenger Name
boardingPassFormatedPaxName.description: Boarding Pass Formated Passenger Name is derived from Given Name and Surname in the physical boarding pass. There is a concatenation of Surname / Given name in one field max 19 chars

bookingRefIdentifier.title: Boarding Pass.Booking Reference Identifier
bookingRefIdentifier.description: Booking reference Identifier, also called Record Locator (6 characters).

operatingCarrierFlightNumber.title: Boarding Pass.Operating Carrier Flight Number
operatingCarrierFlightNumber.description: The numerical designation of a flight as it is operated by a carrier.

seatNumberCode.title: Boarding Pass.Seat Number Code
seatNumberCode.description: Seat Number (Char(4) ) <[Column Id][Row Number]> or strings <'GATE'> or <'STBY'>. GATE - seat not allocated but will be at gate. STBY - standby ticket so allocated at gate if availability.

ticketDocTypeCode.title: Boarding Pass.Ticket Document Type Code
ticketDocTypeCode.description: Document type code as defined by PADIS 1001 (Document/ Message Name, coded).

BoardingPass.paxSegment.title: Each Boarding Pass may be authorised for boarding in one and only one Passenger Segment
BoardingPass.paxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

BoardingPass.destStation.title: Boarding Pass.Destination Station
BoardingPass.destStation.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

BoardingPass.originStation.title: Boarding Pass.Origin Station
BoardingPass.originStation.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

BoardingStatusCode.title: Boarding Status_ Code
BoardingStatusCode.description: The boarding status code of the individual party status

BoardingStatusCodeEnum.title: Boarding Status Code
BoardingStatusCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment a baggage status codes for Boarding status. Valid Values: B - Passenger boarded.; C - Passenger checked-in.; N - Passenger not checked-in.; S - Passenger on standby

bookingRefCompanyCode.title: Booking.Booking Reference Company Code
bookingRefCompanyCode.description: Code of company having issued the booking reference identifier.

bookingRefTypeCode.title: Booking.Booking Reference Type Code
bookingRefTypeCode.description: Booking Reference Type. For example: 6 (Passenger confirmation number) Encoding Scheme: IATA Padis Codeset - List for data element [1153] Reference Qualifier.

BookingInstructions.title: Booking Instructions
BookingInstructions.description: An Optional service booking instructions to include SSR, OSI and upgrade Method.

bookingInstructionsUpgradeNewClassCode.title: Booking Instructions.Booking Instructions Upgrade New Class Code
bookingInstructionsUpgradeNewClassCode.description: New Cabin Type Code related to the Upgrade Method. As defined by PADIS codeset. For example: 1, 2, 3.

methodText.title: Booking Instructions.Method Text
methodText.description: PNR booking method. For example: AE (BY SSR - SPECIAL SERVICE REQUEST). For maximum interoperability, refer to IATA PADIS Code List for data element 9750. Select a code value or enter a value that is bilaterally agreed upon between trading partners.

osiText.title: Booking Instructions.OSI Text
osiText.description: Other service information (OSI) text. For example: PAX VIP MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT.

specialService.title: Each Booking Instructions may supplies one or more Special Services

upgradeMethodCode.title: Booking Instructions.Upgrade Method Code
upgradeMethodCode.description: Upgrade method. Example: AE (BY SSR - SPECIAL SERVICE REQUEST) For maximum interoperability, refer to IATA PADIS Code List for data element 9750. Select a code value or enter a value that is bilaterally agreed upon between trading partners.

BookingRef.title: Booking Reference
BookingRef.description: A location in a database where to find a booking.

bookingCreationDateTime.title: Booking Reference.Booking Creation Date Time
bookingCreationDateTime.description: Creation date and time of the booking reference.

BookingRefCompanyCode.title: Booking Reference Company_ Code
BookingRefCompanyCode.description: Code of company having issued the booking reference identifier.

BookingRefIdentifier.title: Booking Reference_ Identifier
BookingRefIdentifier.description: Booking reference Identifier, also called Record Locator (6 characters).

BookingRefTypeCode.title: Booking Reference Type_ Code
BookingRefTypeCode.description: Definitions from BBIEs this classifies are: Booking Reference Type. Example: 6 (Passenger confirmation number) Encoding Scheme: IATA Padis Codeset - List for data element [1153] Reference Qualifier. OR Specifies the type of Booking Reference. Encoding Scheme: IATA Padis Codeset - List for data element [9958] Reservation Control Type.

CabinCompartment.title: Cabin Compartment
CabinCompartment.description: A physical aircraft compartment where passenger seats are installed, classified by a given Cabin Type. These compartments are typically defined based on fare paid or facilities and services offered.

firstRow.title: Each First Row Seat Row may comprise one and only one First Row Seat Row
firstRow.description: A row of passenger seats located in the cabin.

lastRow.title: Each Last Row Seat Row may comprise one and only one Last Row Seat Row
lastRow.description: A row of passenger seats located in the cabin.

CabinComponent.title: Cabin Component
CabinComponent.description: A Non-seat related cabin feature or facility (e.g. lavatory, galley, closet, stowage, etc.)

absoluteLengthMeasure.title: Cabin Component.Absolute Length Measure
absoluteLengthMeasure.description: Length of the component measured along the axis of the aircraft.

absoluteWidthMeasure.title: Cabin Component.Absolute Width Measure
absoluteWidthMeasure.description: Width of the component measured along the lateral axis of the aircraft.

cabinComponentTypeCode.title: Cabin Component.Cabin Component Type Code
cabinComponentTypeCode.description: Code of the cabin component Type

columnEquivWidthNumber.title: Cabin Component.Column Equivalent Width Number
columnEquivWidthNumber.description: Equivalent width of the component in columns.

firstSeatRow.title: Each First Seat Row Cabin Compartment may start with one and only one First Seat Row Cabin Compartment
firstSeatRow.description: A row of passenger seats located in the cabin.

lastSeatRow.title: Each Last Seat Row Cabin Compartment may end with one and only one Last Seat Row Cabin Compartment
lastSeatRow.description: A row of passenger seats located in the cabin.

orientationCode.title: Cabin Component.Orientation Code
orientationCode.description: Indicates the orientation, or direction of the component.

rowEquivLengthNumber.title: Cabin Component.Row Equivalent Length Number
rowEquivLengthNumber.description: Equivalent length of the component in rows.

CabinComponent.pantryDistributionElement.title: Each Cabin Component may relates to one or more Galley Locations
CabinComponent.pantryDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a pantry distribution.

CabinComponentTypeCode.title: Cabin Component Type_ Code
CabinComponentTypeCode.description: Specifies a Cabin Component Type Code.

CabinComponentTypeCodeEnum.title: Cabin Component Type Code
CabinComponentTypeCodeEnum.description: Cabin component type code set. Examples: 701 (Movable compartment divider) 702 (Convertible seats) AR (Air phone) BA (Bar) BK (Bulkhead) CL (Closet) G (Galley) LA (Lavatory) LG (Luggage storage) MV (Movie screen) SO (Storage space) ST (Stairs to upper deck) TA (Table

CabinCrewDistributionElement.title: Cabin Crew Distribution Element
CabinCrewDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a crew distribution related to cabin crew.

CabinCrewLocation.title: Cabin Crew Location
CabinCrewLocation.description: A seat location for cabin crew.

cabinCrewLocationIdentifier.title: Cabin Crew Location.Cabin Crew Location Identifier
cabinCrewLocationIdentifier.description: Identifies a cabin crew location. For example: Door 1L, Over wing Exit, Aft Crew Rest.

CabinCrewLocationIdentifier.title: Cabin Crew Location_ Identifier
CabinCrewLocationIdentifier.description: Specifies a Cabin Crew Location identifier.

CabinLayout.title: Cabin Layout
CabinLayout.description: A planned utilization layout of aircraft cabin section/zone.

cabinLayoutIdentifier.title: Cabin Layout.Cabin Layout Identifier
cabinLayoutIdentifier.description: Identifies the cabin layout (seating configuration) for a given aircraft type.For example: 10C/200Y.

CabinLayoutClassInfo.title: Cabin Layout Class Information
CabinLayoutClassInfo.description: A Cabin Layout information by cabin type.

CabinSeatColumn.title: Cabin Seat Column
CabinSeatColumn.description: A column of seats within a cabin used to identify seats and cabin components within a Row.

cabinSeatColumnIdentifier.title: Cabin Seat Column.Cabin Seat Column Identifier
cabinSeatColumnIdentifier.description: Alphabetic character identifying a column of seats. Typically, the letters A, B, C, D, E, F are used.

CabinSeatColumn.seat.title: Each Cabin Seat Column may classify one or more Seats
CabinSeatColumn.seat.description: A sitting place for a passenger located in the cabin.

CabinSection.title: Cabin Section
CabinSection.description: A division of the cabin into zones for the purpose of balance.

cabinSectionIdentifier.title: Cabin Section.Cabin Section Identifier
cabinSectionIdentifier.description: Identifies a cabin section within a deck. As per AHM505, cabin sections can be identified starting with a zero (0) as a first figure to indicate the cabin followed by an alpha character starting with A from the front to the rear.
