If the cabin sections correspond with the configuration layout per class, it is also possible to use the class designator. For example: F for first class, to identify a cabin section.

endRowNumber.title: Cabin Section.End Row Number
endRowNumber.description: Seat Row Number at which the cabin ends.

startRowNumber.title: Cabin Section.Start Row Number
startRowNumber.description: Seat Row Number at which the cabin starts.

CabinType.title: Cabin Type
CabinType.description: A classification of aircraft compartments offering a specific range and level of services. For example: business class, economy.

baggageCabinTypeSegmentServiceOffer.title: Each Baggage Cabin Type Segment Service Offer may have one or more Baggage Cabin Types
baggageCabinTypeSegmentServiceOffer.description: An offer that applies to a particular segment of travel.

cabinTypeCode.title: Cabin Type.Cabin Type Code
cabinTypeCode.description: Cabin Type Code as defined by PADIS code set. For example: 1, 2, 3.

cabinTypeIdentifier.title: Cabin Type.Cabin Type Identifier
cabinTypeIdentifier.description: Cabin Type Identifier. Contents to be defined by bilateral agreement. Field/BDT used in domains such as Baggage Logistics where the standard Cabin Type Codes may not be sufficient.

paxCabinTypeSegmentServiceOffer.title: Each Passenger Cabin Type Segment Service Offer may have one or more Passenger Cabin Types
paxCabinTypeSegmentServiceOffer.description: An offer that applies to a particular segment of travel.

CabinType.shoppingCriteria.title: Each Cabin Type may have one or more Cabin Type Criterias
CabinType.shoppingCriteria.description: A set of criteria which qualifies the flight request by influencing which results are returned in the shopping response, including preferred or required criteria.

CabinTypeCode.title: Cabin Type_ Code
CabinTypeCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the Cabin Type Code as defined by PADIS.

CabinTypeCodeEnum.title: Cabin Type Code
CabinTypeCodeEnum.description: Specifies the Cabin Type Code enum values as defined by PADIS. Valid Values: 1 - First class, Highest class of service (First Class Category); 2 - Second class, Medium class of service (Business Class Category); 3 - Third class, lowest class of service (all economy/coach class categories); 4 - Economy/coach premium; 5 - Economy/coach; 6 - Economy/coach discounted; 7 - All

CabinTypeIdentifier.title: Cabin Type_ Identifier
CabinTypeIdentifier.description: Cabin Type Identifier. Contents to be defined by bilateral agreement. Field/BDT used in domains (e.g. Baggage Logistics) where the standard Cabin Type Codes may not be sufficient.

CalendarDateCriteria.title: Calendar Date Criteria
CalendarDateCriteria.description: A request to an airline to additionally include a preview of the Offer price for a specified date range for the same Shopping Criteria.

daysAfterNumber.title: Calendar Date Criteria.Days After Number
daysAfterNumber.description: Number of days after the Departure and Arrival dates for which the Calendar Date request should consider.

daysBeforeNumber.title: Calendar Date Criteria.Days Before Number
daysBeforeNumber.description: Number of days prior to the Departure and Arrival dates for which the Calendar Date request should consider.

CancelRestrictions.title: Cancel Restrictions
CancelRestrictions.description: A set of qualifying conditions/rules/restrictions that are related to a constrained priced grouping of services for the Cancellation action. https://guides.developer.iata.org/docs/offer-and-order-conditions-and-restrictions

CargoHeatingDevice.title: Cargo Heating Device
CargoHeatingDevice.description: An Heating capability of the cargo hold.

cockpitMasterSwitchInd.title: Cargo Heating Device.Cockpit Master Switch Indicator
cockpitMasterSwitchInd.description: Indicates that there is a master switch in the cockpit for the heating capability.

temperatureFromValue.title: Cargo Heating Device.Temperature From Value
temperatureFromValue.description: Minimum expected temperature for the specified control panel setting.

temperatureToValue.title: Cargo Heating Device.Temperature To Value
temperatureToValue.description: Maximum expected temperature for the specified control panel setting.

CargoTypeCodeEnum.title: Cargo Type Code
CargoTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Cargo Type Code BDT. Valid Values: LL - ULD's; PP - Pallets

CargoVentilationDevice.title: Cargo Ventilation Device
CargoVentilationDevice.description: A Ventilation capability of the cargo hold.

airExchDuration.title: Cargo Ventilation Device.Air Exchange Duration
airExchDuration.description: Elapsed time taken for the air in the hold or compartment to be completely replenished.

airExchRateValue.title: Cargo Ventilation Device.Air Exchange Rate Value
airExchRateValue.description: Flow rate at which the air moves through the hold or compartment.

airExchVolumeMeasure.title: Cargo Ventilation Device.Air Exchange Volume Measure
airExchVolumeMeasure.description: Volume of air in the hold or compartment.

airflowRateBaseCode.title: Cargo Ventilation Device.Airflow Rate Base Code
airflowRateBaseCode.description: Indicates that the Air Exchange Rate is expressed in Times Per Hour (true) or Times Per Minute (false).

CarriageMediumCode.title: Carriage Medium_ Code
CarriageMediumCode.description: The usage category code of the transport

CarriageMediumCodeEnum.title: Carriage Medium Code
CarriageMediumCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment a carriage medium codes. Valid Values: AV - Airline VAN; CO - Courier Van; CR - Car Rental VAN; CS - Cruise Ship; HV - Hotel VAN; RA - Rail

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

airlineLoadInfo.title: Each Carrier may supplies one or more Airline Load Informations
airlineLoadInfo.description: An Information distinguishing different categories of cargo used for load planning characterized by Airline specific codes in addition to codes defined in AHM510.

carrierDesigCode.title: Carrier.Carrier Designator Code
carrierDesigCode.description: ICAO-defined 3-character code or IATA-defined 2-character code assigned to the carrier. For example: BA is British Airways PLC, 2C is SNCF and is also CMA CGM Air Cargo.

defaultVolumeUnitCode.title: Carrier.Default Volume Unit Code
defaultVolumeUnitCode.description: Volume unit of measure to be used in any and all business interactions with the carrier unless specified otherwise.

defaultWeightUnitCode.title: Carrier.Default Weight Unit Code
defaultWeightUnitCode.description: Weight unit of measure to be used in any and all business interactions with the carrier unless specified otherwise.

marketedOffer.title: Each Marketing Carrier may own one or more Marketing Carriers
marketedOffer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

validatedOffer.title: Each Validating Carrier may supplies one or more Validating Carriers
validatedOffer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

Carrier.airlineProfile.title: Each Carrier must be owned by one and only one Profile Owner
Carrier.airlineProfile.description: A distribution profile of an airline which describes which types of shopping requests may be processed by a particular carrier.

Carrier.orderItem.title: Each Marketing Carrier may own one or more Marketing Carriers
Carrier.orderItem.description: An individually priced item within an Order, made up of one or more Services. May or may not be a selected Offer Item (e.g. non-chargeable Services available on request such as a wheelchair).

Carrier.service.title: Each Carrier may offer one and only one Responsible Airline
Carrier.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

Carrier.coupon.title: Each Carrier may have one or more Validating Carriers
Carrier.coupon.description: A portion of the Passenger Ticket and Baggage Check or Excess Baggage Ticket that indicates particular places between which the coupon is good for carriage.

Carrier.serviceDefinition.title: Each Carrier may defines one or more Owners
Carrier.serviceDefinition.description: A description and characteristics of a non-flight product or service that can be separately sold and delivered. E.g. bag, seat, meal on a flight.

Carrier.order.title: Each Carrier may have one or more Orders
Carrier.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

Carrier.datedMarketingSegment.title: Each Carrier may have one or more Carriers
Carrier.datedMarketingSegment.description: A commercial designation under which a Dated Operating Segment can be booked, either under the operating carrier's designator or that of another carrier (codeshare).

Carrier.ticketIssuanceInfo.title: Each Carrier must have one and only one Issuing Carrier
Carrier.ticketIssuanceInfo.description: An issuing carrier and issuing location of a ticket.

CarrierAircraftType.title: Carrier Aircraft Type
CarrierAircraftType.description: A Carrier defined internal grouping of aircrafts with the same form, function and specification.

carrierAircraftTypeCode.title: Carrier Aircraft Type.Carrier Aircraft Type Code
carrierAircraftTypeCode.description: Internal code used by an carrier to identify the type of aircraft.

CarrierFee.title: Carrier Fee
CarrierFee.description: A Carrier imposed fee detail, typically related to booking, ticketing, or servicing.

carrierFeeRbdCode.title: Carrier Fee.Carrier Fee RBD Code
carrierFeeRbdCode.description: Code used to identify a particular RBD. For example: P, J, W, M.

CarrierFee.typeCode.title: Carrier Fee.Type Code
CarrierFee.typeCode.description: Type of carrier fee related to booking, ticketing, or servicing as defined by PADIS 9750 (option).

CarrierFee.appCode.title: Carrier Fee.Application Code
CarrierFee.appCode.description: Code used to specify if the fee is non-interlineable, non-refundable, or non-commissionable.

Cash.title: Cash
Cash.description: A payment that is collected by the agent and settled between the Airline and the agent. Refer to IATA Resolution 728 Attachment A for full details.

collectionAddress.title: Each Cash must is collected at one and only one Postal Address
collectionAddress.description: A natural or physical address used for postal service. May be a building address, airport address, etc.

terminalIdentifier.title: Cash.Terminal Identifier
terminalIdentifier.description: Terminal ID where cash was collected. For example: QP776611.

CenterOfGravityLimit.title: Center Of Gravity Limit
CenterOfGravityLimit.description: An end point forward or aft of the range within which the center of gravity of an aircraft must lie for safe flight.

centerOfGravityLimitWeightTypeCode.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Center Of Gravity Limit Weight Type Code
centerOfGravityLimitWeightTypeCode.description: Type of weight to which the CG limit applies: Taxi (TA), Take Off (TO), Landing (LD), Zero Fuel (ZF), Inflight (IN).

CenterOfGravityLimit.weightMeasure.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Weight Measure
CenterOfGravityLimit.weightMeasure.description: Operating weight for which the CG limit applies.

CenterOfGravityLimit.aftIndexValue.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Aft Index Value
CenterOfGravityLimit.aftIndexValue.description: Aft CG limit expressed in index units.

CenterOfGravityLimit.aftMacPercent.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Aft MAC Percent
CenterOfGravityLimit.aftMacPercent.description: Aft CG limit expressed as a percentage of the mean aerodynamic chord (MAC).

CenterOfGravityLimit.forwardIndexValue.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Forward Index Value
CenterOfGravityLimit.forwardIndexValue.description: Forward CG limit expressed in index units.

CenterOfGravityLimit.forwardMacPercent.title: Center Of Gravity Limit.Forward MAC Percent
CenterOfGravityLimit.forwardMacPercent.description: Forward CG limit expressed as a percentage of the mean aerodynamic chord (MAC).

CenterOfGravityLimitTable.title: Center Of Gravity Limit Table
CenterOfGravityLimitTable.description: A Set of related Center of Gravity (CG) limits.

centerOfGravityLimit.title: Each Center Of Gravity Limit Table must contains at least one Center Of Gravity Limits
centerOfGravityLimit.description: An end point forward or aft of the range within which the center of gravity of an aircraft must lie for safe flight.

certifiedInd.title: Center Of Gravity Limit Table.Certified Indicator
certifiedInd.description: Indicates that the specified CG limits are those by which the aircraft has been certified (manufacturer's) or that they are operational limits, that have been curtailed in order to account for certain operational assumptions and associated CG calculation inaccuracies.

CenterOfGravityLimitTable.remark.title: Each Center Of Gravity Limit Table may supplies one or more Remarks
CenterOfGravityLimitTable.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

CenterOfGravityLimitTable.rangeFromValue.title: Center Of Gravity Limit Table.Range From Value
CenterOfGravityLimitTable.rangeFromValue.description: Minimum value of the range for which the specific table applies.

CenterOfGravityLimitTable.rangeToValue.title: Center Of Gravity Limit Table.Range To Value
CenterOfGravityLimitTable.rangeToValue.description: Maximum value of the range for which the specific table applies.

ChangeIndCode.title: Change Indicator_ Code
ChangeIndCode.description: The change indicator code of the bag movement

ChangeIndCodeEnum.title: Change Indicator Code
ChangeIndCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA RP 1745 Baggage Service Message Change Indicator Codes Valid Values: CHG - This is a change to bag movement (e.g. equivalent to BSMCHG); DEL - This is a delete of a bag movement (e.g. equivalent to BSMDEL); NEW - This is a newly created bag movement (equivalent to .V (NEW) BSM

ChangeReasonCode.title: Change Reason_ Code
ChangeReasonCode.description: Specifies the Change reason code list as defined by IATA SSIM. Code assigned by the airlines to be able to inform recipients of the main reason for an ad hoc schedule change and to simultaneously provide statistical information (e.g WEAT, TECH).

ChangeReasonCodeEnum.title: Change Reason Code
ChangeReasonCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Change Reason Code BDT. Valid Values: AIRS - Airspace restrictions; ARPT - Airfield restrictions; COMM - Commercial reasons, demand or lack of demand; CREW - Crew shortage; DAMA - Aircraft damage; EQUI - Equipment shortage; FUEL - Fuel shortage; HDLG - Ground handling; HOLI - Holiday; INDU - Industrial dispute; OPER - Operational reasons; PERF - Aircraft performance; POLI - Political situation; POSI - Aircraft positioning; REPO - Aircraft re-positioning; ROTA - Aircraft rotation; RTNS - Return to normal schedule or reinstatement of flight status prior to issuance of ASM(s) (withdrawal of ASM change); RUNW - Runway restrictions; TECH - Technical reasons, maintenance, etc.; WEAT - Weather conditions

ChangeRestrictions.title: Change Restrictions
ChangeRestrictions.description: A set of qualifying conditions/rules/restriction that are related to a constrained priced grouping of services for a Change/modification action. https://guides.developer.iata.org/docs/offer-and-order-conditions-and-restrictions

changeTypeCode.title: Change Restrictions.Change Type Code
changeTypeCode.description: Type of change that applies to the condition. For example: NAME, FLIGHT, SERVICE.

ChangeTypeCode.title: Change Type_ Code
ChangeTypeCode.description: This will have an associated ENUM which contains codes to represent the types of Changes that can be made to an offer.

ChangeTypeCodeEnum.title: Change Type Code
ChangeTypeCodeEnum.description: Contains list of types of changes allowed Name, Flight Services Valid Values: Flight - This identifies Flight detail changes. changes to the core flight details. departure and arrival points and airline.; Name - Name based changes. Changes to the passenger(s) names.; Service - This identifies Service non flight changes. seat preferences/food/baggage etc.

Check.title: Check
Check.description: A written order instructing a financial institution to pay immediately on demand a specified amount of money from the check writer's account to the person named on the check or, if a specific person is not named, to whoever bears the check to the institution for payment.

payeeName.title: Check.Payee Name
payeeName.description: Name of the payee or check recipient.

signedDate.title: Check.Signed Date
signedDate.description: Date that the check is signed.

CheckIn.title: Check-In
CheckIn.description: An action of registering and validating one's readiness to travel.

CheckInArea.title: Check-In Area
CheckInArea.description: A place provided where facilities exist enabling passengers and / or their luggage to be checked-in.

bagDropDevice.title: Each Check-In Area may include one or more Bag Drop Devices
bagDropDevice.description: A piece of equipment provided to allow checked-in luggage to be handed over to baggage handling. May be used as a self-service device or be used by a manned check-in desk.

checkInKiosk.title: Each Check-In Area may include one or more Check-In Kiosks
checkInKiosk.description: A self service piece of equipment provided to allow passengers and / or their luggage to be checked-in.

CheckInDesk.title: Check-In Desk
CheckInDesk.description: A counter in an airport at which a passenger may check in.

checkInDeskIdentifier.title: Check-In Desk.Check-In Desk Identifier
checkInDeskIdentifier.description: Identifier of the check-in (desk) infrastructure facility.

CheckInDesk.aircraftDep.title: Each Check-In Desk may be used by one or more Aircraft Departures
CheckInDesk.aircraftDep.description: A preparation of an aircraft for departure including acquiring baggage, checking in passengers, loading baggage and cargo onto the aircraft and preparing the aircraft up to when it is ready to depart the stand to begin the leg.

CheckInDeskIdentifier.title: Check-In Desk_ Identifier
CheckInDeskIdentifier.description: The check-in desk identifier of the infrastructure facility

CheckInKiosk.title: Check-In Kiosk
CheckInKiosk.description: A self service piece of equipment provided to allow passengers and / or their luggage to be checked-in.

City.title: City
City.description: A City, town, or postal station (i.e. a postal service territory, often used in a military address, or metropolitan area).

City.name.title: City.Name
City.name.description: Name, expressed as text, of the city, town or village.

ClassOfServiceTypeCode.title: Class Of Service Type_ Code
ClassOfServiceTypeCode.description: This is the class of service used in the context of boarding a plan. It is not to be confused with the fare basis code or the cabin type code

ClassOfServiceTypeCodeEnum.title: Class Of Service Type Code
ClassOfServiceTypeCodeEnum.description: This is a single character token as defined in Resolution 728 CODE DESIGNATORS FOR PASSENGER TICKET

Clearance.title: Clearance
Clearance.description: A transfer of funds from one party (the payer) to another party (the payee) to fulfill a commitment between the two parties under a contractual obligation.

airlineRefIdentifier.title: Clearance.Airline Reference Identifier
airlineRefIdentifier.description: identifier provided by the carrier to support internal financial processes, for example reconciliation.

clearanceIdentifier.title: Clearance.Clearance Identifier
clearanceIdentifier.description: Identifier generated by the party requesting the clearance that uniquely identifies the clearance transaction. It provides the necessary link for financial audit connecting the sale to the financial records. This field is required because no other existing data elements could be used by the financial systems or could provide unique identification. The identifier is globally unique for the settlement by design.

clearancePayeeReconciliationIdentifier.title: Clearance.Clearance Payee Reconciliation Identifier
clearancePayeeReconciliationIdentifier.description: identifier provided by the Clearance Payee to support internal financial processes, for example reconciliation. If this identifier is included in the clearance request then it must be included in all messages thereafter where it is provided as an option.

clearancePayerReconciliationIdentifier.title: Clearance.Clearance Payer Reconciliation Identifier
clearancePayerReconciliationIdentifier.description: identifier provided by the Clearance Payer to support internal financial processes, for example reconciliation. If this identifier is included in the clearance request then it must be included in all messages thereafter where it is provided as an option.

clearingProcess.title: Each Clearance must be related to one and only one Clearing Process
clearingProcess.description: A freeing from debt, i.e. turning the promise of payment (for example, in the form of electronic clearance request) into the actual movement of money from one account to another.

failureReasonCode.title: Clearance.Failure Reason Code
failureReasonCode.description: Describe the reason why a request for clearance cannot be performed and effectively the clearance is rejected or the requested action, such as cancelling the clearance, failed.

nonSettledAmount.title: Clearance.Non Settled Amount
nonSettledAmount.description: amount of the Net Clearance Amount in the individual clearance that remains to be cleared. The amount in the NonSettledAmount is defined by the value in the data element StatusCode. When the value of the StatusCode is Write off (WRTOF) then the value in the data element NonSettledAmount is the value that is being written off. For all other values of the data element StatusCode the value of the data element NonSettledAmount represents what is the remaining amount to be cleared. NonSettledAmount must be included in all messages where it is provided as an option when its value is neither 0 (zero) nor equal to NetClearanceAmount

payee.title: Payee

processRuleCode.title: Clearance.Process Rule Code

settlementDate.title: Clearance.Settlement Date

Clearance.statusCode.title: Clearance.Status Code

Clearance.remainingAmount.title: Clearance.Remaining Amount

ClearanceProcessRuleCode.title: Clearance Process Rule_ Code

ClearanceStatusCode.title: Clearance Status_ Code
ClearanceStatusCode.description: Clearance Status code is a character string of letters and numbers.

ClearanceStatusCodeEnum.title: Clearance Status Code
ClearanceStatusCodeEnum.description: The Clearance can have one of the following statuses: - 1-Partially Settled '1PSTL' - Accepted 'ACCPT' - Claw Back 'CLBCK' - Fully Settled 'FLSTL' - Final Settlement 'FNSTL' - N-Partially Settled 'NPSTL' - Write off 'WRTOF' - Rejected 'RJCTD' Valid Values: 1PSTL - - 1-Partially Settled '1PSTL'; ACCPT - - Accepted 'ACCPT'; CLBCK - - Claw Back 'CLBCK'; FLSTL - - Fully Settled 'FLSTL'; FNSTL - - Final Settlement 'FNSTL'; NPSTL - - N-Partially Settled 'NPSTL'; RJCTD - - Rejected 'RJCTD'; WRTOF - - Write off 'WRTOF'

ClearingIdentifier.title: Clearing_ Identifier

clearingIdentifier.title: Clearing Process.Clearing Identifier

Valid Values: LBA - Left Behind, authorized to load (bag verified not loaded, e.g. scanned post flight); LBN - Left Behind, not authorized for loading; LOD - Loaded, bag is authorised to load and loaded successfully.; NAL - Loaded, but bag is not authorized for loading.; NOF - Normal Offload, bag has been offloaded from inbound aircraft or ULD. Curtailment.title: Curtailment
Curtailment.description: A limitation to certified (manufacturer's) CG limits in order to account for certain operational assumptions and associated CG calculation inaccuracies.

curtailmentWeightTypeCode.title: Curtailment.Curtailment Weight Type Code
curtailmentWeightTypeCode.description: Type of weight of CG limits to which the curtailment must be applied: Taxi (TA), Take Off (TO), Landing (LD) , Zero Fuel (ZF), In-flight (IN).

sumOfSquareInd.title: Curtailment.Sum Of Square Indicator
sumOfSquareInd.description: Indicates that curtailment value is to be applied to the CG as a total value (false) or as a component of the quadratic sum (true).

curtailment.title: Each Curtailment Table must contains at least one Curtailments
curtailment.description: A limitation to certified (manufacturer's) CG limits in order to account for certain operational assumptions and associated CG calculation inaccuracies.

Date.title: Date
Date.description: A date is a Gregorian calendar representation in various common resolutions: year, month, week, day.

DatedMarketingSegment.title: Dated Marketing Segment
DatedMarketingSegment.description: A commercial designation under which a Dated Operating Segment can be booked, either under the operating carrier's designator or that of another carrier (codeshare).

datedMarketingSegmentIdentifier.title: Dated Marketing Segment.Dated Marketing Segment Identifier
datedMarketingSegmentIdentifier.description: Identifier of a Dated Marketing Segment.

dateVariationNumber.title: Dated Marketing Segment.Date Variation Number
dateVariationNumber.description: Relationship between days/period of operation of the flight origin station and the schedule time of the aircraft departure/arrival, For example: '-1' for previous day, '1' for next day.

funnelFlightInd.title: Dated Marketing Segment.Funnel Flight Indicator
funnelFlightInd.description: Use of a single flight number for an itinerary that actually involves an online connection with two separate flight numbers, with the presumed intent to make the itinerary appear to be a direct flight with a change of aircraft as opposed to a connection.

inventoryQualifiers.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment may supplies one or more Inventory Qualifierss
inventoryQualifiers.description: A Identification for a number of inventory seats and their status.

journeyData.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment may have one and only one Journey Data
journeyData.description: An Active air segments that exist in the current agent work area. It is comprised of the existing air segment information including confirmed, pending and waitlisted segments, dated OPEN segments, and passive segments in the agent's work area, e.g. AAA, Booking File, or PNR. All air segments will be sent.

marketingCarrierFlightNumberText.title: Dated Marketing Segment.Marketing Carrier Flight Number Text
marketingCarrierFlightNumberText.description: Numerical designation of a flight as it is marketed by a carrier.

stopsNumber.title: Dated Marketing Segment.Stops Number
stopsNumber.description: Number of times the aircraft lands and departs under a single flight number between origin and destination.

DatedMarketingSegment.carrier.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment must is marketed by one and only one Carrier
DatedMarketingSegment.carrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

DatedMarketingSegment.originDest.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment may have one and only one Origin Destination
DatedMarketingSegment.originDest.description: An Origin and Destination airport/city pair which confines a passenger journey or an aircraft flight.

DatedMarketingSegmentRbd.title: Dated Marketing Segment RBD
DatedMarketingSegmentRbd.description: An information for a given Dated Marketing Segment Reservation Booking Designator - RBD.

DateTime.title: Date Time
DateTime.description: A date time identifies a date and time of day to various common resolutions: year, month, week, day, hour, minute, second, and fraction of second.

Deck.title: Deck
Deck.description: A structural floor level. For aircraft having one structural level only, this floor level shall be referred to as the main deck. For aircraft having more than one structural floor level, the different floor levels shall be referred to as 'lower deck', 'main deck' and 'upper deck', starting from bottom to top.

Deck.remark.title: Each Deck may supplies one or more Remarks
Deck.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

Deck.hold.title: Each Deck may contain one or more Holds
Deck.hold.description: A space in an aircraft confined by ceiling, floor, walls and bulkhead, used for carrying load.

Deck.maximumWeightMeasure.title: Deck.Maximum Weight Measure
Deck.maximumWeightMeasure.description: Maximum total weight permitted on the deck.

DeckCodeEnum.title: Deck Code
DeckCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Deck Code BDT. Valid Values: Lower - Lower Deck; Main - Main Deck; Upper - Upper Deck

DeliveryProvider.title: Delivery Provider
DeliveryProvider.description: An entity responsible for delivery of a good or Service. ---------- An organization responsible for delivery of a good or Service.

deliveryProviderIdentifier.title: Delivery Provider.Delivery Provider Identifier
deliveryProviderIdentifier.description: Identifier for a delivery provider agreed with the airline.

Desc.title: Description
Desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

categorizationText.title: Description.Categorization Text
categorizationText.description: This will contain at present an undefined list of informational types. For example: passport and visa information, Airport information, Airline information, General travel.

markupStyleText.title: Description.Markup Style Text
markupStyleText.description: Mark-up Style of the Description Text. For example: HTML.

mediaObject.title: Each Description may have one and only one Media Object
mediaObject.description: An Electronic documents, images, and other files which accompany and support some information.

Desc.term.title: Each Description must describes one and only one Term
Desc.term.description: A condition under which an agreement is reached.

Desc.keyValueProperty.title: Each Description must be associated with one and only one Key Value Property
Desc.keyValueProperty.description: A contextual information to further describe something using a key-value pair.

DestArrivalCriteria.title: Destination Arrival Criteria
DestArrivalCriteria.description: A Customer's requested Destination arrival time and location for an Origin and Destination shopping request.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: A device upon which the secure transaction will occur.

browserAcceptHeaderText.title: Device.Browser Accept Header Text
browserAcceptHeaderText.description: Browser Accept Header. Note: This contains MIME types accepted by the device.

browserUserAgentHeaderText.title: Device.Browser User Agent Header Text
browserUserAgentHeaderText.description: User Agent String. Note: This contains the user agent string.

deviceCode.title: Device.Device Code
deviceCode.description: Device code from which the request was initiated. See PADIS codeset TDT Touchpoint device type.

presenceTypeCode.title: Device.Presence Type Code
presenceTypeCode.description: Specifies the Presence of a customer and its payment card.

touchPointTrxCode.title: Device.Touch Point Transaction Code
touchPointTrxCode.description: Travel event that triggered the request. For example: Order / buy, Check-In, In Flight. PADIS codeset TTT.

Device.name.title: Device.Name
Device.name.description: Named Device ID. For example: Johns IPAD.

Device.pos.title: Each Device must have one and only one POS
Device.pos.description: An information identifying the location and other attributes of the entity performing transactions. Point of sale may be considered by some systems when making inventory and availability decisions.

DeviceLocation.title: Device Location
DeviceLocation.description: A geographical location of a device of interaction. For example: of a computer, mobile phone, or Agent Terminal.

DeviceLocation.country.title: Each Device Location may be located within one and only one Country
DeviceLocation.country.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

DeviceLocation.city.title: Each Device Location may be located within one and only one City
DeviceLocation.city.description: A City, town, or postal station (i.e. a postal service territory, often used in a military address, or metropolitan area).

DimensionAllowance.title: Dimension Allowance
DimensionAllowance.description: A Baggage dimension allowance with application information.

baggageDimensionCategoryText.title: Dimension Allowance.Baggage Dimension Category Text
baggageDimensionCategoryText.description: Baggage dimensions category. For example: Length, Height, Width, Total Linear.

maxMeasure.title: Dimension Allowance.Max Measure
maxMeasure.description: Maximum dimensions value. For example: 62. Notes: Linear measurement = length + width + height

minMeasure.title: Dimension Allowance.Min Measure
minMeasure.description: Minimum dimensions value. For example: 62. Notes: Linear measurement = length + width + height

DimensionAllowance.qty.title: Dimension Allowance.Quantity
DimensionAllowance.qty.description: Quantity of pieces allowed with these measurements.

DirectBill.title: Direct Bill
DirectBill.description: A system in which a corporation's travel agency bills employees for their business travel. The employee must then submit an expense accounting and be reimbursed by the corporation.

DirectBill.orgName.title: Direct Bill.Organization Name
DirectBill.orgName.description: Company name of the corporation to whom remittance should be directed. For example: IBM.

Disclosure.title: Disclosure
Disclosure.description: A set of Information which should be made known.

disclosureIdentifier.title: Disclosure.Disclosure Identifier
disclosureIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies a disclosure within the context of one message.

Discount.title: Discount
Discount.description: A deduction from the price amount, made in advance of its payment.

discountContext.title: Each Discount may supplies one or more Key Value Properties
discountContext.description: A contextual information to further describe something using a key-value pair.

preDiscountedAmount.title: Discount.Pre Discounted Amount
preDiscountedAmount.description: Original price on which the discount was applied to.

DistributionChain.title: Distribution Chain
DistributionChain.description: An instance of a distribution channel, which is a chain of intermediaries through which a good or service passes until it reaches the final buyer or the end consumer.

DistributionChainLink.title: Distribution Chain Link
DistributionChainLink.description: An organization playing a participating role in an instance of a distribution channel.

distributionChain.title: Each Distribution Chain Link must be part of one and only one Distribution Chain
distributionChain.description: An instance of a distribution channel, which is a chain of intermediaries through which a good or service passes until it reaches the final buyer or the end consumer.

ordinal.title: Distribution Chain Link.Ordinal
ordinal.description: Number defining the position of the distribution chain link in the distribution chain indicating the order in which the organization participated.

orgRoleCode.title: Distribution Chain Link.Organization Role Code
orgRoleCode.description: Distribution chain role performed by the participating organization. That is, the Seller (end buyer facing), the Distributor (an intermediary), or the Carrier (the Responsible Supplier). For clarity this is different to the business model used by the participating organization, and the Nature of Business typically registered during incorporation as one of the organization's business activities.

participatingOrg.title: Each Distribution Chain Link must be performed by one and only one Organization
participatingOrg.description: An organized structure set up for a particular purpose, such as a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution. Business Identifier Fields: - Organization Identifier

verifiablePresentation.title: Distribution Chain Link.Verifiable Presentation
verifiablePresentation.description: Root node of the IATA Verifiable Presentation schema structure based on w3c Verifiable Credential Schema.

DistributionChainLink.contactInfo.title: Each Distribution Chain Link may be contacted via one and only one Contact Information
DistributionChainLink.contactInfo.description: An electronic or geographic address which a party has provided as the contact channel. For example, contact email, contact postal address, contact phone number.

DistributionChainRoleCode.title: Distribution Chain Role_ Code
DistributionChainRoleCode.description: The list of allowable roles in a distribution chain.

DistributionChainRoleCodeEnum.title: Distribution Chain Role Code
DistributionChainRoleCodeEnum.description: The list of allowable roles in a distribution chain. Valid Values: Carrier - An organization which carries the passenger, baggage, or goods, and/or commits to delivering the carriage.; Distributor - An organization that provides a distribution capability such as a certain type of Consolidator, an Aggregator, more generally an intermediary.; Seller - An organization that offers a shopping capability to a shopper.

Door.title: Door
Door.description: A swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle.

doorIdentifier.title: Door.Door Identifier
doorIdentifier.description: Identifies a door within a hold. For example: Door 1, Door 2, Door 1L, Door 2R.

Door.heightMeasure.title: Door.Height Measure
Door.heightMeasure.description: Linear dimension of the height of the door.

DoorPositionCodeEnum.title: Door Position Code
DoorPositionCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Door Position Code BDT. Valid Values: C - Center of aircraft; L - Left side of aircraft; R - Right side of aircraft

DowConfiguration.title: DOW Configuration
DowConfiguration.description: An Identification of operational items such as crew, pantry, potable water and/or service weight adjustments and their weight and/or index influence that are included in the Dry Operating Weight of an aircraft or aircraft group.

dowConfigurationCode.title: DOW Configuration.DOW Configuration Code
dowConfigurationCode.description: Name/identifier of the Dry Operating Weight Configuration. For example: 'All UK Services', 'B'. 'Flight Range 1'.

DowItem.title: DOW Item
DowItem.description: An Item that can be considered as part of the Dry Operating Weight buildup of an aircraft or aircraft group as per company specifications e.g. Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Containers, Pallets, Potable Water, Library, ... Other items are included in the total traffic load weight.

dowItemCode.title: DOW Item.DOW Item Code
dowItemCode.description: Dry Operating Weight Item code. For example: Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Potable water. Based on PADIS Code List.

DowItemCode.title: DOW Item_ Code
DowItemCode.description: Specifies Dry Operating Weight Item codes (Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Potable water...) based on PADIS Code List.

DowItemCodeEnum.title: DOW Item Code
DowItemCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for Dry Operating Weight Item codes (Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Potable water...).

DryOperatingAircraft.title: Dry Operating Aircraft
DryOperatingAircraft.description: An Aircraft configured according to a given Dry Operating Weight configuration.

adjustmentInd.title: Dry Operating Aircraft.Adjustment Indicator
adjustmentInd.description: Indicates that weight and center of gravity data are expressed as adjustments to be applied to the corresponding fleet data or as individual aircraft data.

DryOperatingAircraft.weightMeasure.title: Dry Operating Aircraft.Weight Measure
DryOperatingAircraft.weightMeasure.description: Basic Weight or Dry Operating Weight of the specific aircraft.

DryOperatingAircraft.indexValue.title: Dry Operating Aircraft.Index Value
DryOperatingAircraft.indexValue.description: Basic index or Dry Operating Index of the specific aircraft.

Duration.title: Duration
Duration.description: A duration is the specification of a length of time without a fixed start or end time, expressed in Gregorian calendar time units (Year, Month, Week, or Day) and Hours, Minutes or Seconds

EmailAddress.title: Email Address
EmailAddress.description: An email address which should be used for contact purposes.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: An individual contracted by an organization or another individual for their labor in exchange for a package of remuneration.

numberIdentifier.title: Employee.Number Identifier
numberIdentifier.description: Unique identifier attributed to the employee by the employer.

Employer.title: Employer
Employer.description: A person or organization that employs individuals to perform activities on behalf of the employer in return for remuneration.

EmploymentContract.title: Employment Contract
EmploymentContract.description: A written agreement between an employer and an employee, that, taken together with the rights of each under statute and common law, determines the employment relations between them governing their behavior and providing legally enforceable obligations.

employer.title: Each Employment Contract must be raised by one and only one Employer
employer.description: A person or organization that employs individuals to perform activities on behalf of the employer in return for remuneration.

EWallet.title: E-Wallet
EWallet.description: A payment that is facilitated through virtual wallet, where the paying party has deposited funds and the payee is receiving the payment from the wallet rather than the party committing to the payment.

authorizationIdentifier.title: E-Wallet.Authorization Identifier
authorizationIdentifier.description: Authorization string provided by a third party that is not a party to the Agreement or the Payment Commitment of the Agreement, confirming that the committed funds have been secured or will be secured from the payer.

ExceptionCode.title: Exception_ Code
ExceptionCode.description: The code of the exception control

ExceptionCodeEnum.title: Exception Code
ExceptionCodeEnum.description: Enumeration of IATA RP 1745 Attachment A bag exception codes. Valid Values: AVIH - Animal in hold; BIKE - Bicycle; BULK - Bulky baggage; COUR - Commercial courier; CPY - A copy tag is required or has been done for this baggage; CPYA - A copy tag is authorized for this baggage; CPYD - A copy tag will be performed by the DCS; CPYN - A copy tag is not authorized for this baggage; CREW - Crew member's baggage; CUST - Bag (to be) inspected by customs; DAA - Bag to be delivered at aircraft; DGR - Dangerous goods in checked baggage; DPBP - Digital pre-tag; DPLI - Diplomatic courier; DUPE - Duplicate tag number for the same flight; EBT - Electronic Baggage Tag; FRAG - Fragile baggage; GRND - Requires ground transportation connection; GRP - GRP; HAJJ - Baggage of pilgrims to Mecca; HPBT - Home Printed Baggage Tag; HTLV - Hotel Voucher issued; HVY - Heavy Baggage Indicator; IROP - Irregular operation indicator; JUMP - Passenger on Jump Seat, explains missing seat no. in .S element; LRFI - Limited Release, Fragile or inadequate packing; LRLC - Limited Release, Late Check-in; LRLL - Limited Release, Lack of Name Label; LRNA - Limited Release, Not admissible in Cabin; LRPE - Limited Release, Perishable; LRRD - Limited Release, Received Damaged; LRSZ - Limited Release, Size; MIS - Mishandled baggage; PACK - Indicates that a baggage was rejected from transport due to inadequate packaging.; PBHA - Problem Baggage Handling Area; PRIO - Priority Baggage; RELD - Reload Baggage Indicator; RRTE - Re-routed baggage (Passenger and baggage itinerary changed - baggage tag not reissued and not updated); RUSH - Unaccompanied (expedited) baggage as specified in Resolution 740, Attachments 'K' and 'L'; SCON - Short Connection; SECU - Airport Handling Location Classified as 'secured'; SHOP - Item bought at the airport that cannot be accepted as carry-on baggage; SPEQ - Sports equipment; SPEV - Special Events; STCK - Instruction to update the routing information on the baggage tag; TGRQ - Tag printing request; TOUR - Baggage for a specified tour; UNAC - Unaccompanied baggage in case of involuntary re-routing; UNAR - Unaccompanied baggage, all requirements for travel met; USEC - Airport Handling Location Classified as 'unsecured'; VFDB - VFDB; VIP - Very Important Person (PRIORITY); VOL - VOL; WCHR - Wheelchair - To specify only that a wheelchair has been checked through and does not replace normal SSR notification requirements for passenger handling.; WEAP - Weapons, Firearms or Ammunition booked and carried as Checked Baggage; WGHT - Baggage rejected from transport due to insufficient available weight on the aircraft; XBAG - Excess baggage

ExcessBaggage.title: Excess Baggage
ExcessBaggage.description: An Excess baggage information displayed on a coupon.

measure.title: Excess Baggage.Measure
measure.description: Excess baggage measure and associated Unit of Measurement. For example: 10 kg.

ExcessBaggage.amount.title: Excess Baggage.Amount
ExcessBaggage.amount.description: Excess baggage amount. For example: 100 USD.

ExistingOrderCriteria.title: Existing Order Criteria
ExistingOrderCriteria.description: A References to Orders that were created from Offers that have already been purchased, booked and/or are being held for a Passenger.

FailureReasonCode.title: Failure Reason_ Code
FailureReasonCode.description: Character string of letters and numbers to describe the reason why a request cannot be performed or an action failed.

FareCalculationInfo.title: Fare Calculation Information
FareCalculationInfo.description: An Information related to the calculation of the Fare amount by applying various rules to determine a final fare for an airline ticket.

addlInfoText.title: Fare Calculation Information.Additional Information Text
addlInfoText.description: Fare calculation text required in the fare calculation area of an electronic ticket.

pricingCodeText.title: Fare Calculation Information.Pricing Code Text
pricingCodeText.description: Primary identifier reflecting the method of pricing for a transaction.

FareComponent.title: Fare Component
FareComponent.description: A portion of an itinerary between two consecutive fare construction points. If the journey has only one fare component, the points of origin and destination are the only fare construction points

fareBasisAppCode.title: Fare Component.Fare Basis Application Code
fareBasisAppCode.description: Indicates how the fare basis was applied. For example: Requested, Ticketed, Other.

fareBasisCityPairText.title: Fare Component.Fare Basis City Pair Text
fareBasisCityPairText.description: Identified published fare. Origin and destination city codes and two character designator of fare owning airline associated with Fare Basis Code. For example: MIANCEDL

negotiatedCode.title: Fare Component.Negotiated Code
negotiatedCode.description: Identifies the Negotiated code/fare qualifier. PADIS codeset 9910

ticketDesigCode.title: Fare Component.Ticket Designator Code
ticketDesigCode.description: Fare Basis Code Designator shall be placed within this element and removed from the Fare Basis Code element. For example, if the Airline has a fare basis code with a designator like 'JFBC/WO'. The Fare basis Code element should contain 'JFBC' and this element should contain'WO'.

FareCriteria.title: Fare Criteria
FareCriteria.description: A set of Fare criteria used to filter shopping results.

noAdvancePurchaseInd.title: Fare Criteria.No Advance Purchase Indicator
noAdvancePurchaseInd.description: When true, do not return fares with advance purchase restrictions.

noMaxStayInd.title: Fare Criteria.No Max Stay Indicator
noMaxStayInd.description: When true, do not return fares with maximum stay restrictions.

noMinStayInd.title: Fare Criteria.No Min Stay Indicator
noMinStayInd.description: When true, do not return fares with minimum stay restrictions.

noPenaltyInd.title: Fare Criteria.No Penalty Indicator
noPenaltyInd.description: When true, do not return fares with penalties.

FareDetail.title: Fare Detail
FareDetail.description: An amount charged by the carrier for the carriage of a passenger and his allowable free baggage.

fareCalculationInfo.title: Each Fare Detail may have one and only one Fare Calculation Information
fareCalculationInfo.description: An Information related to the calculation of the Fare amount by applying various rules to determine a final fare for an airline ticket.

fareIndCode.title: Fare Detail.Fare Indicator Code
fareIndCode.description: Fare indicator code. For example: 1 (SYSTEM PRICED WITHOUT MANUAL INTERVENTION). Encoding Scheme: IATA PADIS Code List for data element 5387 - Price Type Qualifier.

fareWaiver.title: Each Fare Detail may have between zero and five Fare Waivers
fareWaiver.description: A Validating carrier-assigned fare rule modification or override information.

filedFareInd.title: Fare Detail.Filed Fare Indicator
filedFareInd.description: When TRUE, a component of this fare has been priced using filed fare data. If FALSE, dynamic pricing has been applied.

netReportingCodeText.title: Fare Detail.Net Reporting Code Text
netReportingCodeText.description: Code indicating if the transaction is subject to a net reporting arrangement.

pricingSystemCodeText.title: Fare Detail.Pricing System Code Text
pricingSystemCodeText.description: IATA assigned code identifying the system used to price the itinerary for the document being issued.

statisticalCodeText.title: Fare Detail.Statistical Code Text
statisticalCodeText.description: Code used for domestic or international sales differentiation.

FareDetail.accountCode.title: Fare Detail.Account Code
FareDetail.accountCode.description: Corporate ID used for pricing special fares. For example: 675124.

FarePriceType.title: Fare Price Type
FarePriceType.description: A type of fair price applied to a Fare Detail (e.g. filed amount, net amount, or a sell amount).

farePriceTypeCode.title: Fare Price Type.Fare Price Type Code
farePriceTypeCode.description: Indicates if the fare price provided is a filed amount, net amount, or a sell amount.

FareRule.title: Fare Rule
FareRule.description: A Special purchasing rules and restrictions used to differentiate fare levels from one another.

instantPurchaseTypeCode.title: Fare Rule.Instant Purchase Type Code
instantPurchaseTypeCode.description: Instant purchase type code. For example: CC (Ticketless purchase immediately charged to credit card), NO (Not an instant purchase), TT (Simultaneous with time of ticketing). Encoding scheme: IATA PADIS Codeset IPT - Instant Purchase Type.

ruleCode.title: Fare Rule.Rule Code
ruleCode.description: Fare category number as defined by ATPCO.

FareWaiver.title: Fare Waiver
FareWaiver.description: A Validating carrier-assigned fare rule modification or override information.

fareRuleWaiverCode.title: Fare Waiver.Fare Rule Waiver Code
fareRuleWaiverCode.description: Code assigned by the validating carrier that allows fare rule modification or override.

FareWaiver.typeCode.title: Fare Waiver.Type Code
FareWaiver.typeCode.description: Waiver type code. For example: ExchangeReissued, FareComponent.

Fee.title: Fee
Fee.description: An amount added on to a charge for a specific product, purpose, or service.

desigText.title: Fee.Designator Text
desigText.description: Fee designator code. For example: USC.

FieldMetadata.title: Field Metadata
FieldMetadata.description: A set of defining implementation specific fields which should be populated.

FieldMetadata.mandatoryInd.title: Field Metadata.Mandatory Indicator
FieldMetadata.mandatoryInd.description: When TRUE, indicates the associated field is expected to be populated.

FieldMetadata.pathText.title: Field Metadata.Path Text
FieldMetadata.pathText.description: Message property location using XPATH syntax.

FiledFee.title: Filed Fee
FiledFee.description: A Filed fee information relating to a coupon, including the Bankers Seller Rate used to convert the filed amount into the currency of payment.

bankersSellerRate.title: Filed Fee.Bankers Seller Rate
bankersSellerRate.description: BSR or BBR used to convert the filed fee amount from the filed currency into the currency of payment.

feeAmount.title: Filed Fee.Fee Amount
feeAmount.description: File fee amount. For example: 100 USD.

Flight.title: Flight
Flight.description: A sequence of flight legs designed to meet the demands of the flight services operating under the same operational flight number, making efficient use of available aircraft for the repositioning of aircraft, and ensuring conformance with the use of flight numbers as defined by regulations.

arrivalAiport.title: Each Inbound Flight must finish at one and only one Inbound Flight
arrivalAiport.description: A facility where air transportation originates, stops and / or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off and/or maintenance, re-stocking or re-fueling takes place.

operatingAirline.title: Each Flight must be operated by one and only one Airline
operatingAirline.description: An organization operating aircraft for commercial purposes which offers air transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by the civil aviation authority of the state in which it is established. Note that the unique identifier of an Airline is a composite of the Airline Designator Code and its Name. It is common only to use Airline Designator Code when the duplicate coded airlines operate in different air spaces.

originDepDate.title: Flight.Origin Departure Date
originDepDate.description: Date in UTC of the departure from the station of origin.

FlightCharacteristicsCode.title: Flight Characteristics_ Code
FlightCharacteristicsCode.description: Business data type for Flight Characteristics Code.

FlightCharacteristicsCodeEnum.title: Flight Characteristics Code
FlightCharacteristicsCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the flight characteristics code BDT. Valid Values: AirportChange - Airport Change; Direct - Direct; NonStop - NonStop; OvernightStop - OvernightStop; RedEye - RedEye; WaitList - WaitList

FlightCharacteristicsCriteria.title: Flight Characteristics Criteria
FlightCharacteristicsCriteria.description: A set of Flight characteristics filter criteria for shopping requests, including non-stop, red eye, etc.

FlightCharacteristicsCriteria.characteri.title: Flight Characteristics Criteria.Characteristic Code
FlightCharacteristicsCriteria.characteri.description: Code to identify the type of flight characteristic. For example: non-stop, red eye.

FlightCriteria.title: Flight Criteria
FlightCriteria.description: A set of Flight filter criteria including aircraft features, Cabin Type, RBD, and Tail Number.

waitListCriteria.title: Each Flight Criteria may supply one and only one Preference Level
waitListCriteria.description: An Information supporting some shopping filter criteria, including preference level code (e.g. Preferred, Exclude, etc.).

FlightDeckCrewDistributionElement.title: Flight Deck Crew Distribution Element
FlightDeckCrewDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a crew distribution related to flight deck crew.

FlightDeckCrewLocation.title: Flight Deck Crew Location
FlightDeckCrewLocation.description: A Seat location for flight deck crew.

flightDeckCrewLocationIdentifier.title: Flight Deck Crew Location.Flight Deck Crew Location Identifier
flightDeckCrewLocationIdentifier.description: Identifies a flight deck crew location. For example: Captain, FO, Observer.

FlightDeckCrewLocationIdentifier.title: Flight Deck Crew Location_ Identifier
FlightDeckCrewLocationIdentifier.description: Specifies a Flight Deck Crew Location identifier.

FlightHaulCode.title: Flight Haul_ Code
FlightHaulCode.description: Business data type for Flight Haul Code as per PADIS Codeset.

FlightHaulTypeCodeEnum.title: Flight Haul Type Code
FlightHaulTypeCodeEnum.description: Codeset information for Flight Haul Type Code.

FlightLeg.title: Flight Leg
FlightLeg.description: An operation of an aircraft from off-blocks at the departure airport to on-blocks at the subsequent arrival airport.

arrival.title: Each Flight Leg may terminate with one and only one Aircraft Arrival
arrival.description: A handling of the arrival of an aircraft from passenger disembarkation, baggage unloading and reuniting passengers with their luggage.

arrivalAirport.title: Each Flight Leg must Inbound Leg one and only one Airport
arrivalAirport.description: A facility where air transportation originates, stops and / or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off and/or maintenance, re-stocking or re-fueling takes place.

arrivalDateTime.title: Flight Leg.Arrival Date Time
arrivalDateTime.description: Actual date and time of arrival of the aircraft.

assignedAircraft.title: Assigned Aircraft
assignedAircraft.description: A flight leg may either be assigned an IATA aircraft type or a specific aircraft.

dep.title: Each Flight Leg may begin with one and only one Aircraft Departure
dep.description: A preparation of an aircraft for departure including acquiring baggage, checking in passengers, loading baggage and cargo onto the aircraft and preparing the aircraft up to when it is ready to depart the stand to begin the leg.

depDateTime.title: Flight Leg.Departure Date Time
depDateTime.description: Actual date and time of departure of the aircraft.

inboundLegStop.title: Each Inbound leg may be followed by one and only one Inbound leg
inboundLegStop.description: A stop made by a vehicle such as an aircraft, train or bus on the way to the final destination.

operationalLeg.title: Each Flight Leg may be fuflfilled by one and only one Transport Service Leg
operationalLeg.description: If a technical stop for re-fueling is needed then there will be two flight Legs required to fulfill one transport service leg. Also, if a single flight under abnormal conditions, recognized before departure, cannot go directly to its destination an additional leg may be required.

outboundLegStop.title: Each Outbound Leg Stop may follow one and only one Outbound Leg
outboundLegStop.description: A stop made by a vehicle such as an aircraft, train or bus on the way to the final destination.

FlightLeg.flight.title: Each Flight Leg must be part of one and only one Flight
FlightLeg.flight.description: A sequence of flight legs designed to meet the demands of the flight services operating under the same operational flight number, making efficient use of available aircraft for the repositioning of aircraft, and ensuring conformance with the use of flight numbers as defined by regulations.

FlightLeg.distanceMeasure.title: Flight Leg.Distance Measure
FlightLeg.distanceMeasure.description: Total distance between the beginning and end stations of a leg, measured by the great circle of the earth.

FlightLegStatusCode.title: Flight Leg Status_ Code
FlightLegStatusCode.description: The states of a flight leg.

FlightLegStatusCodeEnum.title: Flight Leg Status Code
FlightLegStatusCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes that are operationally significant. This provides the current operational status of a flight leg. Supported codesets: 1245, 2005 and 9750 Possible statuses: Aborted, Canceled, Completed, Diverted, Planned, Re-routed, Underway

FlightNumberText.title: Flight Number_ Text
FlightNumberText.description: Identifies a flight number. 1 to 4 digits. May or may not have leading zeros when less than 4 digits. The use of leading zeros does not create a different Flight Number. For example, Flight Numbers 123 and 0123 are the same.

FlightStatusCode.title: Flight Status_ Code
FlightStatusCode.description: Contains the valid statuses for a Flight.

FlightStatusCodeEnum.title: Flight Status Code
FlightStatusCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes if there is no processing required on the information, i.e. it is for use only for staff or public display. List of Supported codesets are defined in these category: 2005 and 9750 Possible statuses: Flight Diverted, Scheduled, Landed, Re-route, Canceled, Boarding, Departed

FloorLoadLimitation.title: Floor Load Limitation
FloorLoadLimitation.description: A Maximum load acceptable on any m2 (ft2) of an aircraft floor.

limitWeightPerAreaMeasure.title: Floor Load Limitation.Limit Weight Per Area Measure
limitWeightPerAreaMeasure.description: Maximum load permitted per unit of area.

FloorLoadLimitation.areaUnitCode.title: Floor Load Limitation.Area Unit Code
FloorLoadLimitation.areaUnitCode.description: Area unit used for area density calculation. When missing the standard aircraft area unit is used.

FloorLoadLimitationTable.title: Floor Load Limitation Table
FloorLoadLimitationTable.description: A Set of related floor load limitations.

Foid.title: FOID
Foid.description: A Form of identification. Typically used to identify that the passenger is who he says he is. This is the type of FOID as defined in AIRIMP (FF Number, Credit Card Number, etc.).

foidIdentifier.title: FOID.FOID Identifier
foidIdentifier.description: FOID ID value. For example: NY122345.

Foid.typeText.title: FOID.Type Text
Foid.typeText.description: Form of identification type code used for booking/ticketing. For example: PP (passport), CC (credit card), FF (frequent flyer), DL (drivers license).

FuelDistribution.title: Fuel Distribution
FuelDistribution.description: A procedure that defines the consecutive steps for fueling an aircraft and the quantities to distribute to each of the corresponding tanks at each step in case a fuel split calculation is required to be performed by the departure control system.

conditionName.title: Fuel Distribution.Condition Name
conditionName.description: Further specification of the fuel distribution name. For example: CASE A, CASE B.

FuelDistributionStep.title: Fuel Distribution Step
FuelDistributionStep.description: A step in the fueling of an aircraft describing the quantities to distribute to each of the corresponding tanks.

stepName.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Step Name
stepName.description: Name describing the step in the fueling sequence. For example: 'Fill Wings First', 'Partially Fill Tank A', 'Fill Center Until Full', 'Fill Tank C and D Evenly Until Full'.

stepNumber.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Step Number
stepNumber.description: Identifies the step number in the fueling sequence.

volumeRangeFromMeasure.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Volume Range From Measure
volumeRangeFromMeasure.description: Minimum fuel quantity volume for the sequence/step. Should be combined with a maximum fuel quantity volume.

volumeRangeToMeasure.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Volume Range To Measure
volumeRangeToMeasure.description: Maximum fuel quantity volume for the sequence/step. Should be combined with a minimum fuel quantity volume.

weightRangeFromMeasure.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Weight Range From Measure
weightRangeFromMeasure.description: Minimum fuel quantity weight for the sequence/step. Should be combined with a maximum fuel quantity weight.

weightRangeToMeasure.title: Fuel Distribution Step.Weight Range To Measure
weightRangeToMeasure.description: Maximum fuel quantity weight for the sequence/step. Should be combined with a minimum fuel quantity weight.

FuelDistributionStep.fuelDistributionSte.title: Each Fuel Distribution Step must contains at least one Fuel Distribution Step Elements
FuelDistributionStep.fuelDistributionSte.description: A quantity or ratio allocated to a specific tank or set of tanks during a fuel distribution step.

FuelDistributionStepElement.title: Fuel Distribution Step Element
FuelDistributionStepElement.description: A quantity or ratio allocated to a specific tank or set of tanks during a fuel distribution step.

FuelDistributionStepElement.ratio.title: Fuel Distribution Step Element.Ratio
FuelDistributionStepElement.ratio.description: Fuel quantity that is included in a specific tank or set of tanks after the fuel distribution step is carried out, specified as a ratio with respect to other tanks within the fuel distribution step.

FuelEffect.title: Fuel Effect
FuelEffect.description: An Effect of fuel volume and/or weight on balance arm and/or index for a given fuel tank or fueling procedure.

FuelEffect.indexValue.title: Fuel Effect.Index Value
FuelEffect.indexValue.description: Index influence of the loaded fuel volume or weight.

FuelEffect.lateralArmMeasure.title: Fuel Effect.Lateral Arm Measure
FuelEffect.lateralArmMeasure.description: Lateral position of the mean centroid of the loaded fuel volume or weight. Specify values as negative for linear dimensions extending to the left of the aircraft centerline and positive for linear dimensions extending to the right of the aircraft centerline.

FuelingProcedure.title: Fueling Procedure
FuelingProcedure.description: A procedure for filling the complete set of tanks (All Tanks) of an aircraft or an individual fuel tank, which might be composite when multiple tanks have been combined under one.

cumulativeInd.title: Fueling Procedure.Cumulative Indicator
cumulativeInd.description: Indicates that fueling procedure relates to all tanks (true) or to an individual tank or group of tanks (false).

fuelEffect.title: Each Fueling Procedure must have at least one Fuel Effects
fuelEffect.description: An Effect of fuel volume and/or weight on balance arm and/or index for a given fuel tank or fueling procedure.

maximumFuelDensityMeasure.title: Fueling Procedure.Maximum Fuel Density Measure
maximumFuelDensityMeasure.description: Maximum fuel density permitted, expressed as weight for a given fuel density volume unit.

minimumFuelDensityMeasure.title: Fueling Procedure.Minimum Fuel Density Measure
minimumFuelDensityMeasure.description: Minimum fuel density permitted, expressed as weight for a given fuel density volume unit.

standardInd.title: Fueling Procedure.Standard Indicator
standardInd.description: For cumulative fueling procedures indicates that the procedure complies with the standard fueling distribution as defined by the aircraft manufacturer. Where a non-standard distribution is specified additional comments may be required in the remarks field.

FuelingProcedure.fuelDistributionStepEle.title: Each Fueling Procedure may have one or more Tank Names
FuelingProcedure.fuelDistributionStepEle.description: A quantity or ratio allocated to a specific tank or set of tanks during a fuel distribution step.

FuelingProcedure.tankName.title: Fueling Procedure.Tank Name
FuelingProcedure.tankName.description: For non-cumulative fueling procedures, specifies which individual tanks are included in the grouping. Where the procedure name considers only one tank the Tank name will normally equal the Procedure name.

FuelingProcedure.taxiFuelBurnOrder.title: Each Fueling Procedure may have one or more Tank Names
FuelingProcedure.taxiFuelBurnOrder.description: A tank order for taxi fuel burn.

FundsTransfer.title: Funds Transfer
FundsTransfer.description: An amount of money moved from one financial account to another.

valueDate.title: Funds Transfer.Value Date
valueDate.description: Date on which a transaction actually takes place. This is the best estimate of the value date.

FundsTransfer.accountCode.title: Funds Transfer.Account Code
FundsTransfer.accountCode.description: predefined account where the funds are being transferred to or taken out from. Provided as token that is understood only by the communicating parties.

FundsTransfer.methodCode.title: Funds Transfer.Method Code
FundsTransfer.methodCode.description: a particular way of doing something. The value defines how the funds were paid to the payee or paid by the payer.

FundsTransferAccountCode.title: Funds Transfer Account_ Code
FundsTransferAccountCode.description: predefined account, provided as token, where the funds are being transferred to or taken out from.

FundsTransferMethodCode.title: Funds Transfer Method_ Code
FundsTransferMethodCode.description: describes how the funds were paid to the payee or paid by the payer.

FundsTransferTypeCode.title: Funds Transfer Type_ Code
FundsTransferTypeCode.description: characterizes how the selected method was executed.

GenderCode.title: Gender_ Code
GenderCode.description: Additional BDT to specify Gender code.

GenderCodeEnum.title: Gender Code
GenderCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for Gender Code. Valid Values: F - Female; M - Male; U - Unknown; X - Unspecified

GeographicFilterCriteria.title: Geographic Filter Criteria
GeographicFilterCriteria.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

areaCodeText.title: Geographic Filter Criteria.Area Code Text
areaCodeText.description: Valid area values include 1 = Western Hemisphere 2 = Europe, Africa, and the Near East 3 = Far East, Australia, and Pacific.

coordRadiusMeasure.title: Geographic Filter Criteria.Coordinate Radius Measure
coordRadiusMeasure.description: Radius to be used in conjunction with associated Geospatial coordinates.

destPointOfferFilterCriteria.title: Each Destination Point Offer Filter Criteria must be defined by one and only one Offer Destination Point
destPointOfferFilterCriteria.description: A set of filter criteria based on offer preferences/criteria.

geographicFilterCriteriaCountryCode.title: Geographic Filter Criteria.Geographic Filter Criteria Country Code
geographicFilterCriteriaCountryCode.description: ISO Country Code (can be extended by bilateral agreement in case of exceptions like Kosovo). For example: US, FR.

geographicFilterCriteriaCountrySubDivisi.title: Geographic Filter Criteria.Geographic Filter Criteria Country Sub-Division Code
geographicFilterCriteriaCountrySubDivisi.description: ISO code identifying this country sub-division within a given country. For example: 'AZ' for state of Arizona (US), 'BY' for region of Bavaria (Germany).

geographicFilterCriteriaIataLocationCode.title: Geographic Filter Criteria.Geographic Filter Criteria IATA Location Code
geographicFilterCriteriaIataLocationCode.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

originPointOfferFilterCriteria.title: Each Origin Point Offer Filter Criteria must be defined by one and only one Offer Origin Point
originPointOfferFilterCriteria.description: A set of filter criteria based on offer preferences/criteria.

GeographicFilterCriteria.airlineProfileD.title: Each Geographic Filter Criteria must be used by one and only one POS Geographic Filter Criteria
GeographicFilterCriteria.airlineProfileD.description: A Single set of data elements contained within the airline profile.

GeographicFilterCriteria.offerFilterCrit.title: Each Geographic Filter Criteria must be defined by one and only one Travel Within
GeographicFilterCriteria.offerFilterCrit.description: A set of filter criteria based on offer preferences/criteria.

GeographicFilterCriteria.geospatialLocat.title: Each Geographic Filter Criteria may have one and only one Geospatial Location
GeographicFilterCriteria.geospatialLocat.description: A location with geographic or spatial coordinates, on the surface of the Earth or in the air. For example: Longitude and Latitude.

GeospatialLocation.title: Geospatial Location
GeospatialLocation.description: A location with geographic or spatial coordinates, on the surface of the Earth or in the air. For example: Longitude and Latitude.

areaIdentifier.title: Geospatial Location.Area Identifier
areaIdentifier.description: Identifier of an area relevant to the business. Convention on identifier defined by the sender of the message. For example: 'PCA AB' for Passenger Check-in Area AB.

geographicFilterCriteria.title: Each Geospatial Location must be defined by one and only one Geographic Filter Criteria
geographicFilterCriteria.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

lineIdentifier.title: Geospatial Location.Line Identifier
lineIdentifier.description: Identifier of a spatial line relevant to the business. Convention on identifier defined by the sender of the message. For example: 'PAP KRIC BNTLY CAVLR3 KIAD' for Planned Airway Path VOR name KRIC.

naturalAreaGeocode.title: Geospatial Location.Natural Area Geocode
naturalAreaGeocode.description: Natural Area Geocode as defined by NAC Geographic Products Inc. For example: 8KDB PGFD.

pointAltitudeMeasure.title: Geospatial Location.Point Altitude Measure
pointAltitudeMeasure.description: Vertical distance of a level, a point or an object considered as a point, measured from mean sea level (MSL).

pointElevationNumber.title: Geospatial Location.Point Elevation Number
pointElevationNumber.description: Number of the spatial location point elevation.

pointIdentifier.title: Geospatial Location.Point Identifier
pointIdentifier.description: Identifier of a point relevant to the business, to be located. Convention on identifier defined by the sender of the message. For example: 'BSP 123' for Bag Sortation Point 123.

pointLatitudeNumber.title: Geospatial Location.Point Latitude Number
pointLatitudeNumber.description: Number of the spatial location point latitude.

pointLongitudeNumber.title: Geospatial Location.Point Longitude Number
pointLongitudeNumber.description: Number of the spatial location point longitude.

volumeIdentifier.title: Geospatial Location.Volume Identifier
volumeIdentifier.description: Identifier of a volume/space relevant to the business. Convention on identifier defined by the sender of the message. For example: 'ACS UPPER' for Upper Air Control Space.

GeospatialLocation.device.title: Each Geospatial Location must have one and only one Device
GeospatialLocation.device.description: A device upon which the secure transaction will occur.

GroupFareCriteria.title: Group Fare Criteria
GroupFareCriteria.description: A Group Fare preferences by passenger type

groupFareCriteriaPaxSegmentRefIdentifier.title: Group Fare Criteria.Group Fare Criteria Passenger Segment Reference Identifier
groupFareCriteriaPaxSegmentRefIdentifier.description: Reference to a Passenger Segment ID.

GroupFareCriteria.ptcCode.title: Group Fare Criteria.PTC Code
GroupFareCriteria.ptcCode.description: Type code applying to the Passenger which typically drives pricing. For example: ADT, CHD.

GstTaxInfoText.title: GST Tax Info_ Text
GstTaxInfoText.description: Text used to support the collection of additional goods and service tax.

HandlingAgency.title: Handling Agency
HandlingAgency.description: A Handling Agency responsible for baggage handling.

handlingAgencyCode.title: Handling Agency.Handling Agency Code
handlingAgencyCode.description: Code of the baggage handling agency organization.

HandlingAgencyCode.title: Handling Agency_ Code
HandlingAgencyCode.description: The baggage handling agency operator code.

HandlingAgencyCodeEnum.title: Handling Agency Code
HandlingAgencyCodeEnum.description: The baggage handling agency operator code.

Hold.title: Hold
Hold.description: A space in an aircraft confined by ceiling, floor, walls and bulkhead, used for carrying load.

door.title: Each Hold must have at least one Doors
door.description: A swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle.

holdIdentifier.title: Hold.Hold Identifier
holdIdentifier.description: Identifies a hold within a deck. For example: FWD (forward), AFT, BULK, MAIN (deck).

noRuleIsZeroInd.title: Hold.No Rule Is Zero Indicator
noRuleIsZeroInd.description: True means that in case no missing restraint rule is found the restricted weight is zero. False means that in case no missing restraint rule is found no reduction is applicable.

HoldCompartment.title: Hold Compartment
HoldCompartment.description: A space designated within a hold that can be containerized/palletized or not.

holdCompartmentIdentifier.title: Hold Compartment.Hold Compartment Identifier
holdCompartmentIdentifier.description: Identifies a compartment within a hold (compartment no). As per AHM505, compartments are numbered from 1 to 6. A second figure can indicate a section in a compartment starting from the front to the back and from right to left.

HoldCompartment.cabinCrewDistributionEle.title: Each Hold Compartment may be used by one or more Baggage Locations
HoldCompartment.cabinCrewDistributionEle.description: The location at which the cabin crew baggage is to be considered.

HoldCompartment.flightDeckCrewDistributi.title: Each Hold Compartment may use one or more Baggage Locations
HoldCompartment.flightDeckCrewDistributi.description: The location at which the flight deck crew baggage is to be considered.

HoldCompartmentIdentifier.title: Hold Compartment_ Identifier
HoldCompartmentIdentifier.description: Identifies a Compartment. As per AHM505, compartments are numbered from the rear of the aircraft in descending order from 6 to 1. A second figure can indicate a section in a compartment starting from the front to the back and from right to left.

HoldIdentifier.title: Hold_ Identifier
HoldIdentifier.description: Specifies a Hold identifier (AFT, FWD, BULK)

HoldLayout.title: Hold Layout
HoldLayout.description: A planned utilization layout of aircraft hold.

holdLayoutCargoInfo.title: Each Hold Layout may have one or more Hold Layout Cargo Informations
holdLayoutCargoInfo.description: A Hold Layout information by cargo type.

holdLayoutIdentifier.title: Hold Layout.Hold Layout Identifier
holdLayoutIdentifier.description: Identifies the hold layout (load configuration) for a given aircraft type. For example: 10 Pallets/16 Containers, All Container, All Pallet.

HoldLayout.aircraftGroupConfiguration.title: Each Hold Layout may be based on one or more Aircraft Group Configurations
HoldLayout.aircraftGroupConfiguration.description: A specific configuration of an aircraft group.

HoldLayoutCargoInfo.title: Hold Layout Cargo Information
HoldLayoutCargoInfo.description: A Hold Layout information by cargo type.

holdLayoutCargoInfoCargoTypeCode.title: Hold Layout Cargo Information.Hold Layout Cargo Information Cargo Type Code
holdLayoutCargoInfoCargoTypeCode.description: Cargo Type Code. For example: PP for Pallets and LL for ULDs.

unitsQty.title: Hold Layout Cargo Information.Units Quantity
unitsQty.description: Number of cargo units of the specified cargo type.
