IataAgencyAccreditationTypeCode.title: IATA Agency Accreditation Type_ Code
IataAgencyAccreditationTypeCode.description: Data type which specifies the IATA agency accreditation status.

IataAgencyAccreditationTypeCodeEnum.title: IATA Agency Accreditation Type Code
IataAgencyAccreditationTypeCodeEnum.description: Data type which specifies the IATA agency accreditation status, e.g. N - Non IATA Agents, T - Travel Agent Valid Values: N - Non IATA Agents; T - Travel Agent

IataAircraftGroupCode.title: IATA Aircraft Group_ Code
IataAircraftGroupCode.description: Specifies the IATA defined code of an aircraft group.

IataAircraftGroupCodeEnum.title: IATA Aircraft Group Code
IataAircraftGroupCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the IATA Aircraft Group Code BDT.

IataAircraftType.title: IATA Aircraft Type
IataAircraftType.description: A grouping of aircraft, defined in the SSIM RP 1761b, where aircraft sharing a family name, a common fuselage cross section and a common service character (e.g. Passenger, Cargo or Mixed Configuration) are recognized as a group.

iataAircraftGroupCode.title: IATA Aircraft Type.IATA Aircraft Group Code
iataAircraftGroupCode.description: Code assigned to an aircraft group in IATA SSIM. Aircraft Group codes are designed to be used wherever a lesser degree of precision in the specification of aircraft types is required.

iataAircraftTypeCode.title: IATA Aircraft Type.IATA Aircraft Type Code
iataAircraftTypeCode.description: Code assigned to an aircraft type in IATA SSIM. Within a group of aircraft covered by an Aircraft Group code, multiple Aircraft Type Codes may be assigned where substantial differences such as fuselage length, wingspan or category exist between different models of the same aircraft family. For certain categories of Aircraft Types, different codes have been assigned to reflect different service characteristics such as Passenger, Mixed Configuration and Freighter.

manufacturerName.title: IATA Aircraft Type.Manufacturer Name
manufacturerName.description: Name of the company which manufactures the aircraft type.

IataAircraftTypeCode.title: IATA Aircraft Type_ Code
IataAircraftTypeCode.description: Specifies the IATA defined code of an aircraft type.

IataAircraftTypeCodeEnum.title: IATA Aircraft Type Code
IataAircraftTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the IATA Aircraft Type Code BDT.

IataEasyPay.title: IATA Easy Pay
IataEasyPay.description: An IATA EasyPay is a payment instrument with a specific remittance mechanism. This FOP is not limited to BSP.

expirationDateText.title: IATA Easy Pay.Expiration Date Text
expirationDateText.description: Last month and year of validity.

iataEasyPayEncryptedData.title: Each IATA Easy Pay may supplies one and only one IATA Easy Pay Encrypted Data
iataEasyPayEncryptedData.description: A container for the encrypted Easy Pay data.

paymentMethodCriteria.title: Each IATA Easy Pay must have one and only one IATA Easy Pay Criteria
paymentMethodCriteria.description: A form of procedure for the payment of goods or services, plus any transactional information specific to the payment method other than the amount.

IataEasyPay.eWallet.title: Each IATA Easy Pay must have one and only one E-Wallet
IataEasyPay.eWallet.description: A payment that is facilitated through virtual wallet, where the paying party has deposited funds and the payee is receiving the payment from the wallet rather than the party committing to the payment.

IataEasyPayEncryptedData.title: IATA Easy Pay Encrypted Data
IataEasyPayEncryptedData.description: A container for the encrypted Easy Pay data.

encryptedAccountBinaryObject.title: IATA Easy Pay Encrypted Data.Encrypted Account Binary Object

IataLocation.title: IATA Location
IataLocation.description: A place or area from which a transport service may begin, visit and/or terminate.

IataLocationCode.title: IATA Location_ Code
IataLocationCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the codeset which defines the IATA airport or city codes.

IataLocationCodeEnum.title: IATA Location Code
IataLocationCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Location Code BDT.

IataMetropolitanArea.title: IATA Metropolitan Area
IataMetropolitanArea.description: A city with more than one airport servicing it.

iataMetropolitanAreaCode.title: IATA Metropolitan Area.IATA Metropolitan Area Code
iataMetropolitanAreaCode.description: Code assigned to an IATA Metropolitan Area by IATA.

IataPtcCode.title: IATA PTC_ Code
IataPtcCode.description: Additional BDT to specigy the type code codeset applying to a Passenger.

IataSpecialHandlingCode.title: IATA Special Handling_ Code
IataSpecialHandlingCode.description: Specifies the code set which defines the IATA special handling codes.

IataSpecialHandlingCodeEnum.title: IATA Special Handling Code
IataSpecialHandlingCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Special Handling Code BDT.

IataTerminalCode.title: IATA Terminal_ Code
IataTerminalCode.description: The code of the terminal infrastructure facility, as defined by IATA SSIM Appendix D. Example: '2W'.

IataTerminalCodeEnum.title: IATA Terminal Code
IataTerminalCodeEnum.description: The code of the terminal infrastructure facility.

IdealTrimLineTable.title: Ideal Trim Line Table
IdealTrimLineTable.description: A Set of related Ideal Trim Line Points forming an ideal trim line applying to a specific set of CG limits or to all CG limits.

idealTrimPoint.title: Each Ideal Trim Line Table must contains at least one Ideal Trim Points
idealTrimPoint.description: An optimal position of the center of gravity of an aircraft depending on its weight.

IdealTrimLineTable.remark.title: Each Ideal Trim Line Table may supplies one or more Remarks
IdealTrimLineTable.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

IdealTrimLineTable.rangeTypeCode.title: Ideal Trim Line Table.Range Type Code
IdealTrimLineTable.rangeTypeCode.description: Type or nature of the defined From/To values that limit the applicability of the balance limitation table. This may be specific units such as 'KG', 'Liters', but may also be used to identify the range such as 'Fuel Volume', 'Fuel Wt','Zero Fuel MAC'.

IdealTrimLineTable.rangeFromValue.title: Ideal Trim Line Table.Range From Value
IdealTrimLineTable.rangeFromValue.description: Minimum value of the range for which the specific table applies.

IdealTrimLineTable.rangeToValue.title: Ideal Trim Line Table.Range To Value
IdealTrimLineTable.rangeToValue.description: Maximum value of the range for which the specific table applies.

IdealTrimPoint.title: Ideal Trim Point
IdealTrimPoint.description: An optimal position of the center of gravity of an aircraft depending on its weight.

IdealTrimPoint.weightMeasure.title: Ideal Trim Point.Weight Measure
IdealTrimPoint.weightMeasure.description: Operating weight for which the optimal CG values apply.

IdealTrimPoint.indexValue.title: Ideal Trim Point.Index Value
IdealTrimPoint.indexValue.description: Value of the optimal CG expressed in index units.

IdealTrimPoint.macPercent.title: Ideal Trim Point.MAC Percent
IdealTrimPoint.macPercent.description: Value of the optimal CG expressed as %MAC/RC.

Identifier.title: Identifier
Identifier.description: An identifier is a character string used to uniquely identify one instance of an object within an identification scheme that is managed by an agency.

IdentityDoc.title: Identity Document
IdentityDoc.description: A document which may be used to identify a person or verify aspects of a person's personal identity. If issued in a small, standard credit card size form, it is usually called an identity card. Some countries issue formal identity documents, while others may require identity verification using informal documents. When the identity document incorporates a person's photograph, it may be called photo ID. In the absence of a formal identity document, a driver's license may be accepted in many countries for identity verification. Most countries accept passports as a form of identification.

countryOfNatl.title: Each Nationality Identifying Document may prove the nationality of the holder of one and only one Nationality Identifying Document
countryOfNatl.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

identityDocIdentifier.title: Identity Document.Identity Document Identifier
identityDocIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies the document from all other identity documents issued by the state or organization. For example: passport number, drivers license number.

issuerCountry.title: Each Issued Identifying Document must be issued by one and only one Issued Identifying Document
issuerCountry.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

IdentityDoc.typeCode.title: Identity Document.Type Code
IdentityDoc.typeCode.description: Type of passenger document. For example: PT (Passport).

IdentityDoc.visa.title: Each Identity Document may contain one or more Visas
IdentityDoc.visa.description: An official entry in a Passport or other Travel Document made by an official of a government to indicate that the bearer has been granted authority to enter or re-enter the country or region concerned.

IdentityDoc.givenName.title: Identity Document.Given Name
IdentityDoc.givenName.description: Holder's first or given name, as written on the document.

IdentityDoc.issueDate.title: Identity Document.Issue Date
IdentityDoc.issueDate.description: Date the identity document was issued.

IdentityDoc.titleName.title: Identity Document.Title Name
IdentityDoc.titleName.description: Holder's title as written on the document. For example: Mr., Mrs., Miss, Dr.

IdentityDocTypeCode.title: Identity Document Type_ Code
IdentityDocTypeCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the type of passenger document.

IdentityDocTypeCodeEnum.title: Identity Document Type Code
IdentityDocTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Identity Document Type BDT.

Ind.title: Indicator
Ind.description: An indicator is a list of two mutually exclusive Boolean values that express the only possible states of a property.

Individual.title: Individual
Individual.description: An individual human being as distinct from a group, class, or family.

addlName.title: Each Individual may be known by one or more Additional Names
addlName.description: An additional name derived from an individual's mother or father's surname as required by various states. For example: Father Surname, Smith and Mother Surname, Park.

birthplaceSimpleText.title: Individual.Birthplace Simple_ Text
birthplaceSimpleText.description: Country Code where the Passenger was born (ISO 3166). For example: DE.

individualIdentifier.title: Individual.Individual Identifier
individualIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies an Individual within the context of one message.

nameTypeCode.title: Individual.Name Type Code
nameTypeCode.description: Type of proper name. For example: Father Surname, Mother Surname.

Individual.givenName.title: Individual.Given Name
Individual.givenName.description: A personal name given to the individual at birth and used before a family name. Also called first name.

Individual.titleName.title: Individual.Title Name
Individual.titleName.description: A word such as Mr., Mrs., Miss or Dr that is used before an individual's name to indicate the gender, profession or marital status.

InterlineSettlementInfo.title: Interline Settlement Information
InterlineSettlementInfo.description: An Information item related to the value of a product or service as it pertains to interline transactions.

settlementAmount.title: Interline Settlement Information.Settlement Amount
settlementAmount.description: Settlement (Price) Value. For example: 300 USD. Note: This represents a Settlement value that is only used between the POA and ORA.

InterlineSettlementInfo.commission.title: Each Interline Settlement Information may have one or more Commissions
InterlineSettlementInfo.commission.description: A remuneration either an amount of money, or a set percentage of the value involved, paid to an agent in relations to a commercial transaction.

InterlineSettlementInfo.paxJourney.title: Each Interline Settlement Information must be associated with one and only one Passenger Journey
InterlineSettlementInfo.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

InterlineSettlementInfo.service.title: Each Interline Settlement Information may refer to one and only one Service
InterlineSettlementInfo.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

InterlineSettlementInfo.fee.title: Each Interline Settlement Information may have one or more Fees
InterlineSettlementInfo.fee.description: An amount added on to a charge for a specific product, purpose, or service.

InterlineSettlementInfo.tax.title: Each Interline Settlement Information may have one or more Taxes
InterlineSettlementInfo.tax.description: A compulsory contribution to state revenue, levied by the government on workers' income and business profits or added to the cost of some goods, services, and transactions.

InterlineSettlementInfo.fareDetail.title: Each Interline Settlement Information may have one or more Fare Details
InterlineSettlementInfo.fareDetail.description: An amount charged by the carrier for the carriage of a passenger and his allowable free baggage.

InterlineSettlementInfo.methodCode.title: Interline Settlement Information.Method Code
InterlineSettlementInfo.methodCode.description: Settlement method. For example: AD (Internal Airline Document), DS (Direct Settlement), EA (EMD Associated or Internal Airline Document).

InventoryGuarantee.title: Inventory Guarantee
InventoryGuarantee.description: An Identification and time limit information for holding inventory in an Offer or Order.

noGuaranteeInd.title: Inventory Guarantee.No Guarantee Indicator
noGuaranteeInd.description: When TRUE, no inventory could be guaranteed.

waitListInd.title: Inventory Guarantee.Wait List Indicator
waitListInd.description: When TRUE, the inventory was waitlisted.

InventoryGuarantee.order.title: Each Inventory Guarantee must applies to one and only one Order
InventoryGuarantee.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

InventoryGuarantee.timeLimitDateTime.title: Inventory Guarantee.Time Limit Date Time
InventoryGuarantee.timeLimitDateTime.description: Time limit by which guaranteed inventory for a specified product offer is guaranteed as available and by which the inventory held must be converted into a completed order before the time limit expires otherwise the guarantee is lost.

InventoryQualifiers.title: Inventory Qualifiers
InventoryQualifiers.description: A Identification for a number of inventory seats and their status.

inventorySeatsQty.title: Inventory Qualifiers.Inventory Seats Quantity
inventorySeatsQty.description: Number of inventory seats held or requested.

inventoryStatusCode.title: Inventory Qualifiers.Inventory Status Code
inventoryStatusCode.description: Reflects the status of the inventory. Uses IATA defined action/advice/status code.

JourneyData.title: Journey Data
JourneyData.description: An Active air segments that exist in the current agent work area. It is comprised of the existing air segment information including confirmed, pending and waitlisted segments, dated OPEN segments, and passive segments in the agent's work area, e.g. AAA, Booking File, or PNR. All air segments will be sent.

JourneyDistanceCriteria.title: Journey Distance Criteria
JourneyDistanceCriteria.description: A shopping filter criteria based on total Journey distance.

JourneyDurationCriteria.title: Journey Duration Criteria
JourneyDurationCriteria.description: A shopping filter criteria based on total Journey duration. This includes the sum of all flight durations as well as connection times.

maximumTimeMeasure.title: Journey Duration Criteria.Maximum Time Measure
maximumTimeMeasure.description: Preferred maximum time for this Journey.

JourneyStageTypeCode.title: Journey Stage Type_ Code
JourneyStageTypeCode.description: This will have an associated ENUM which contains codes to represent the Stages within a journey from prior to paying to post travel.

JourneyStageTypeCodeEnum.title: Journey Stage Type Code
JourneyStageTypeCodeEnum.description: Used PADIS Codeset FAT Fare or application penalty type. BUT this is used generically to indicate stages of a journey Contains list of Stages of a flight journey NO SHOW PRIOR TO DEPARTURE AFTER DEPARTURE Valid Values: After Departure - After Departure any time after a journey segment which was included in the offer/order item has taken place irrespective of whether the segment was flown or not.; No Show - No Show when passenger(s) have not turned up for any of the flights in the itinerary.; Prior To Departure - Prior to Departure any time before the first flight segment but after payment received.

KeyValueProperty.title: Key Value Property
KeyValueProperty.description: A contextual information to further describe something using a key-value pair.

keyText.title: Key Value Property.Key Text
keyText.description: Name or ID of the Keyword.

KeyValueProperty.affinityShoppingCriteri.title: Each Key Value Property must have one and only one Keyword Preference
KeyValueProperty.affinityShoppingCriteri.description: Affinity query keyword(s) with optional preference level.

KeyValueProperty.prefLevel.title: Each Key Value Property may have one and only one Preference Level
KeyValueProperty.prefLevel.description: An Information supporting some shopping filter criteria, including preference level code (e.g. Preferred, Exclude, etc.).

KeyValueProperty.coupon.title: Each Key Value Property must have one and only one Product Characteristic
KeyValueProperty.coupon.description: Contains product characteristics of an optional service, for inclusion on EMD. The type (Designates an optional service product characteristic type e.g., t-shirt size, color or pre-reserved seat number) should be carried in the Key field and characteristic value (Text that describes the product sold for the corresponding Product Characteristic Type, e.g. large, blue.) should be passed in the value field.

KeyValueProperty.desc.title: Each Key Value Property must associates one and only one Description
KeyValueProperty.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

KeyValueProperty.seatProfile.title: Each Key Value Property must have one and only one Seat Keywords
KeyValueProperty.seatProfile.description: An Airline defined characteristics shared by a group of seats.

KeyValueProperty.valueText.title: Key Value Property.Value Text
KeyValueProperty.valueText.description: Value corresponding to the associated Keyword.

LangCode.title: Language_ Code
LangCode.description: BDT to represent ISO language code list.

LateralImbalanceLimit.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit
LateralImbalanceLimit.description: A limit of any imbalance caused by off-center loading of payload and/or fuel.

lateralImbalanceLimitWeightTypeCode.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit.Lateral Imbalance Limit Weight Type Code
lateralImbalanceLimitWeightTypeCode.description: Type of weight to which the balance limit applies: Taxi (TA), Take Off (TO), Landing (LD).

operatingWeightMeasure.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit.Operating Weight Measure
operatingWeightMeasure.description: Operating weight for which the balance limit applies.

weightLimitMeasure.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit.Weight Limit Measure
weightLimitMeasure.description: Lateral imbalance weight or moment limit. When weight unit is missing the standard aircraft moment weight unit is used.

LateralImbalanceLimit.momentLengthUnitCo.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit.Moment Length Unit Code
LateralImbalanceLimit.momentLengthUnitCo.description: Length unit used for moment calculation in case moment indicator is set for the table. When missing the standard aircraft moment length unit is used.

LateralImbalanceLimitTable.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit Table
LateralImbalanceLimitTable.description: A Set of related Lateral Imbalance Limits.

lateralImbalanceLimit.title: Each Lateral Imbalance Limit Table must contains at least one Lateral Imbalance Limits
lateralImbalanceLimit.description: A limit of any imbalance caused by off-center loading of payload and/or fuel.

momentInd.title: Lateral Imbalance Limit Table.Moment Indicator
momentInd.description: Indicator if lateral imbalance limits in the table are expressed in moments or in weights.

LateralImbalanceLimitTable.remark.title: Each Lateral Imbalance Limit Table may supplies one or more Remarks
LateralImbalanceLimitTable.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

LengthMeasure.title: Length_ Measure
LengthMeasure.description: A numeric value determining a length (linear dimension) along with the specified unit of measure.

LengthUnitCodeEnum.title: Length Unit Code
LengthUnitCodeEnum.description: List of Length Unit Codes. Subset of UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Valid Values: CMT - Centimeter; FOT - Foot; INH - Inch; MTR - Meter

LiquidVolumeMeasure.title: Liquid Volume_ Measure
LiquidVolumeMeasure.description: A numeric value determining a liquid volume along with the specified unit of measure.

LiquidVolumeUnitCode.title: Liquid Volume Unit_ Code
LiquidVolumeUnitCode.description: Specifies Liquid Volume Unit code list.

LiquidVolumeUnitCodeEnum.title: Liquid Volume Unit Code
LiquidVolumeUnitCodeEnum.description: List of Liquid Volume Unit Codes. Subset of UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Valid Values: GLL - US Gallon; LTR - Liter

Lock.title: Lock
Lock.description: An ULD restraint which can be fixed within the aircraft.

lockIdentifier.title: Lock.Lock Identifier
lockIdentifier.description: Identifies a lock within a hold.

Lock.typeCode.title: Lock.Type Code
Lock.typeCode.description: Type of lock. For example: Pallet Lock, Lateral Guide, Fixed End Stop, Center Guide.

Lock.lateralArmMeasure.title: Lock.Lateral Arm Measure
Lock.lateralArmMeasure.description: Lateral position of lock. Specify values as negative for linear dimensions extending to the left of the aircraft centerline and positive for linear dimensions extending to the right of the aircraft centerline.

LockPositionCodeEnum.title: Lock Position Code
LockPositionCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Lock Position Code BDT. Valid Values: A - Aft restraint; F - Forward restraint; L - Lateral restraint; R - Right restraint

LockTypeCode.title: Lock Type_ Code
LockTypeCode.description: Specifies Lock Type codes (Pallet Lock, Lateral Guide, Fixed End Stop. ...)

LoyaltyProgram.title: Loyalty Program
LoyaltyProgram.description: A structured marketing effort to build long-term brand loyalty by providing incentives, such as rewards, discounts, free products and services, early access to new offerings, point systems, or exclusive merchandise and services, to qualifying customers who are willing to share data about themselves and their buying habits. Often referred to as a Frequent Flyer Program in the airline industry.

account.title: Each Loyalty Program may have one or more Loyalty Program Accounts
account.description: An account set up to record points awarded, points redeemed, expiration of points and tier levels achieved for a member of a loyalty program.

loyaltyProgramCode.title: Loyalty Program.Loyalty Program Code
loyaltyProgramCode.description: Loyalty Program ID: For example: MAM.

providerName.title: Loyalty Program.Provider Name
providerName.description: Name of the organization providing the Loyalty Program.

LoyaltyProgram.websiteUri.title: Loyalty Program.Website URI
LoyaltyProgram.websiteUri.description: Website address where information explaining the nature and rules of the loyalty program can be found.

LoyaltyProgramAccount.title: Loyalty Program Account
LoyaltyProgramAccount.description: An account set up to record points awarded, points redeemed, expiration of points and tier levels achieved for a member of a loyalty program.

loyaltyProgramAccountIdentifier.title: Loyalty Program Account.Loyalty Program Account Identifier
loyaltyProgramAccountIdentifier.description: Loyalty Program account number. For example: ABC123456.

loyaltyProgramAccountTierCode.title: Loyalty Program Account.Loyalty Program Account Tier Code

loyaltyProgramAccountTierLevelCode.title: Loyalty Program Account.Loyalty Program Account Tier Level Code
loyaltyProgramAccountTierLevelCode.description: Identifier for Loyalty Program tier Level. Example: GOLD.

signInIdentifier.title: Loyalty Program Account.Sign In Identifier
signInIdentifier.description: Identifier used to sign into the account. Typically, this is a random set of characters or a username.

tierPriorityText.title: Loyalty Program Account.Tier Priority Text
tierPriorityText.description: Loyalty Program account priority within the tier. For example: Platinum, executive.

LoyaltyProgramAccount.individual.title: Each Loyalty Program Account must be owned by one and only one Individual
LoyaltyProgramAccount.individual.description: An individual human being as distinct from a group, class, or family.

LoyaltyProgramAccount.bagSegment.title: Each Loyalty Program Account may be used by one or more Bag Segments
LoyaltyProgramAccount.bagSegment.description: A movement of a bag over a Dated Operating Segment.

LoyaltyProgramTier.title: Loyalty Program Tier
LoyaltyProgramTier.description: A level of loyalty that can be assigned to a customer having accrued or been awarded sufficient credits, earned through trade with the Loyalty program owner or their partners, providing the customer with a range of defined benefits. ------------Propose A status assigned to a customer having accrued or been awarded sufficient credits to reach the qualification threshold, earned through trade with the Loyalty program owner or their partners, providing the customer with a range of defined benefits.

higherTier.title: Each Higher Tier may be inferior to one and only one Lower Tier
higherTier.description: The ranking of the tier with respect to its next higher tier and next lower tier.

lowerTier.title: Each Higher Tier may be superior to one and only one Higher Tier
lowerTier.description: The ranking of the tier with respect to its next higher tier and next lower tier.

qualifyingBalanceAmount.title: Loyalty Program Tier.Qualifying Balance Amount
qualifyingBalanceAmount.description: Minimum balance required for loyalty program members to be eligible for the tier.

LoyaltyProgramTier.loyaltyProgramAccount.title: Each Loyalty Program Tier may define the benefits of one or more Tiers
LoyaltyProgramTier.loyaltyProgramAccount.description: An account set up to record points awarded, points redeemed, expiration of points and tier levels achieved for a member of a loyalty program.

LoyaltyRedemption.title: Loyalty Redemption
LoyaltyRedemption.description: A form of payment by which the customer uses a virtual currency of a Loyalty Program Account (such as air miles) in exchange for goods or services.

loyaltyCurAmount.title: Loyalty Redemption.Loyalty Currency Amount
loyaltyCurAmount.description: Quantity of loyalty units redeemed. For example: 15000.

Markup.title: Markup
Markup.description: A definition of the reason for the markup added by an airline as part of the offer reported as calculation detail. The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit. [Oxford]

Markup.amount.title: Markup.Amount
Markup.amount.description: Value and sold-in currency added by an airline as part of the offer reported as calculation detail.

MarriageGroup.title: Marriage Group
MarriageGroup.description: A segments of a journey which are actioned as a single unit (set).

marriageGroupNumber.title: Marriage Group.Marriage Group Number
marriageGroupNumber.description: Number that identifies a marriage group.

marriageTypeCode.title: Marriage Group.Marriage Type Code
marriageTypeCode.description: Code indicating the type of marriage applied. For example: 'A' for online, 'I' for interline.

MarriageGroupSegment.title: Marriage Group Segment
MarriageGroupSegment.description: A segment which is a part of a marriage group.

marriageGroup.title: Each Marriage Group Segment must have one and only one Marriage Group
marriageGroup.description: A segments of a journey which are actioned as a single unit (set).

MatchTypeCode.title: Match Type_ Code
MatchTypeCode.description: Data type for Offer Match Result ENUMs.

MatchTypeCodeEnum.title: Match Type Code
MatchTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Match Type BDT. Valid Values: Full - Full; None - None; Other - Other; Partial - Partial

MaximumWeights.title: Maximum Weights
MaximumWeights.description: A Maximum certified weights (ZFW, LW, TOW, TW) applicable to an aircraft or a group of aircraft.

maximumWeightsVariationCode.title: Maximum Weights.Maximum Weights Variation Code
maximumWeightsVariationCode.description: Variation code identifying a set of maximum certified weights. For example: Standard, Domestic, International, Charter.

MaximumWeightsTable.title: Maximum Weights Table
MaximumWeightsTable.description: A Set of maximum certified weights.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description: A measure is a numeric value determined by measuring an object along with the specified unit of measure.

MeasurementSystemCode.title: Measurement System_ Code
MeasurementSystemCode.description: BDT to represent measurement system codes (e.g. Imperial, Metric).

MeasurementSystemCodeEnum.title: Measurement System Code
MeasurementSystemCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the measurement system code BDT. Valid Values: Imperial - Imperial.; Metric - Metric.

MediaObject.title: Media Object
MediaObject.description: An Electronic documents, images, and other files which accompany and support some information.

binaryObject.title: Media Object.Binary Object
binaryObject.description: Binary Object Information. Supplementary attributes include character set code, MIME code, encoding information, file name, format, and URI.

fileSizeMeasure.title: Media Object.File Size Measure
fileSizeMeasure.description: Size of the Attachment in kilobytes (KB). For example: 60.

hintText.title: Media Object.Hint Text
hintText.description: Media object tip which is typically used in a client GUI (a mouse over tip). For example: Envoy Class Seat.

mediaIdentifier.title: Media Object.Media Identifier
mediaIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies a Media file within the context of one message.

renderingInstructionsText.title: Media Object.Rendering Instructions Text
renderingInstructionsText.description: Rendering Instruction Parameters. Notes: This is typically used for XSLT.

renderingMethodText.title: Media Object.Rendering Method Text
renderingMethodText.description: Rendering Method name. For example: Narrative, XSLT.

renderingOutputFormatText.title: Media Object.Rendering Output Format Text
renderingOutputFormatText.description: An identifier for a file format or content type of the rendered output.

renderingOverviewText.title: Media Object.Rendering Overview Text
renderingOverviewText.description: An overview of the rendering method or style.

MediaObject.heightMeasure.title: Media Object.Height Measure
MediaObject.heightMeasure.description: Media (typically Image) height in specified units.

MediaObject.widthMeasure.title: Media Object.Width Measure
MediaObject.widthMeasure.description: Media (typically Image) width in specified units.

MediaObject.desc.title: Each Media Object may be further described by one or more Descriptions
MediaObject.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

MediaObject.seatProfile.title: Each Media Object must describe one and only one Marketing Information
MediaObject.seatProfile.description: An Airline defined characteristics shared by a group of seats.

MerchantAccount.title: Merchant Account
MerchantAccount.description: An individual or organization that excepts credit and / or debit cards as methods of enacting financial transactions. A merchant works with an Acquiring Bank to apply for and receive a Merchant Account (an account that allows the Merchant to accept Credit and debit cards). Whenever a customer purchases an item with a Credit or debit card, the Merchant submits the purchase Transaction information to its Acquiring Bank, which will then submit it through the card association network to the card holder's Issuing Bank. The Issuing Bank will approve or decline the charge, and bill the cardholder the amount due to the Merchant.

merchantIdentifier.title: Merchant Account.Merchant Identifier
merchantIdentifier.description: Identifier passed from the merchant (airline) to the PSP/Bank to identify themselves during the authorization transaction.

merchantName.title: Merchant Account.Merchant Name
merchantName.description: name under which the merchant is registered within their PSP/Bank

MessageFunctionCode.title: Message Function_ Code
MessageFunctionCode.description: PADIS defined list of message functions.

MessageFunctionCodeEnum.title: Message Function Code
MessageFunctionCodeEnum.description: PADIS defined list of message functions.

curMetadata.title: Each Metadata may have associated one or more Currency Parameters
curMetadata.description: A currency related parameters intended to influence which currency the shopping results are displayed in.

fieldMetadata.title: Each Metadata may supplies one or more Field Metadatas
fieldMetadata.description: A set of defining implementation specific fields which should be populated.

MinimumWeights.title: Minimum Weights
MinimumWeights.description: A Minimum certified weights (ZFW, LW, TOW, TW) applicable to an aircraft or a group of aircraft.

minimumWeightsVariationCode.title: Minimum Weights.Minimum Weights Variation Code
minimumWeightsVariationCode.description: Variation code identifying a set of minimum certified weights. For example: Standard, Domestic, International, Charter.

MinimumWeightsTable.title: Minimum Weights Table
MinimumWeightsTable.description: A set of minimum certified weights.

MissingLockCondition.title: Missing Lock Condition
MissingLockCondition.description: A condition on number of missing locks per lock type and/or lock position.

missingLockConditionLockPositionCode.title: Missing Lock Condition.Missing Lock Condition Lock Position Code
missingLockConditionLockPositionCode.description: Position of lock relative to the ULD position.

missingLockConditionLockTypeCode.title: Missing Lock Condition.Missing Lock Condition Lock Type Code
missingLockConditionLockTypeCode.description: Type of lock. For example: Pallet Lock, Lateral Guide, Fixed End Stop, Center Guide.

MissingLockCondition.missingQty.title: Missing Lock Condition.Missing Quantity
MissingLockCondition.missingQty.description: Number of missing or inoperable locks to which the specified reduced maximum weight applies.

MissingLockRestriction.title: Missing Lock Restriction
MissingLockRestriction.description: A weight restriction on fuel tank or other ULD load position applicable when missing restraint rule conditions are fulfilled.

missingLockRestrictionUldLoadPositionIde.title: Missing Lock Restriction.Missing Lock Restriction ULD Load Position Identifier
missingLockRestrictionUldLoadPositionIde.description: Identifies a possible ULD position within the aircraft, using one of the patterns described in AHM505. For example: A, BR, CDL, E3, 13,22L, 32P, 413, 1112O. May contain compartment number, row position, left-to-right position in a row.

MissingRestraintRule.title: Missing Restraint Rule
MissingRestraintRule.description: A restriction on weight applicable when one or more locks are inoperable or missing.

adjacentInd.title: Missing Restraint Rule.Adjacent Indicator
adjacentInd.description: Indicator missing locks should be adjacent for the rule to apply.

emptyUldOnlyInd.title: Missing Restraint Rule.Empty ULD Only Indicator
emptyUldOnlyInd.description: Indicator that restricted weight is zero but that an empty ULD or pallet can be loaded.

missingLockCondition.title: Each Missing Restraint Rule may have one or more Missing Lock Conditions
missingLockCondition.description: A condition on number of missing locks per lock type and/or lock position.

missingLockRestriction.title: Each Missing Restraint Rule may induce one or more Missing Lock Restrictions
missingLockRestriction.description: A weight restriction on fuel tank or other ULD load position applicable when missing restraint rule conditions are fulfilled.

missingRestraintRuleLockTypeCode.title: Missing Restraint Rule.Missing Restraint Rule Lock Type Code
missingRestraintRuleLockTypeCode.description: Type of lock. For example: Pallet Lock, Lateral Guide, Fixed End Stop, Center Guide.

MissingRestraintRule.verticalInd.title: Missing Restraint Rule.Vertical Indicator
MissingRestraintRule.verticalInd.description: Indicator missing locks should be vertical for the rule to apply.

MissingRestraintRule.missingQty.title: Missing Restraint Rule.Missing Quantity
MissingRestraintRule.missingQty.description: Number of missing or inoperable locks to which the specified reduced maximum weight applies.

MovementStatusCode.title: Movement Status_ Code
MovementStatusCode.description: The movement status code of the logistics item status

MovementStatusCodeEnum.title: Movement Status Code
MovementStatusCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment a baggage movement status codes. Valid Values: Acquired - Acquired, bag has been acquired by a party or facility; Delivered - Delivered, bag has been delivered by a party or facility; Reclaimed - Reclaimed, bag has been reclaimed by (passenger) party.; Routed - Routed, bag has been routed through a facility

Name.title: Name
Name.description: A name is a word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a person, place, thing or concept

NaturalNumber.title: Natural_ Number
NaturalNumber.description: A mathematical number used for counting (positive whole number or integer).

NetworkAddress.title: Network Address
NetworkAddress.description: A virtual address in an IT network.

ipVersion4Identifier.title: Network Address.IP Version 4 Identifier
ipVersion4Identifier.description: Identifier of the IP version 4 electronic address.

ipVersion6Identifier.title: Network Address.IP Version 6 Identifier
ipVersion6Identifier.description: Identifier of the IP version 6 electronic address.

lniataAddressIdentifier.title: Network Address.LNIATA Address Identifier
lniataAddressIdentifier.description: Identifier of the LNIATA electronic address.

NetworkAddress.offer.title: Each Network Address may be associated one and only one Web Address URL
NetworkAddress.offer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

NetworkAddress.printer.title: Each Network Address must refer to one and only one Printer
NetworkAddress.printer.description: A device for printing text or pictures or barcodes, especially one linked to a computer.

NetworkAddress.scanner.title: Each Network Address must refer to one and only one Scanner
NetworkAddress.scanner.description: A device that scans objects and converts them or extracts of them into digital data. Different types of scanner are a document scanner, a barcode reader and a biometric scanner.

NetworkAddress.order.title: Each Network Address may be associated one and only one Web Address URL
NetworkAddress.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

Number.title: Number
Number.description: A mathematical number that is assigned or is determined by calculation.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

expirationTimeLimitDateTime.title: Offer.Expiration Time Limit Date Time
expirationTimeLimitDateTime.description: Length of time an offer will persist in an airline's offer management system for use in subsequent transactions. Note: Upon expiry, the expectation is that the offer is no longer retrievable and the shopping process must begin again. The presence of an Offer Time Limit does not indicate either a guarantee of price or inventory against a given Offer item within the Offer. Should the offer time limit expire, any other time limit also expires unless an Order has been created or changed.

matchAppText.title: Offer.Match Application Text
matchAppText.description: Specifies which type of flight request the match information relate to. For example: Attribute, Affinity, Other.

matchPercent.title: Offer.Match Percent
matchPercent.description: Offer match percentage to shopping criteria type. This information should be populated when there is a partial match of the initial shopping criteria. For example: 60.

matchTypeCode.title: Offer.Match Type Code
matchTypeCode.description: Offer match to shopping criteria type. For example: Full, None, Partial, Other. Note: An additional percentage qualifier, such as 50%, may be specified for a Partial match.

offerIdentifier.title: Offer.Offer Identifier
offerIdentifier.description: Carrier assigned ID which uniquely identifies a specific Offer across several messages. Offer ID facilitates the tracking and verification of individually priced offer(s) selected from the shopping response. Only the Offer IDs of the ORA (Offer Responsible Airline) are returned in shopping responses. Offer ID is unique to each individually priced offer in the shopping response even if the offer price is zero. Offer ID may be specific to individual passengers in the offer, and may be associated with a segment or a journey. The set of Offer IDs returned in a response are referenced by a Shopping Response ID.

ptcOfferParameters.title: Each Offer may have one or more PTC Offer Parameterss
ptcOfferParameters.description: A Passenger Type summary information for an offer.

redemptionInd.title: Offer.Redemption Indicator
redemptionInd.description: When TRUE, this Offer must be redeemed, that is, it cannot be purchased. Note: Taxes may still apply.

requestedDateInd.title: Offer.Requested Date Indicator
requestedDateInd.description: Indicator to specify if the offer relates to a requested date. For example in calendar search, this indicator will be set to 'true' if this airline offer is for a requested date and will not be present (or will be set to 'false' if airline offer is for another date than requested one.

webAddressUrlUri.title: Offer.Web Address URL URI
webAddressUrlUri.description: Deep linking into another site to complete the transaction. For example: to bring the customer directly to a page to continue with a purchase of a specific offer.

OfferFilterCriteria.title: Offer Filter Criteria
OfferFilterCriteria.description: A set of filter criteria based on offer preferences/criteria.

directionalIndText.title: Offer Filter Criteria.Directional Indicator Text
directionalIndText.description: 1 = From LOC 1 to LOC 2 2 = To LOC 1 from LOC 2 3 = Both.

offerDestPoint.title: Each Destination Point Offer Filter Criteria may have one or more Destination Point Offer Filter Criterias
offerDestPoint.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

offerOriginPoint.title: Each Origin Point Offer Filter Criteria may have one or more Origin Point Offer Filter Criterias
offerOriginPoint.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

travelWithin.title: Each Offer Filter Criteria may have one or more Geographic Filter Criterias
travelWithin.description: A set of criteria used to filter results based on geographic preferences, including Area, State, City, Airport, or Geospatial information.

OfferItem.title: Offer Item
OfferItem.description: A priced grouping of one or more services within an Offer.

modificationProhibitedInd.title: Offer Item.Modification Prohibited Indicator
modificationProhibitedInd.description: POA to ORA only: to indicate that the offer is non-modifiable. This indicates to ORA that its offer is non-modifiable for reasons such as Regulatory or brand protection. If indicator is set to TRUE, modifications to the POA's offer ARE NOT allowed.

offerItemIdentifier.title: Offer Item.Offer Item Identifier
offerItemIdentifier.description: Carrier assigned ID which exists uniquely within an Offer. Note: Exceeding 64 characters or use of dashes is not recommended.

OfferItem.mandatoryInd.title: Offer Item.Mandatory Indicator
OfferItem.mandatoryInd.description: If set to 'true', indicates mandatory Offer Items which cannot be removed from the Offer. Mandatory Offer Items transition into Order Items. If not present or 'false', the Offer item is optional. The aggregate price at the Offer level initially reflects the sum of the prices for all Mandatory Offer Items within it.

OperationalSuffixText.title: Operational Suffix_ Text
OperationalSuffixText.description: Defines the Operational Suffix which is appended to a flight number.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

lastModifiedDateTime.title: Order.Last Modified Date Time
lastModifiedDateTime.description: Date time by which the order is modified. For example: 2018-09-05T15:52:01Z.

orderIdentifier.title: Order.Order Identifier
orderIdentifier.description: Carrier assigned ID which uniquely identifies a specific Order across several messages.

Order.ticketDocInfo.title: Each Order must have one and only one Referenced Order
Order.ticketDocInfo.description: An Information corresponding to a group of 1 to 4 Tickets for a single Origin Destination and a single Passenger.

OrderAmendment.title: Order Amendment
OrderAmendment.description: An Order amendment information and action type.

OrderAmendment.remark.title: Each Order Amendment may supplies one and only one Remark
OrderAmendment.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

minimumQty.title: Ordering Quantity.Minimum Quantity
minimumQty.description: MINIMUM Quantity of the Option that may be ordered.

OrderingQty.term.title: Each Ordering Quantity must have one and only one Term
OrderingQty.term.description: A condition under which an agreement is reached.

OrderingQty.maximumQty.title: Ordering Quantity.Maximum Quantity
OrderingQty.maximumQty.description: MAXIMUM Quantity of the Option that may be ordered.

OrderItem.title: Order Item
OrderItem.description: An individually priced item within an Order, made up of one or more Services. May or may not be a selected Offer Item (e.g. non-chargeable Services available on request such as a wheelchair).

changeGroupIdentifier.title: Order Item.Change Group Identifier
changeGroupIdentifier.description: Reference to one Order Item that are going to be replaced, unique within Order.

changeTypeText.title: Order Item.Change Type Text
changeTypeText.description: indicates whether the Order Item is the old or the new Order Item.

grandTotalAmount.title: Order Item.Grand Total Amount
grandTotalAmount.description: Reflects the Differential Total Amount and the Penalty Total Amount, if netted.

inventoryGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.title: Order Item.Inventory Guarantee Time Limit Date Time
inventoryGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.description: Length of time inventory against a given Service is guaranteed. If inventory is not guaranteed, the Order creation (or change) may fail. In the absence of a time limit, no inventory is guaranteed. Note: The presence of an inventory guarantee does not assume a guarantee of price. For the price to be guaranteed against a given Offer Item, the Price Guarantee Time Limit must also be present. The assumption is that inventory is held when an Order is created (or changed), so this time limit only applies in the context of an Offer.

orderItemIdentifier.title: Order Item.Order Item Identifier
orderItemIdentifier.description: Carrier assigned ID which exists uniquely within an Order.

reusableInd.title: Order Item.Reusable Indicator
reusableInd.description: If Reusable = true, indicates that part of the value of the OrderItem may be reused for reshopping or refund. Exact reusable amount is unknown until Seller requests to reshop or to process a refund for this OrderItem.

sellerFollowUpAction.title: Each Order Item may Is required by one and only one Seller Follow Up Action
sellerFollowUpAction.description: A seller followup action following involuntary change means a subsequent action required to an Order Item after a schedule change.

OrderItemStatusCode.title: Order Item Status _ Code
OrderItemStatusCode.description: represents the status of an Order Item

OrderItemStatusCodeEnum.title: Order Item Status Code
OrderItemStatusCodeEnum.description: shows the current statuses of an Order Item Valid Values: CANCELLED BY CUSTOMER - The Order Item reservation is cancelled by the Customer.; ENTITLED - Customer is entitled to receive the Order Item.; NOT ENTITLED - Customer is not entitled to receive the Order Item until certain conditions are met.

OrderStatusCode.title: Order Status_ Code
OrderStatusCode.description: represents the statuses of an Order

OrderStatusCodeEnum.title: Order Status Code
OrderStatusCodeEnum.description: shows the possible statuses of an Order Valid Values: CLOSED - Once all Order Items are FULLY PAID and Services are either DELIVERED or REFUNDED or EXPIRED; FROZEN - emergency lock; OPENED - Order was built based on offer information.

Ordinal.title: Ordinal
Ordinal.description: An ordinal number is an assigned mathematical number that represents order or sequence.

Org.title: Organization
Org.description: An organized structure set up for a particular purpose, such as a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution. Business Identifier Fields: - Organization Identifier

taxDeductedAtSourceCapabilityInd.title: Organization.Tax Deducted At Source Capability Indicator
taxDeductedAtSourceCapabilityInd.description: Identifies if the Organization has the capability to apply Tax Deduction at Source.

Org.distributionChainLink.title: Each Organization may perform one or more Participating Organizations
Org.distributionChainLink.description: An organization playing a participating role in an instance of a distribution channel.

OriginDepRequest.title: Origin Departure Request
OriginDepRequest.description: A Customer's requested Origin departure time and location for an Origin and Destination shopping request.

OriginDest.title: Origin Destination
OriginDest.description: An Origin and Destination airport/city pair which confines a passenger journey or an aircraft flight.

calendarDateCriteria.title: Each Origin Destination may supplies one and only one Calendar Date Criteria
calendarDateCriteria.description: A request to an airline to additionally include a preview of the Offer price for a specified date range for the same Shopping Criteria.

destArrivalCriteria.title: Each Origin Destination must supplies one and only one Destination Arrival Criteria
destArrivalCriteria.description: A Customer's requested Destination arrival time and location for an Origin and Destination shopping request.

originDepRequest.title: Each Origin Destination must supplies one and only one Origin Departure Request
originDepRequest.description: A Customer's requested Origin departure time and location for an Origin and Destination shopping request.

originDestIdentifier.title: Origin Destination.Origin Destination Identifier
originDestIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies an Origin Destination within the context of one message.

OriginDest.paxJourney.title: Each Origin Destination may confines one or more Journeys
OriginDest.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

OriginDest.destStation.title: Each Destination Station Origin Destination must supplies one and only one Destination Station Origin Destination
OriginDest.destStation.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

OriginDest.originStation.title: Each Origin Station Origin Destination must supplies one and only one Origin Station Origin Destination
OriginDest.originStation.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

OriginDest.datedMarketingSegment.title: Each Origin Destination may supplies one or more Dated Marketing Segments
OriginDest.datedMarketingSegment.description: A commercial designation under which a Dated Operating Segment can be booked, either under the operating carrier's designator or that of another carrier (codeshare).

OtherAddress.title: Other Address
OtherAddress.description: An alternative other contact method E.g. web site URL, social media handle.

OtherPaymentMethod.title: Other Payment Method
OtherPaymentMethod.description: A non-standard form of payment which may be used in exchange for goods or services.

OtherPaymentMethod.remark.title: Each Other Payment Method may supplies one or more Remarks
OtherPaymentMethod.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

OwnershipTypeCodeEnum.title: Ownership Type Code
OwnershipTypeCodeEnum.description: Ownership Type Code Valid Values: CS - Customer; SL - Seller

OwnerTypeCode.title: Owner Type_ Code
OwnerTypeCode.description: Specifies the type of Owner for a given Offer/Order/Order Item (E.g. ORA, POA).

OwnerTypeCodeEnum.title: Owner Type Code
OwnerTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Owner Type BDT. Valid Values: ORA - Offer Responsible Airline; POA - Participating Offer Airline

PantryDistribution.title: Pantry Distribution
PantryDistribution.description: An Allocation of galley equipment, food, service items etc. to specified locations or regardless of location.

pantryDistributionCode.title: Pantry Distribution.Pantry Distribution Code
pantryDistributionCode.description: Name/identifier of the pantry distribution. For example: 'Domestic', 'Charter', 'Z'.

PantryDistribution.remark.title: Each Pantry Distribution may supplies one or more Remarks
PantryDistribution.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

PantryDistribution.pantryDistributionEle.title: Each Pantry Distribution may contains one or more Pantry Distribution Elements
PantryDistribution.pantryDistributionEle.description: A specific allocation in a pantry distribution.

PantryDistributionElement.title: Pantry Distribution Element
PantryDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a pantry distribution.

galleyLocation.title: Each Pantry Distribution Element must be related one and only one Cabin Component
galleyLocation.description: A Non-seat related cabin feature or facility (e.g. lavatory, galley, closet, stowage, etc.)

weightPerLocationMeasure.title: Pantry Distribution Element.Weight Per Location Measure
weightPerLocationMeasure.description: Total weight of galley equipment, food, service items etc. to be loaded at the specified location.

Party.title: Party
Party.description: An individual, a group, or a body having a role in the air transport industry. Party has a legal connotation in a business transaction.

role.title: Each Party may perform one or more Parties
role.description: A part played by a party conforming to a set of connected behaviors, rights, obligations, beliefs, and norms.

PartyRole.title: Party Role
PartyRole.description: A part played by a party conforming to a set of connected behaviors, rights, obligations, beliefs, and norms.

party.title: Each Party must be performed by one and only one Role
party.description: An individual, a group, or a body having a role in the air transport industry. Party has a legal connotation in a business transaction.

Pax.title: Passenger
Pax.description: An individual, except members of the crew, carried or to be carried with the consent of the carrier, on board any transport vehicle such as aircraft, train, bus, ship.

ageMeasure.title: Passenger.Age Measure
ageMeasure.description: Age of the passenger. Typically used in NDC Anonymous Shopping requests or when the individual's birth date is not known.

booking.title: Each Passenger must supplies one and only one Booking

customerValueNumber.title: Passenger.Customer Value Number
customerValueNumber.description: A numeric value assigned to a customer by an airline to be used at the discretion of the airline.

foid.title: Each Passenger may supplies one and only one FOID
foid.description: A Form of identification. Typically used to identify that the passenger is who he says he is. This is the type of FOID as defined in AIRIMP (FF Number, Credit Card Number, etc.).

infant.title: Each Passenger may carry one and only one Passenger
infant.description: Reference to Passenger instance within the context of one message, associating an infant on lap to the adult passenger.

offeredService.title: Each Offered Service may be offered one or more Offered Passengers
offeredService.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

paxIdentifier.title: Passenger.Passenger Identifier
paxIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies a Passenger within the context of one message.

paxSharingPref.title: Each Passenger may is associated to one and only one Passenger Sharing Preference
paxSharingPref.description: A passengers order sharing preferences. This will be used to identify a Passenger's sharing preference. The passenger can request that his/her information is not shared with other passengers in the same order. Additionally the passenger can be in a requested selected group of passengers whom wish to not share with the remaining passengers in the booking . E.g could be a group of a family members in a larger group booking.

profileConsentInd.title: Passenger.Profile Consent Indicator
profileConsentInd.description: When TRUE, passenger authorizes the airline to share his/her profile information or send promotional emails.

Pax.service.title: Each Passenger may have one or more Services
Pax.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

Pax.langUsage.title: Each Passenger may supplies one or more Language Usages

Pax.promotion.title: Each Passenger must have one and only one Promotion
Pax.promotion.description: An Information item related to publicizing a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

Pax.ptcCode.title: Passenger.PTC Code
Pax.ptcCode.description: Type code applying to the Passenger which typically drives pricing. For example: ADT, CHD.

Pax.birthdate.title: Passenger.Birthdate
Pax.birthdate.description: Date of birth of the Passenger.

PaxGroup.title: Passenger Group
PaxGroup.description: A number of individual passengers traveling under one commercial name that associates them. E.g. a Tour group or a group for sales allotment from airline to agency. Group bookings are subject to special booking rules and may be eligible for special fare rules. Usage and nature of groups is left to bilateral agreements.

intendedPaxQty.title: Passenger Group.Intended Passenger Quantity
intendedPaxQty.description: Intended number of passengers for this Group.

PaxGroup.orderItem.title: Each Passenger Group may have an associated one and only one Order Item
PaxGroup.orderItem.description: An individually priced item within an Order, made up of one or more Services. May or may not be a selected Offer Item (e.g. non-chargeable Services available on request such as a wheelchair).

PaxGroup.order.title: Each Passenger Group must have one and only one Order
PaxGroup.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

PaxJourney.title: Passenger Journey
PaxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

paxJourneyIdentifier.title: Passenger Journey.Passenger Journey Identifier
paxJourneyIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies a Passenger Journey within the context of one message.

PaxLeg.title: Passenger Leg
PaxLeg.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Leg.

paxLegIdentifier.title: Passenger Leg.Passenger Leg Identifier
paxLegIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies a Passenger Leg within the context of one message.

PaxSegment.title: Passenger Segment
PaxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

arnkInd.title: Passenger Segment.ARNK Indicator
arnkInd.description: When TRUE, indicates an ARNK (ARrival uNKown) condition, i.e. a gap between current segment departure and previous segment arrival location, implying an unknown passenger movement.

boardingPass.title: Each Passenger Segment must apply to at least one Boarding Passs
boardingPass.description: Boarding pass is a type of accountable document which is used electronically or physically as proof of authorisation/authentication of right to board a flight.

checkInSeqNumber.title: Passenger Segment.Check In Sequence Number
checkInSeqNumber.description: This is the check in sequence number for a passenger on a passenger segment

marketingCarrierRbd.title: Each Marketing Carrier RBD Passenger Segment may have one and only one Marketing Carrier RBD Passenger Segment
marketingCarrierRbd.description: A categorization used to facilitate access to inventory, application of filed fares, and to identify cabin entitlement. For example: 'J' for Business Class Premium, 'D' for Business Discounted.

nonFlightService.title: Each Non-flight Service may have one or more Non Flight Service Passenger Segments
nonFlightService.description: A reference to the details of this Service. May include either Passenger Journeys, a Service Definition, or a Selected Seat.

operatingCarrierRbd.title: Each Operating Carrier RBD Passenger Segment may have one and only one Operating Carrier RBD Passenger Segment
operatingCarrierRbd.description: A categorization used to facilitate access to inventory, application of filed fares, and to identify cabin entitlement. For example: 'J' for Business Class Premium, 'D' for Business Discounted.

paxSegmentIdentifier.title: Passenger Segment.Passenger Segment Identifier
paxSegmentIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies a Passenger Segment within the context of one message.

PaxSegment.paxJourney.title: Each Passenger Segment must be part of one and only one Passenger Journey
PaxSegment.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

PaxSegment.coupon.title: Each Passenger Segment must have one and only one Sold Airline Information
PaxSegment.coupon.description: A portion of the Passenger Ticket and Baggage Check or Excess Baggage Ticket that indicates particular places between which the coupon is good for carriage.

PaxSharingPref.title: Passenger Sharing Preference
PaxSharingPref.description: A passengers order sharing preferences. This will be used to identify a Passenger's sharing preference. The passenger can request that his/her information is not shared with other passengers in the same order. Additionally the passenger can be in a requested selected group of passengers whom wish to not share with the remaining passengers in the booking . E.g could be a group of a family members in a larger group booking.

sharingInd.title: Passenger Sharing Preference.Sharing Indicator
sharingInd.description: Identifies if the passenger wants to stop sharing his data with the other passengers not in his group, possible values are True or False to let the airline to decide (or not) to split the order.

sharingPartyIdentifier.title: Passenger Sharing Preference.Sharing Party Identifier
sharingPartyIdentifier.description: Identifies a group of multiple passengers share a sharing preference.

PaxStandardWeights.title: Passenger Standard Weights
PaxStandardWeights.description: An approved passenger standard weights to be used for weight and balance calculation.

handBaggageWeightMeasure.title: Passenger Standard Weights.Hand Baggage Weight Measure
handBaggageWeightMeasure.description: Standard weight of hand baggage (hand baggage is not considered for infant).

paxStandardsWeightsVariationCode.title: Passenger Standard Weights.Passenger Standards Weights Variation Code
paxStandardsWeightsVariationCode.description: Variation code. For example: Standard, Domestic, International, Charter.

undisclosedGenderWeightMeasure.title: Passenger Standard Weights.Undisclosed Gender Weight Measure
undisclosedGenderWeightMeasure.description: Standard weight of an undisclosed gender.

unspecifiedGenderWeightMeasure.title: Passenger Standard Weights.Unspecified Gender Weight Measure
unspecifiedGenderWeightMeasure.description: Standard weight of an unspecified gender.

PaxStatus.title: Passenger Status
PaxStatus.description: A status of a passenger at a particular time during a process.

boardingStatusCode.title: Passenger Status.Boarding Status Code
boardingStatusCode.description: Code of the passenger's boarding status.

securityProfileStatusInd.title: Passenger Status.Security Profile Status Indicator
securityProfileStatusInd.description: Indicates a passenger may be subject to more extensive security check and is at increased risk to no-show for flight.

PaxStatusCode.title: Passenger Status_ Code
PaxStatusCode.description: This defines pre boarding passenger statuses.

PaxStatusCodeEnum.title: Passenger Status Code
PaxStatusCodeEnum.description: This is defined by PSIB Passenger Status Information For Boarding code list. This specifies the different passenger statuses pre boarding.

PaxTrimOutputRequirement.title: Passenger Trim Output Requirement
PaxTrimOutputRequirement.description: A requirement to put specific passenger trim output on the load sheet.

paxTrimOutputRequirementTrimTypeCode.title: Passenger Trim Output Requirement.Passenger Trim Output Requirement Trim Type Code
paxTrimOutputRequirementTrimTypeCode.description: Trim Type code. For example: Class trim, Cabin area trim, Seat row trim.

PaxTrimOutputRequirement.remark.title: Each Passenger Trim Output Requirement may supplies one or more Remarks
PaxTrimOutputRequirement.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

PayCardDateText.title: Pay Card Date_ Text
PayCardDateText.description: BDT used to define card issue/expiry dates in a 4N format.

Payer.title: Payer
Payer.description: A role which provides Payment Card details and commits the payment for the Offer(s) they wish to purchase. The Payment can take place either before or after the Order has been created.

PaymentAddressVerification.title: Payment Address Verification
PaymentAddressVerification.description: A Secure Payment-related Processing information, including AVS/ CVV Verification Results and Secure Payment Processing Results.

addressVerificationInvalidInd.title: Payment Address Verification.Address Verification Invalid Indicator
addressVerificationInvalidInd.description: When true, the specified address was invalid.

addressVerificationNoMatchInd.title: Payment Address Verification.Address Verification No Match Indicator
addressVerificationNoMatchInd.description: When true, the specified address could not be matched with issuing bank address on record.

addressVerificationStatusCode.title: Payment Address Verification.Address Verification Status Code
addressVerificationStatusCode.description: Address verification response code (AVS) when the ticketing agency performs address verification. For example: X - Match: Street address and 9-digit ZIP code both match Y - Match: Street address and 5-digit ZIP code both match A - Partial Match: Street address matches, but both 5-digit and 9-digit ZIP Code do not match W - Partial Match: Street address does not match, but 9-digit ZIP code matches Z - Partial Match: Street address does not match, but 5-digit ZIP code matches N - No Match: Street address, 5-digit ZIP code, and 9-digit ZIP code all do not match U - System Unavailable: Address information unavailable. Returned if non-US. AVS is not available or if the AVS in a U.S. bank is not functioning properly. R - System Unavailable: Retry - Issuer's System Unavailable or Timed Out. E - Invalid: AVS data is invalid S - Not Supported: U.S. issuing bank does not support AVS.

PaymentAddressVerification.postalAddress.title: Each Payment Address Verification must have one and only one Postal Address
PaymentAddressVerification.postalAddress.description: A natural or physical address used for postal service. May be a building address, airport address, etc.

PaymentApprovalCodeEnum.title: Payment Approval Code
PaymentApprovalCodeEnum.description: Approval Code Method. Example: M (Manual) Note: This is used to specify how the approval code for a credit card sale was obtained.

PaymentCard.title: Payment Card
PaymentCard.description: A device that enables its owner (the cardholder) to make a payment by electronic funds transfer.

approvalTypeCode.title: Payment Card.Approval Type Code
approvalTypeCode.description: Used to specify how the approval code for a credit card sale was obtained. For example: M (Manual). This is used to specify how the approval code for a credit card sale was obtained. Encoding Scheme: IATA PADIS Code List for data element 9890.

cardBrandCode.title: Payment Card.Card Brand Code
cardBrandCode.description: A two-letter code assigned according to IATA Resolution 728. For example: VI for Visa

cardHolderContactInfo.title: Each Payment Card may supplies one and only one Contact Information
cardHolderContactInfo.description: An electronic or geographic address which a party has provided as the contact channel. For example, contact email, contact postal address, contact phone number.

cardNumber.title: Payment Card.Card Number
cardNumber.description: Card number indicated on the payment card.

cardProductTypeCode.title: Payment Card.Card Product Type Code
cardProductTypeCode.description: Used to specify whether the card is a Consumer (personal) or Commercial (corporate) card.

cardSecurityCode.title: Payment Card.Card Security Code
cardSecurityCode.description: 3-digit number printed on the signature panel on the back of the card and following the last four digits of the Primary Account Number (PAN). For American Express, 4 digits located on the front of the card, above the card number on the right hand side. Visa - CVV2, MasterCard - CVC2, American Express - CID, Discover - CMID, Union Pay - CVN2, JCB - CAV2.

cardSecurityCodeCryptographyKey.title: Each Card Security Code Payment Card may is used to encrypt the Card Security Code in one and only one Card Security Code Payment Card
cardSecurityCodeCryptographyKey.description: An encryption key identification. Includes the name of a cryptographic key which is being used to encrypt data in the current context of usage.

cardSeqNumber.title: Payment Card.Card Sequence Number
cardSeqNumber.description: Number displayed on a payment card following the card number which indicates if the card is an original or if it was re-issued with the same card number.

cardTypeText.title: Payment Card.Card Type Text
cardTypeText.description: Magenetic striped card type. For example: Debit, Credit.

cryptographyKey.title: Each Payment Card may can be applied to one and only one Cryptography Key
cryptographyKey.description: An encryption key identification. Includes the name of a cryptographic key which is being used to encrypt data in the current context of usage.

protectedCardIdentifier.title: Payment Card.Protected Card Identifier
protectedCardIdentifier.description: Payment card number protected in a non format preserving fashion.

reconciliationIdentifier.title: Payment Card.Reconciliation Identifier
reconciliationIdentifier.description: Identifies the individual for this specific transaction when the card is shared - perhaps a corporate card. This ID is typically used for payment reconciliation.

securePayerAuthentication.title: Each Payment Card may resulting in one and only one Secure Payer Authentication
securePayerAuthentication.description: A set of indicators and fields that convey the result of the 3D Secure authentication transaction. Applicable for 3D Secure Version V 1.0.

secureProgram.title: Each Payment Card may belongs to one and only one Secure Program
secureProgram.description: A container of enrolment information of the Payment Card e.g. Verified by Visa.

sellerOwnCardInd.title: Payment Card.Seller Own Card Indicator
sellerOwnCardInd.description: When TRUE, indicates the seller is using their own card. If FALSE, customer card is being used.

PaymentCard.expirationDate.title: Payment Card.Expiration Date
PaymentCard.expirationDate.description: Last month of validity For example: 0119.

PaymentCardCriteria.title: Payment Card Criteria
PaymentCardCriteria.description: A set of Payment card specific filter criteria for shopping requests, including card issuer type and identification number.

cardIssuingCountryCode.title: Payment Card Criteria.Card Issuing Country Code

cardTypeCode.title: Payment Card Criteria.Card Type Code
cardTypeCode.description: Two letter payment card type. For example: MC, VI.

chargeAmount.title: Payment Card Criteria.Charge Amount
chargeAmount.description: Monetary amount intended to be paid on this payment card type.

chargePercent.title: Payment Card Criteria.Charge Percent
chargePercent.description: Percent of the total Offer price amount intended to be paid on this payment card type.

iinNumber.title: Payment Card Criteria.IIN Number
iinNumber.description: Payment card IIN/BIN number. For example: 401123. This is the first 6 digits of a credit card number known as the Issuer Identification Number, previously known as Bank Identification Number (BIN), which identifies the institution that issued the card.

PaymentCardNumber.title: Payment Card_ Number
PaymentCardNumber.description: Data type for Payment Card Number.

PaymentInfo.title: Payment Information
PaymentInfo.description: An information related to the settlement of a transaction through monetary or other compensations. For example, a payment may be applied to an entire Order or individual Order Items.

paymentInfoIdentifier.title: Payment Information.Payment Information Identifier
paymentInfoIdentifier.description: Uniquely identifies payment information within a message.

paymentRefIdentifier.title: Payment Information.Payment Reference Identifier
paymentRefIdentifier.description: If creating the order after payment authorization it is a way of linking an order to an existing payment reference. not triggering the whole process again.

paymentStatusCode.title: Payment Information.Payment Status Code
paymentStatusCode.description: Indicates the current status of this payment information.

priceVarianceAmount.title: Payment Information.Price Variance Amount
priceVarianceAmount.description: Price variance amount applied during Payment processing.

surchargeAmount.title: Payment Information.Surcharge Amount
surchargeAmount.description: Amount added to the final Offer/Order price, depending on which payment method is used by the client.

verificationInd.title: Payment Information.Verification Indicator
verificationInd.description: When true, this payment requires additional authentication.

PaymentInfo.desc.title: Each Payment Information may have one and only one Description
PaymentInfo.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

PaymentInfo.amount.title: Payment Information.Amount
PaymentInfo.amount.description: Amount applied to the associated payment method. For example: 300 USD.

PaymentInfo.promotion.title: Each Payment Information may is subject to one or more Promotions
PaymentInfo.promotion.description: An Information item related to publicizing a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

PaymentMethod.title: Payment Method
PaymentMethod.description: A form of procedure for the payment of goods or services, plus any transactional information specific to the payment method other than the amount.

accountableDoc.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Accountable Document
accountableDoc.description: A Form of payment which utilizes a previously issued accountable travel document (ticket, EMD, coupon, etc.) which has an outstanding credit value.

bankTransfer.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Bank Transfer
bankTransfer.description: A Bank Account payment method definition. Customer bank accounts for payments, either for paper checks or electronic funds transfer.

check.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Check
check.description: A written order instructing a financial institution to pay immediately on demand a specified amount of money from the check writer's account to the person named on the check or, if a specific person is not named, to whoever bears the check to the institution for payment.

fundsTransfer.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Funds Transfer
fundsTransfer.description: An amount of money moved from one financial account to another.

voucher.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Voucher
voucher.description: A document that entitles the holder to a discount or that may be exchanged for goods or services.

PaymentMethod.shoppingCriteria.title: Each Payment Method must have one and only one FOP Criteria
PaymentMethod.shoppingCriteria.description: A set of criteria which qualifies the flight request by influencing which results are returned in the shopping response, including preferred or required criteria.

PaymentMethod.directBill.title: Each Payment Method may is a one and only one Direct Bill
PaymentMethod.directBill.description: A system in which a corporation's travel agency bills employees for their business travel. The employee must then submit an expense accounting and be reimbursed by the corporation.
