PaymentMethod.eWallet.title: Each Commitment To Pay must is a one and only one Commitment To Pay
PaymentMethod.eWallet.description: A payment that is facilitated through virtual wallet, where the paying party has deposited funds and the payee is receiving the payment from the wallet rather than the party committing to the payment.

PaymentMethod.cash.title: Each Commitment To Pay must is a one and only one Commitment To Pay
PaymentMethod.cash.description: A payment that is collected by the agent and settled between the Airline and the agent. Refer to IATA Resolution 728 Attachment A for full details.

PaymentMethodCode.title: Payment Method_ Code
PaymentMethodCode.description: Additional BDT to specify payment method code.

PaymentMethodCodeEnum.title: Payment Method Code
PaymentMethodCodeEnum.description: The form of payment type. Examples: Credit Card, Cash.

PaymentMethodCriteria.title: Payment Method Criteria
PaymentMethodCriteria.description: A form of procedure for the payment of goods or services, plus any transactional information specific to the payment method other than the amount.

iataEasyPayCriteria.title: Each Payment Method Criteria may supplies one and only one IATA Easy Pay
iataEasyPayCriteria.description: An IATA EasyPay is a payment instrument with a specific remittance mechanism. This FOP is not limited to BSP.

PaymentStatusCodeEnum.title: Payment Status Code
PaymentStatusCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for payment status codes. Valid Values: ACCEPTED - The commitments to pay was accepted./At the Payment Level to indicate that a payment has been authorized, etc. or the status in not needed; ALLOCATED - The value of compensation was allocated to the corresponding Order Item.; CLOSED - The payment process was done.; COMMITTED - The payer has committed to pay the compensation./When NDC indicates that part of a payment is to be applied to an order item; RECEIVED - The compensation was received./ The actual receipt of funds is a function of the accounting system, or it it expected that the revenue accounting system will update the order when the bank transmits funds to the airline? Don't think we need this.; REFUNDED - The compensation was transfered back to the payer./When an order item is cancelled or changed, we expect that any payments applied to the item will be un-applied. this leaves a credit balance on the order that can be applied to a new item of refunded.; SENT - The compensation was transfered.

PaymentTimeLimit.title: Payment Time Limit
PaymentTimeLimit.description: A time limit used to indicate by when payment commitment must be received for confirmed Order Item in an Order. To indicate instant payment, the duration field should be populated with a value of 0. If no value is returned, then no advice has been given.

PaymentTimeLimit.duration.title: Payment Time Limit.Duration
PaymentTimeLimit.duration.description: Duration from the Order creation date by which payment commitment is required for a given Order Item. For example: PaymentTimeLimitDuration: 'PT48H3M6S' shows the amount of time after Order is created/changed that payment commitment must be made for a given Order Item. PaymentTimeLimitDuration: 'PT0H0M0S' indicates instant payment is required for a given Order Item.

PaymentTrx.title: Payment Transaction
PaymentTrx.description: A set of Additional identification and URLs used to further describe a secure payment transaction.

inputCurCode.title: Payment Transaction.Input Currency Code
inputCurCode.description: Input Payment Currency code. For example: USD.

maximumTryInd.title: Payment Transaction.Maximum Try Indicator
maximumTryInd.description: When TRUE, the maximum payment authentication attempts have been exceeded.

notProcessedInd.title: Payment Transaction.Not Processed Indicator
notProcessedInd.description: When TRUE, the payment information has not been processed.

originalIdentifier.title: Payment Transaction.Original Identifier
originalIdentifier.description: Identifier of the original transaction that initiated this Traveler authentication. For example: TRN12345.

retryInd.title: Payment Transaction.Retry Indicator
retryInd.description: When TRUE, the payment transaction should be present.

settlementCurCode.title: Payment Transaction.Settlement Currency Code
settlementCurCode.description: Settlement payment currency code. For example: CHF.

trxIdentifier.title: Payment Transaction.Transaction Identifier
trxIdentifier.description: Globally unique ID for a transaction processing instance.

trxTypeText.title: Payment Transaction.Transaction Type Text
trxTypeText.description: 3D Secure Transaction Type. For example: Authorize: Authorize amount (no funds transferred) Complete: Complete a previous authorization (funds are transferred) Purchase: Purchase (funds are transferred immediately) Refund: Refund (funds transferred immediately) Validate: Validation Transaction (a small authorized transaction amount to validate card details including expiry date and address).

PaymentTrx.descText.title: Payment Transaction.Description Text
PaymentTrx.descText.description: Transaction description information. For example: Air Fare Two PAX.

Penalty.title: Penalty
Penalty.description: A fee or penalty for failure to meet agreed conditions. Information related to a punishment imposed for breaking a law, rule, or contract.

cancelFeeInd.title: Penalty.Cancel Fee Indicator
cancelFeeInd.description: When TRUE, Cancellation fee(s) may apply.

changeFeeInd.title: Penalty.Change Fee Indicator
changeFeeInd.description: When TRUE, Change of Itinerary fee(s) may apply.

netInd.title: Penalty.Net Indicator
netInd.description: Airline informs the seller if the penalty is netted (True) (i.e. taken from any amount that airline will owe to customer consequently to the servicing) or to be paid (False) (i.e. charged to customer upfront any servicing action, and even if customer benefits from a subsequent refund/ residual value).

penaltyIdentifier.title: Penalty.Penalty Identifier
penaltyIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of this Penalty instance.

upgradeFeeInd.title: Penalty.Upgrade Fee Indicator
upgradeFeeInd.description: When TRUE, Upgrade fee(s) may apply.

Penalty.typeCode.title: Penalty.Type Code
Penalty.typeCode.description: Penalty type information. For example: Cancellation, Change, NoShow, Upgrade, Other.

Penalty.offer.title: Each Penalty must apply to one and only one Offer
Penalty.offer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

Penalty.orderItem.title: Each Penalty must have one and only one Order Item
Penalty.orderItem.description: An individually priced item within an Order, made up of one or more Services. May or may not be a selected Offer Item (e.g. non-chargeable Services available on request such as a wheelchair).

Penalty.amount.title: Penalty.Amount
Penalty.amount.description: Penalty monetary value amount and currency code.

Penalty.appCode.title: Penalty.Application Code
Penalty.appCode.description: Penalty application type. For example: ADE (After departure), NOS (No show), PDE (Prior to departure).

Penalty.percent.title: Penalty.Percent
Penalty.percent.description: Percentage Value relating to acceptable the total amount by which the Order item price can vary; OR the amount of a penalty. For example: 20 USD, 2 Percent.

Penalty.fareDetail.title: Each Penalty may be associated to one or more Fare Details
Penalty.fareDetail.description: An amount charged by the carrier for the carriage of a passenger and his allowable free baggage.

PenaltyTypeCodeEnum.title: Penalty Type Code
PenaltyTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set values for Penalty Type. Valid Values: Cancellation - Cancellation; Change - Change; NoShow - NoShow; Other - Other; Upgrade - Upgrade

Percent.title: Percent
Percent.description: A percent is a value representing a fraction of one hundred,expressed as a quotient.

Phone.title: Phone
Phone.description: A telephone number is a sequence of digits assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other private networks.

areaCodeNumber.title: Phone.Area Code Number
areaCodeNumber.description: Phone number area code. For example: 813. Note: The phone number can be put unstructured into the phone element or can be put structured into country dialing code, area code, phone number and extension.

extensionNumber.title: Phone.Extension Number
extensionNumber.description: Phone extension number. For example: 1234. Note: The phone number can be put unstructured into the phone element or can be put structured into country dialing code, area code, phone number and extension.

Phone.phoneNumber.title: Phone.Phone Number
Phone.phoneNumber.description: Phone number text. For example: +1 999-999-9999 ext 1234, 617-9976. Note: This may be a simple, un-structured phone number, such as +01 999-999-9999 ext 1234 or combined with additional attributes country dialing code, area code and extension to create a structured phone number.

PieceAllowance.title: Piece Allowance
PieceAllowance.description: An allowance of the maximum number of each allowable baggage type.

pieceDimensionAllowance.title: Each Piece Allowance may can have one or more Dimension Allowances
pieceDimensionAllowance.description: A Baggage dimension allowance with application information.

pieceWeightAllowance.title: Each Piece Allowance may can have one or more Weight Allowances
pieceWeightAllowance.description: A baggage weight allowance with application information.

PieceAllowance.typeText.title: Piece Allowance.Type Text
PieceAllowance.typeText.description: Type of bag. For example: Golf Equipment, Fishing Bag, Car Seat.

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description: A message policy information, including PCI, PII information.

policyNodeInfo.title: Each Policy must supplies at least one Policy Node Informations
policyNodeInfo.description: A policy data node detail, including an XPATH and associated Tag Name.

Policy.desc.title: Each Policy may be associated with one or more Descriptions
Policy.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

Policy.typeText.title: Policy.Type Text
Policy.typeText.description: Policy Type, For example: Policy Type. For example: Privacy_PII, Payment_PCI, Credentialing.

PolicyNodeInfo.title: Policy Node Information
PolicyNodeInfo.description: A policy data node detail, including an XPATH and associated Tag Name.

PolicyNodeInfo.pathText.title: Policy Node Information.Path Text
PolicyNodeInfo.pathText.description: Message property location using XPATH syntax.

Pos.title: POS
Pos.description: An information identifying the location and other attributes of the entity performing transactions. Point of sale may be considered by some systems when making inventory and availability decisions.

agentDutyText.title: POS.Agent Duty Text
agentDutyText.description: Internally defined agent authority to request changes.

onlineTrxInd.title: POS.Online Transaction Indicator
onlineTrxInd.description: Indicator to flag if this is an online transaction, it could be used to refer to the Point of Sales, which could be an online platform.

requestTime.title: POS.Request Time
requestTime.description: Point of sale timestamp value. For example: 2017-01-13T13:59:38Z. Note: This may be used if the point of sale time zone differs from the message creation timestamp.

Pos.country.title: Each POS may supplies one and only one Country
Pos.country.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

PosCode.title: POS_ Code
PosCode.description: Further defines the type of PointOfSaleCode.

PosCodeEnum.title: POS Code
PosCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values of Point of Sale Code. Valid Values: A - Airline Specific Codes; H - Home IATA Agency No.; I - IATA Travel Agency No.; L - LNIATA Number (CRT Address); T - Pseudo Code/Travel Agency Code; U - Home Travel Agency Code; V - CRS/CXR Department Code; X - Department/Identifier

PosFilterCriteria.title: POS Filter Criteria
PosFilterCriteria.description: A criteria used to filter results based on point of sale information.

posCodeText.title: POS Filter Criteria.POS Code Text
posCodeText.description: Code or identifier of the entity defined by the Point of Sale Type Code. For example: CRS code, Airline specific code.

posTypeCode.title: POS Filter Criteria.POS Type Code
posTypeCode.description: Further defines the types of Point of Sale.

PosFilterCriteria.aggregator.title: Each POS Filter Criteria may have one and only one Aggregator
PosFilterCriteria.aggregator.description: An organization that distributes a seller's shopping request to multiple airlines and aggregates subsequent responses. For example: Farelogix.

PostalAddress.title: Postal Address
PostalAddress.description: A natural or physical address used for postal service. May be a building address, airport address, etc.

buildingRoomText.title: Postal Address.Building Room Text
buildingRoomText.description: Additional address information including building name, room, apartment, or suite number.

poBoxCode.title: Postal Address.PO Box Code
poBoxCode.description: Post office box. For example: P.O. Box 21.

PostalAddress.cash.title: Each Postal Address may have one or more Collection Addresss
PostalAddress.cash.description: A payment that is collected by the agent and settled between the Airline and the agent. Refer to IATA Resolution 728 Attachment A for full details.

PotableWaterDistribution.title: Potable Water Distribution
PotableWaterDistribution.description: A distribution of potable water to each individually specified potable water tank or to all tanks. Water can be specified as follows: - Weight per tank, with corresponding index. - Distribution: For a given total water weight, specify the quantity in each tank - Specific water weights, with corresponding index. - Adjustment (from full) e.g. full water included in basic weight.

potableWaterDistributionCode.title: Potable Water Distribution.Potable Water Distribution Code
potableWaterDistributionCode.description: Name/identifier of the potable water distribution. For example: 'Long Haul', 'Short Haul', '75% Water', '1/4','1/2','3/4','0','200'.

PotableWaterDistribution.remark.title: Each Potable Water Distribution may supplies one or more Remarks
PotableWaterDistribution.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

PotableWaterDistribution.dowConfiguratio.title: Each Potable Water Distribution may be associated to one or more DOW Configurations
PotableWaterDistribution.dowConfiguratio.description: An Identification of operational items such as crew, pantry, potable water and/or service weight adjustments and their weight and/or index influence that are included in the Dry Operating Weight of an aircraft or aircraft group.

PotableWaterDistributionElement.title: Potable Water Distribution Element
PotableWaterDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a potable water distribution.

tankWeightMeasure.title: Potable Water Distribution Element.Tank Weight Measure
tankWeightMeasure.description: Weight adjustment of water in the specified potable water tank.

PotableWaterTank.title: Potable Water Tank
PotableWaterTank.description: A tank of potable water located in the cabin.

PotableWaterTank.name.title: Potable Water Tank.Name
PotableWaterTank.name.description: Name or description of the potable water tank.

PotableWaterTank.balanceArmForwardMeasur.title: Potable Water Tank.Balance Arm Forward Measure
PotableWaterTank.balanceArmForwardMeasur.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft datum to the forward edge of the specified tank location. Used when graphical representation of each specified tank location is available in the supplier's departure control system.

PotableWaterTank.lateralArmCentroidMeasu.title: Potable Water Tank.Lateral Arm Centroid Measure
PotableWaterTank.lateralArmCentroidMeasu.description: Lateral position of the water tank. Used when potable water lateral imbalance influence is required to be calculated.

PotableWaterTank.maximumWeightMeasure.title: Potable Water Tank.Maximum Weight Measure
PotableWaterTank.maximumWeightMeasure.description: Maximum weight of water permitted in the specified tank.

PotableWaterTank.weightUnitIndexValue.title: Potable Water Tank.Weight Unit Index Value
PotableWaterTank.weightUnitIndexValue.description: Index influence of one weight unit (as defined under aircraft units) of potable water weight located at that location.

PrefLevel.title: Preference Level
PrefLevel.description: An Information supporting some shopping filter criteria, including preference level code (e.g. Preferred, Exclude, etc.).

prefContextText.title: Preference Level.Preference Context Text
prefContextText.description: Preference level context. For example: MyContext.

prefLevelCode.title: Preference Level.Preference Level Code
prefLevelCode.description: Preference level code. For example: Preferred, Required, Exclude, Other.

PrefLevel.flightCriteria.title: Each Preference Level may have one and only one Wait List Criteria

PrefLevel.keyValueProperty.title: Each Preference Level must be defined by one and only one Key Value Property
PrefLevel.keyValueProperty.description: A contextual information to further describe something using a key-value pair.

PrefLevelCode.title: Preference Level_ Code
PrefLevelCode.description: Level of preference requested. Examples: Preferred, Required, or Exclude.

PrefLevelCodeEnum.title: Preference Level Code
PrefLevelCodeEnum.description: Level of preference requested. Examples: Preferred, Required, or Exclude. Valid Values: Exclude - Exclude; Preferred - Preferred; Required - Required

PrePaidCertificate.title: Pre-Paid Certificate
PrePaidCertificate.description: An account which provides access to a pre-paid certificate document with a financial value and validity period.

PresenceTypeCodeEnum.title: Presence Type Code
PresenceTypeCodeEnum.description: Presence Type Code Valid Values: CN - Customer not present; CP - Customer present -> (e.g. for non-PaymentCard payment methods); CPCN - Customer present and card not present; CPCP - Customer present and card present

Price.title: Price
Price.description: An amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

baseAmount.title: Price.Base Amount
baseAmount.description: Total Base Fare Amount. For example: 200000.

baseAmountGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.title: Price.Base Amount Guarantee Time Limit Date Time
baseAmountGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.description: Length of time the Base Amount of an offer item is guaranteed. In the absence of the Base Amount guarantee time limit, the Base Amount is not guaranteed. Note: Upon expiry, the Base Amount may no longer be guaranteed and either a new shopping process should begin, or the offer should be repriced resulting in a new Offer. Should the Base Amount guarantee time limit extend beyond Order creation, the remaining length of time persists into the corresponding Order Item. The airline can increase the remaining length of time beyond the original time limit should they wish to. This attribute should only be used when the Airline indicates that a Price Guarantee is available.

equivAmount.title: Price.Equivalent Amount
equivAmount.description: Entire amount of transaction stated in the local currency at the point of sale, or the currency as defined by the Currency Indicator Code.

loyaltyUnitAmount.title: Price.Loyalty Unit Amount
loyaltyUnitAmount.description: Amount specified in loyalty units. Note: the 'Currency Code' sup for this BDT should not be populated.

loyaltyUnitName.title: Price.Loyalty Unit Name
loyaltyUnitName.description: Name of the loyalty unit used by the loyalty unit amount (For example: miles or points).

markup.title: Each Price may have one or more Markups
markup.description: A definition of the reason for the markup added by an airline as part of the offer reported as calculation detail. The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit. [Oxford]

maskedInd.title: Price.Masked Indicator
maskedInd.description: Indicator to advise the Seller if the price will be masked to the Customer.

Price.offer.title: Each Price must apply to one and only one Total Price
Price.offer.description: A proposal to sell a specific set of products or Services under specific conditions, for a certain price. Can be the response to a shopping request.

Price.service.title: Each Price must have one and only one Internal Value
Price.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

Price.order.title: Each Price must have one and only one Total Price
Price.order.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

Price.aLaCarteOfferItem.title: Each Price must have one and only one Unit Price
Price.aLaCarteOfferItem.description: A Container of one Service (excluding flights) or Service Bundle which is priced per unit. A La Carte Offer Items are optional, and the quantities of these can be selected for any of the eligible passengers and segments.

Price.fareDetail.title: Each Price must be associated to one and only one Price
Price.fareDetail.description: An amount charged by the carrier for the carriage of a passenger and his allowable free baggage.

PriceClass.title: Price Class
PriceClass.description: A price point within a particular Cabin Type (sometimes referred to as 'Fare Families').

displayOrderText.title: Price Class.Display Order Text
displayOrderText.description: Airline requested default display order (in a client application) for this price class. For example: 2.

fareBasisAppText.title: Price Class.Fare Basis Application Text
fareBasisAppText.description: Fare basis application. For example: Requested, Ticketed, Other.

priceClassIdentifier.title: Price Class.Price Class Identifier
priceClassIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies a Price Class within the context of one message.

PriceClass.name.title: Price Class.Name
PriceClass.name.description: Price class name. For example: SUPERSAVER.

PriceClass.desc.title: Each Price Class may be associated with one or more Descriptions
PriceClass.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

PriceClass.code.title: Price Class.Code
PriceClass.code.description: Price class code. For example: 1, ABC.

PriceQuote.title: Price Quote
PriceQuote.description: A pricing history information for a given Order.

priceQuoteOwnerCode.title: Price Quote.Price Quote Owner Code
priceQuoteOwnerCode.description: Airline code assigned to a carrier. Either ICAO-defined 3-character code or IATA-defined 2-character code.

quoteDateTime.title: Price Quote.Quote Date Time
quoteDateTime.description: Date time information related to the Price Quote.

sourceText.title: Price Quote.Source Text
sourceText.description: ID or name of the source of this Transaction ID. For example: UA, ABC123. Note: If this is an Airline ID, please use 'Owner Code'.

PriceVarianceRule.title: Price Variance Rule
PriceVarianceRule.description: A Price Variance rule supports specifying Payment Processing Rules, including payment failure. Acceptable amount and/or percentage of the total amount by which the Order item price can vary. Example: 20 USD, 2 Percent.

acceptableVarianceAmount.title: Price Variance Rule.Acceptable Variance Amount
acceptableVarianceAmount.description: Acceptable amount by which the price at time of payment can vary. For example: 20 USD

acceptableVariancePercent.title: Price Variance Rule.Acceptable Variance Percent
acceptableVariancePercent.description: Acceptable percent by which the price at time of payment can vary. For example: 2 percent

ruleIdentifier.title: Price Variance Rule.Rule Identifier
ruleIdentifier.description: Rule ID assigned by the owner. For example: PRICERULE001.

ruleName.title: Price Variance Rule.Rule Name
ruleName.description: Rule Name. For example: Acceptable Price variance.

PriceVarianceRule.remark.title: Each Price Variance Rule may supplies one or more Remarks
PriceVarianceRule.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

PriceVarianceRule.ownerName.title: Price Variance Rule.Owner Name
PriceVarianceRule.ownerName.description: Entity that owns/ assigned this Rule. If this is an airline, the IATA Airline Designator Code should be used.

PriceVarianceRule.paymentInfo.title: Each Price Variance Rule must have one and only one Payment Information
PriceVarianceRule.paymentInfo.description: An information related to the settlement of a transaction through monetary or other compensations. For example, a payment may be applied to an entire Order or individual Order Items.

PricingParameter.title: Pricing Parameter
PricingParameter.description: A set of Pricing Parameters, including Simple Pricing, Award Travel, Auto Exchange, Override Currency and Tax Exemption.

autoExchInd.title: Pricing Parameter.Auto Exchange Indicator
autoExchInd.description: When TRUE, this request is to be handled by an auto-exchange process.

awardIncludedInd.title: Pricing Parameter.Award Included Indicator
awardIncludedInd.description: When TRUE, award eligible offers to be returned in addition to priced offers.

awardOnlyInd.title: Pricing Parameter.Award Only Indicator
awardOnlyInd.description: When TRUE, only award eligible offers are requested.

simplePricingInd.title: Pricing Parameter.Simple Pricing Indicator
simplePricingInd.description: When TRUE, simple pricing is requested for returned offers.

taxExemption.title: Each Pricing Parameter may supplies one or more Tax Summaries

Printer.title: Printer
Printer.description: A device for printing text or pictures or barcodes, especially one linked to a computer.

ProcessingInstructions.title: Processing Instructions
ProcessingInstructions.description: An Information related to the processing options

clearanceCount.title: Processing Instructions.Clearance Count
clearanceCount.description: count of the clearances that are transmitted in a batch.

rejectEveryClearanceInd.title: Processing Instructions.Reject Every Clearance Indicator
rejectEveryClearanceInd.description: Indicates if every single Clearance shall be rejected if one Clearance does not pass validation. This indicator has two possible values: TRUE meaning that every single Clearance must be rejected even if only one does not pass validation, and FALSE meaning that only the Clearances that do not pass validation are rejected. It is optional data element and when it is not present it will mean that the Settlement Manager will reject only the clearances that failed validation. If this indicator is included in the clearance request from the carrier then it must be included in all messages thereafter where it is provided as an option.

ProductDetailsCode.title: Product Details_ Code
ProductDetailsCode.description: Business data type for Product Details as per PADIS Codeset.

ProductDetailsCodeEnum.title: Product Details Code
ProductDetailsCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Product Details Code BDT.

ProgamContract.title: Progam Contract
ProgamContract.description: An agreement which provides access to discounted or negotiated prices.

ProgramAccount.title: Program Account
ProgramAccount.description: An account which provides access to discounted or negotiated prices.

ProgramCriteriaSet.title: Program Criteria Set
ProgramCriteriaSet.description: A set of Discount program specific filter criteria for shopping requests.

companyIndexText.title: Program Criteria Set.Company Index Text
companyIndexText.description: Company profile index associated with this special fare. For example: COM1234.

memberStatusText.title: Program Criteria Set.Member Status Text
memberStatusText.description: Member or participant status within the program. For example: VP, Director, Exec).

prePaidCertificate.title: Each Program Criteria Set may supplies one or more Pre-Paid Certificates
prePaidCertificate.description: An account which provides access to a pre-paid certificate document with a financial value and validity period.

progamContract.title: Each Program Criteria Set may supplies one and only one Progam Contract
progamContract.description: An agreement which provides access to discounted or negotiated prices.

programAccount.title: Each Program Criteria Set may supplies one or more Program Accounts
programAccount.description: An account which provides access to discounted or negotiated prices.

ProgramCriteriaSet.typeCode.title: Program Criteria Set.Type Code
ProgramCriteriaSet.typeCode.description: Program type code. For example: Discount Program, Incentive Program, Pre-paid Program.

ProgramCriteriaSet.carrier.title: Each Program Criteria Set may own one and only one Carrier
ProgramCriteriaSet.carrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

ProgramCriteriaSet.org.title: Each Program Criteria Set may own one and only one Organization
ProgramCriteriaSet.org.description: An organized structure set up for a particular purpose, such as a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution. Business Identifier Fields: - Organization Identifier

Promotion.title: Promotion
Promotion.description: An Information item related to publicizing a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

promotionIdentifier.title: Promotion.Promotion Identifier
promotionIdentifier.description: Promotion code ID or number. For example: PROMO123. Used in conjunction with Link (Promotion URL), Issuer (Promotion Owner or Sponsor) and Remarks (Promotion remarks).

promotionIssuer.title: Promotion Issuer
promotionIssuer.description: An organization that offers the promotion to a market place.

Promotion.remark.title: Each Promotion may supplies one or more Remarks
Promotion.remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

Promotion.shoppingCriteria.title: Each Promotion must have one and only one Promotion Criteria
Promotion.shoppingCriteria.description: A set of criteria which qualifies the flight request by influencing which results are returned in the shopping response, including preferred or required criteria.

ProperName.title: Proper_ Name
ProperName.description: BDT with value constraints for proper, regular names (e.g. Individual Surname, Individual First Name, Company Name, etc.).

PtcOfferParameters.title: PTC Offer Parameters
PtcOfferParameters.description: A Passenger Type summary information for an offer.

pricedPaxNumber.title: PTC Offer Parameters.Priced Passenger Number
pricedPaxNumber.description: Number of Passenger(s) for associated passenger type. For example: 2.

ptcOfferParametersPricedCode.title: PTC Offer Parameters.PTC Offer Parameters Priced Code
ptcOfferParametersPricedCode.description: Actual passenger type code used for pricing. For example: ADT

ptcRequestedCode.title: PTC Offer Parameters.PTC Requested Code
ptcRequestedCode.description: Requested passenger type code for pricing. For example: CHD. Encoding scheme: IATA (three character) Passenger Type Code.

requestedPaxNumber.title: PTC Offer Parameters.Requested Passenger Number
requestedPaxNumber.description: Number of Passenger(s) for associated passenger type. For example: 2.

Qty.title: Quantity
Qty.description: A quantity is a counted number of non-monetary units, possibly including fractions

Rate.title: Rate
Rate.description: A rate is a quantity, amount, frequency, or dimensionless factor, measured against an independent base unit, expressed as a quotient.

baseMultiplierValue.title: Rate.Base Multiplier. Value
baseMultiplierValue.description: The multiplier of the Rate. Base Unit, Code or Rate. Base Currency. Code

baseUnitCode.title: Rate.Base Unit. Code
baseUnitCode.description: The unit of measure of the denominator

multiplierValue.title: Rate.Multiplier. Value
multiplierValue.description: The multiplier of the Rate. Unit. Code or Rate. Currency. Code

Rate.format.title: Rate.Format
Rate.format.description: Whether the number is an integer, decimal, real number or percentage

Rate.unitCode.title: Rate.Unit. Code
Rate.unitCode.description: The unit of measure of the numerator

Ratio.title: Ratio
Ratio.description: A ratio is a relation between two independent quantities, using the same unit of measure or currency.

Rbd.title: RBD
Rbd.description: A categorization used to facilitate access to inventory, application of filed fares, and to identify cabin entitlement. For example: 'J' for Business Class Premium, 'D' for Business Discounted.

marketingCarrierRbdPaxSegment.title: Each Marketing Carrier RBD Passenger Segment may be related to one or more Marketing Carrier RBDs
marketingCarrierRbdPaxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

operatingCarrierRbdPaxSegment.title: Each Operating Carrier RBD Passenger Segment may be related to one or more Operating Carrier RBDs
operatingCarrierRbdPaxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

rbdCode.title: RBD.RBD Code
rbdCode.description: Code used to identify a particular RBD. For example: P, J, W, M.

Rbd.typeCode.title: RBD.Type Code
Rbd.typeCode.description: RBD type as defined by PADIS code list for data element 7009.

Rbd.originDest.title: Each RBD may have one and only one Origin Destination
Rbd.originDest.description: An Origin and Destination airport/city pair which confines a passenger journey or an aircraft flight.

RbdCode.title: RBD_ Code
RbdCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the RBD as defined in AIRIMP and SSIM.

RbdCodeEnum.title: RBD Code
RbdCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values of RBD Codes as per PADIS codeset 9800.

ReasonForIssuanceCode.title: Reason For Issuance_ Code
ReasonForIssuanceCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the reason for issuance code.

ReasonForIssuanceCodeEnum.title: Reason For Issuance Code
ReasonForIssuanceCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Reason for Issuance codes.

ReasonForIssuanceSubCode.title: Reason For Issuance Sub_ Code
ReasonForIssuanceSubCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the reason for issuance sub code.

ReasonForIssuanceSubCodeEnum.title: Reason For Issuance Sub Code
ReasonForIssuanceSubCodeEnum.description: Enumeration values for Reason for Issuance sub codes. Examples: 0CC (First Checked Bag) 0B1 (In-flight Entertainment) 0BX (Lounge) 0B3 (Meal/ Beverage) 0B5 (Pre-reserved Seat Assignment) 0G6 (Priority Boarding)

ReconciliationIdentifier.title: Reconciliation_ Identifier
ReconciliationIdentifier.description: Reconciliation Identifier that is provided by the Party (Payer or Payee) of the Clearance to support internal reconciliation process. Once provided it is included in all communications thereafter.

RedressCase.title: Redress Case
RedressCase.description: A registration of an individual with a country's redress program.

redressCaseIdentifier.title: Redress Case.Redress Case Identifier
redressCaseIdentifier.description: A unique government-issued identifier assigned to a redress case.

RedressCase.individual.title: Each Redress Case must involve one and only one Individual
RedressCase.individual.description: An individual human being as distinct from a group, class, or family.

RedressCase.pax.title: Each Redress Case may be declared by one or more Passengers
RedressCase.pax.description: An individual, except members of the crew, carried or to be carried with the consent of the carrier, on board any transport vehicle such as aircraft, train, bus, ship.

RedressCase.redressProgram.title: Each Redress Case must cover one and only one Redress Program
RedressCase.redressProgram.description: A country's redress program, which can be used to eliminate watch list misidentification and assist in identity verification.

RedressIdentifier.title: Redress_ Identifier
RedressIdentifier.description: A unique TSA-issued number that helps eliminate watch list misidentification and verify identity.

RedressProgram.title: Redress Program
RedressProgram.description: A country's redress program, which can be used to eliminate watch list misidentification and assist in identity verification.

RedressProgram.name.title: Redress Program.Name
RedressProgram.name.description: Name of the redress program. For example: Secure Flight Program.

RedressProgram.country.title: Each Redress Program must be operated by one and only one Country
RedressProgram.country.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

Refund.title: Refund
Refund.description: A collection of information containing refund type, payment type and amount attributes for a specific product, purpose, or service.

fixedAmount.title: Refund.Fixed Amount
fixedAmount.description: Stores an exact fixed fee amount relating to this condition.

levelTypeCode.title: Refund.Level Type Code
levelTypeCode.description: This will identify the type of re-fundability for the condition. Allowable values: Fully Refundable, Partly Refundable, Non Refundable.

paymentTypeCode.title: Refund.Payment Type Code
paymentTypeCode.description: Form of payment to be used to reimburse the customer/passenger.

RejectEveryClearanceInd.title: Reject Every Clearance_ Indicator
RejectEveryClearanceInd.description: string that Indicates how clearances shall be rejected during validation.

Remark.title: Remark
Remark.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

displayInd.title: Remark.Display Indicator
displayInd.description: When TRUE, this remark should be displayed. Notes: 1. This capability may not be supported by all NDC-enabled systems or may be supported by bilateral agreement only. The technical implementation of this capability is not dictated by this specification.

Remark.aircraft.title: Each Remark may have one and only one Aircraft
Remark.aircraft.description: A transport vehicle which is certified as airworthy by a competent aeronautical authority.

Remark.deck.title: Each Remark may have one and only one Deck
Remark.deck.description: A structural floor level. For aircraft having one structural level only, this floor level shall be referred to as the main deck. For aircraft having more than one structural floor level, the different floor levels shall be referred to as 'lower deck', 'main deck' and 'upper deck', starting from bottom to top.

Remark.dowItem.title: Each Remark may have one and only one DOW Item
Remark.dowItem.description: An Item that can be considered as part of the Dry Operating Weight buildup of an aircraft or aircraft group as per company specifications e.g. Basic Weight, Flight Deck Crew, Cabin Crew, Flight Deck Crew Baggage, Cabin Crew Baggage, Pantry, Containers, Pallets, Potable Water, Library, ... Other items are included in the total traffic load weight.

Remark.supplementaryInfoRequirement.title: Each Remark may have one and only one Supplementary Information Requirement
Remark.supplementaryInfoRequirement.description: A requirement to add specific data to the supplementary information (SI) area of each applicable load sheet (provisional, final, ACARS,...).

Remark.swa.title: Each Remark may have one and only one SWA
Remark.swa.description: A service weight adjustment. Standard adjustment to the service weight of an aircraft with optional balance arm and/or index.

Remark.responseParameters.title: Each Remark may have one and only one Marketing Message
Remark.responseParameters.description: An information related to how response results should be returned.

Remark.promotion.title: Each Remark may have one and only one Promotion
Remark.promotion.description: An Information item related to publicizing a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

ReportingTypeCode.title: Reporting Type_ Code
ReportingTypeCode.description: BDT for Reporting Type Code BBIE.

ReportingTypeCodeEnum.title: Reporting Type Code
ReportingTypeCodeEnum.description: Contains the levels of re fundability FULL PARTIAL NONE Valid Values: Airline - Airline; ARC - ARC; BSP - BSP; Not applicable - Not Applicable

ResChangeInfo.title: Reservation Change Information
ResChangeInfo.description: A reservation change information which describes new flight information as it relates to a changed reservation.

resStatusCode.title: Reservation Change Information.Reservation Status Code
resStatusCode.description: Reservation Status Code of the 'Reservation Change' flight.

ResponseParameters.title: Response Parameters
ResponseParameters.description: An information related to how response results should be returned.

curParameter.title: Each Response Parameters may supplies one or more Currency Parameters
curParameter.description: A currency related parameters intended to influence which currency the shopping results are displayed in.

inventoryGuaranteeInd.title: Response Parameters.Inventory Guarantee Indicator
inventoryGuaranteeInd.description: When TRUE, inventory guarantee is requested for applicable optional services.

marketingMessage.title: Each Response Parameters may supplies one or more Remarks
marketingMessage.description: An additional, supplementary information about the document or service.

measurementSystemCode.title: Response Parameters.Measurement System Code
measurementSystemCode.description: Measurement system code. For example: Imperial, Metric.

ResponseParameters.bdc.title: Each Response Parameters may be performed in respect of one and only one BDC
ResponseParameters.bdc.description: An information for use in NDC Interline: The carrier whose baggage allowances and charges apply.

ResponseParameters.deviceLocation.title: Each Response Parameters may associates one and only one Device Location
ResponseParameters.deviceLocation.description: A geographical location of a device of interaction. For example: of a computer, mobile phone, or Agent Terminal.

ResponseParameters.langUsage.title: Each Response Parameters may supplies one or more Language Usages

ResponseParameters.device.title: Each Response Parameters may Supplies one and only one Device
ResponseParameters.device.description: A device upon which the secure transaction will occur.

ResponseParameters.pricingParameter.title: Each Response Parameters may supplies one and only one Pricing Parameter
ResponseParameters.pricingParameter.description: A set of Pricing Parameters, including Simple Pricing, Award Travel, Auto Exchange, Override Currency and Tax Exemption.

ResponseParameters.reasonCode.title: Response Parameters.Reason Code
ResponseParameters.reasonCode.description: Should be used for the seller to communicate the reason for cancellation to the Seller and for the Airline to respond with advice on the cancellation request. Uses PADIS REA Codeset.

RunningLoadLimitation.title: Running Load Limitation
RunningLoadLimitation.description: A maximum load acceptable on any given fuselage length of the aircraft floor. Can apply to a specific deck or to all decks at a given location.

limitWeightPerDistanceMeasure.title: Running Load Limitation.Limit Weight Per Distance Measure
limitWeightPerDistanceMeasure.description: Maximum load permitted per unit of linear dimension.

RunningLoadLimitation.lengthUnitCode.title: Running Load Limitation.Length Unit Code
RunningLoadLimitation.lengthUnitCode.description: Length unit used for linear density calculation. When missing the standard aircraft length unit is used.

RunningLoadLimitationTable.title: Running Load Limitation Table
RunningLoadLimitationTable.description: A set of related running load limitations.

SaleableConfiguration.title: Saleable Configuration
SaleableConfiguration.description: A planned utilization layout of aircraft cabin section/zone that is fit or able to be sold.

saleableConfigurationIdentifier.title: Saleable Configuration.Saleable Configuration Identifier
saleableConfigurationIdentifier.description: Identifies a saleable configuration. For example: P10J20Y52, 10P/20J/52Y, A01.

SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.title: Saleable Configuration Class Information
SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.description: A saleable configuration information by cabin type.

firstRowNumber.title: Saleable Configuration Class Information.First Row Number
firstRowNumber.description: Row number of the first seat row in the specified class.

lastRowNumber.title: Saleable Configuration Class Information.Last Row Number
lastRowNumber.description: Row number of the last seat row in the specified class.

SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.lateralAr.title: Saleable Configuration Class Information.Lateral Arm From Measure
SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.lateralAr.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the left hand edge of the cabin section at the specified class. Used when the graphical representation of each specified cabin section/class is available in the supplier's departure control system.

SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.lateralAr.title: Saleable Configuration Class Information.Lateral Arm To Measure
SaleableConfigurationClassInfo.lateralAr.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the right hand edge of the cabin section at the specified class. Used when the graphical representation of each specified cabin section/class is available in the supplier's departure control system.

SaleableConfigurationSection.title: Saleable Configuration Section
SaleableConfigurationSection.description: A cabin section information of a saleable configuration.

SaleableConfigurationSectionClassInfo.title: Saleable Configuration Section Class Information
SaleableConfigurationSectionClassInfo.description: A cabin section information of a saleable configuration by cabin type.

SalesTaxRegistration.title: Sales Tax Registration
SalesTaxRegistration.description: An Identification and contact information of a party purchasing goods or services as registered with a Purchase Tax.

cityName.title: Sales Tax Registration.City Name
cityName.description: Name, expressed as text, of the city, town or village.

countrySubDivisionName.title: Sales Tax Registration.Country Sub-Division Name
countrySubDivisionName.description: Name, expressed as text, of the sub-division of a country.

emailAddressText.title: Sales Tax Registration.Email Address Text
emailAddressText.description: Email address which should be used for contact purposes.

gstTaxInfoText.title: Sales Tax Registration.GST Tax Information Text
gstTaxInfoText.description: Goods and services tax information as passed as a string in EDIFACT. The data will be sent in this order separated by a / GST Number, country owning GST, business name, business address line 1, business address line 2, business address city, business address state or province or county, zip code or postal code, business phone number country, first business phone number, second business phone number, business email.

salesTaxRegistrationCountryCode.title: Sales Tax Registration.Sales Tax Registration Country Code
salesTaxRegistrationCountryCode.description: ISO Country Code (can be extended by bilateral agreement in case of exceptions like Kosovo). For example: US, FR.

salesTaxRegistrationIdentifier.title: Sales Tax Registration.Sales Tax Registration Identifier
salesTaxRegistrationIdentifier.description: Registered identifier of the business purchasing the goods and services. For example, a GST number in India XX.

salesTaxSpecification.title: Each Sales Tax Registration must relates to one and only one Sales Tax Specification
salesTaxSpecification.description: A tax imposed on retail products and services at the point of sale, usually as a percentage of the retail price. Known by different names around the world. For example: Sales Tax in the US, Value-Added Tax (VAT) in the UK, and Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India.

SalesTaxRegistration.org.title: Each Sales Tax Registration must be used by an one and only one Organization
SalesTaxRegistration.org.description: An organized structure set up for a particular purpose, such as a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution. Business Identifier Fields: - Organization Identifier

SalesTaxRegistration.tax.title: Each Sales Tax Registration may be associated to one and only one Tax
SalesTaxRegistration.tax.description: A compulsory contribution to state revenue, levied by the government on workers' income and business profits or added to the cost of some goods, services, and transactions.

SalesTaxRegistration.orgName.title: Sales Tax Registration.Organization Name
SalesTaxRegistration.orgName.description: Organization name purchasing the goods or services for which the GST registration applies.

SalesTaxRegistration.phoneNumber.title: Sales Tax Registration.Phone Number
SalesTaxRegistration.phoneNumber.description: Phone number text. For example: +1 999-999-9999 ext 1234, 617-9976. Note: This may be a simple, un-structured phone number, such as +01 999-999-9999 ext 1234 or combined with the additional attributes to create a structured phone number.

SalesTaxSpecification.title: Sales Tax Specification
SalesTaxSpecification.description: A tax imposed on retail products and services at the point of sale, usually as a percentage of the retail price. Known by different names around the world. For example: Sales Tax in the US, Value-Added Tax (VAT) in the UK, and Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India.

SalesTaxSpecification.name.title: Sales Tax Specification.Name
SalesTaxSpecification.name.description: Name of the tax specification. For example: India GST.

Scanner.title: Scanner
Scanner.description: A device that scans objects and converts them or extracts of them into digital data. Different types of scanner are a document scanner, a barcode reader and a biometric scanner.

ScreeningAlarmCode.title: Screening Alarm_ Code
ScreeningAlarmCode.description: The screening alarm code of the bag incident

ScreeningAlarmCodeEnum.title: Screening Alarm Code
ScreeningAlarmCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment A Screening Alarm Reason Codes Valid Values: C - combination of dark alarm and explosives; D - Dark alarm; E - Explosives; N - no decision; T - time out

ScreeningInstructionCode.title: Screening Instruction_ Code
ScreeningInstructionCode.description: The screening instruction code of the security control

ScreeningMethodCode.title: Screening Method_ Code
ScreeningMethodCode.description: The screening method code of the method interaction

ScreeningMethodCodeEnum.title: Screening Method Code
ScreeningMethodCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Recommendation 1745 Attachment A Screening Method Codes Valid Values: AT - Advanced Technology screening method; EBD - Explosive bulk detection screening method; ETD - Explosive trace detection screening method; HAND - Hand Search screening method; XRAY - X-ray screening method

Seat.title: Seat
Seat.description: A sitting place for a passenger located in the cabin.

Seat.shoppingCriteria.title: Each Seat must have one and only one Seat Criteria
Seat.shoppingCriteria.description: A set of criteria which qualifies the flight request by influencing which results are returned in the shopping response, including preferred or required criteria.

SeatCharacteristicCodeEnum.title: Seat Characteristic Code
SeatCharacteristicCodeEnum.description: Refers to aircraft seat characteristic codes e.g. A (Aisle seat), E (Exit and emergency exit). See PADIS code list 9825.

SeatIdentifier.title: Seat_ Identifier
SeatIdentifier.description: The seat identifier of the service offering

SeatOnLeg.title: Seat On Leg
SeatOnLeg.description: A sitting place for a passenger or crew in a cabin compartment on a Dated Operating Leg.

availableSeatSericeAssociation.title: Each Available Seat Serice Association may have one and only one Available Seat
availableSeatSericeAssociation.description: A reference to the details of this Service. May include either Passenger Journeys, a Service Definition, or a Selected Seat.

occupationStatusCode.title: Seat On Leg.Occupation Status Code
occupationStatusCode.description: Information related to the availability of a particular Seat on Leg.

selectedSeatSericeAssociation.title: Each Selected Seat Serice Association may have one and only one Selected Seat
selectedSeatSericeAssociation.description: A reference to the details of this Service. May include either Passenger Journeys, a Service Definition, or a Selected Seat.

SeatOnLeg.service.title: Each Seat On Leg may be delivered as one or more Selected Seats
SeatOnLeg.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

SeatProfile.title: Seat Profile
SeatProfile.description: An Airline defined characteristics shared by a group of seats.

marketingInfo.title: Each Seat Profile may have one or more one or more Media Objects
marketingInfo.description: An Electronic documents, images, and other files which accompany and support some information.

seatKeywords.title: Each Seat Profile may supplies one or more Key Value Properties
seatKeywords.description: A contextual information to further describe something using a key-value pair.

seatPitchMeasure.title: Seat Profile.Seat Pitch Measure
seatPitchMeasure.description: Measure of a given seat's pitch.

seatProfileIdentifier.title: Seat Profile.Seat Profile Identifier
seatProfileIdentifier.description: Unique identifier associated to this Seat Profile.

seatWidthMeasure.title: Seat Profile.Seat Width Measure
seatWidthMeasure.description: Measure of a given seat's width.

SeatProfile.desc.title: Each Seat Profile may supplies one or more Descriptions
SeatProfile.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

SeatRow.title: Seat Row
SeatRow.description: A row of passenger seats located in the cabin.

firstRowSeatRow.title: Each First Row Seat Row must be part of one and only one First Row
firstRowSeatRow.description: A physical aircraft compartment where passenger seats are installed, classified by a given Cabin Type. These compartments are typically defined based on fare paid or facilities and services offered.

firstSeatRowCabinCompartment.title: Each First Seat Row Cabin Compartment must be the first row of seats in one and only one First Seat Row
firstSeatRowCabinCompartment.description: A Non-seat related cabin feature or facility (e.g. lavatory, galley, closet, stowage, etc.)

lastRowSeatRow.title: Each Last Row Seat Row must be part of one and only one Last Row
lastRowSeatRow.description: A physical aircraft compartment where passenger seats are installed, classified by a given Cabin Type. These compartments are typically defined based on fare paid or facilities and services offered.

lastSeatRowCabinCompartment.title: Each Last Seat Row Cabin Compartment must be the last row of seats in one and only one Last Seat Row
lastSeatRowCabinCompartment.description: A Non-seat related cabin feature or facility (e.g. lavatory, galley, closet, stowage, etc.)

maximumSeatsQty.title: Seat Row.Maximum Seats Quantity
maximumSeatsQty.description: Maximum number of seats that exist at the specified row. Where convertible seats exist, define the maximum possible passenger positions available.

rowCharacteristicCode.title: Seat Row.Row Characteristic Code
rowCharacteristicCode.description: Information and characteristics applying to a row of Passenger Seats. For example: XC - Exit Row, N - No Smoking Row.

rowNumber.title: Seat Row.Row Number
rowNumber.description: Ordinal number identifying a seat row in an aircraft.

SeatRowCharacteristicsCode.title: Seat Row Characteristics_ Code
SeatRowCharacteristicsCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the seat row characteristics code.

SeatRowCharacteristicsCodeEnum.title: Seat Row Characteristics Code
SeatRowCharacteristicsCodeEnum.description: Row characteristic. Examples: A (Extra Leg Room) B (Buffer Row) MV (Row With Movie Screen) Encoding Scheme: IATA PADIS Code List for data element 9864 - Row Characteristic

SeatStatusCode.title: Seat Status_ Code
SeatStatusCode.description: Additional BDT to specify the seat status code.

SeatStatusCodeEnum.title: Seat Status Code
SeatStatusCodeEnum.description: Seat status. Examples: SA (Seats are available) WO (Seats waitlist open for segment) WC (Seats waitlist closed for segment) OR (Seats on request only to airline)

SecurePayerAuthentication.title: Secure Payer Authentication
SecurePayerAuthentication.description: A set of indicators and fields that convey the result of the 3D Secure authentication transaction. Applicable for 3D Secure Version V 1.0.

payerAuthenticationResponseText.title: Secure Payer Authentication.Payer Authentication Response Text
payerAuthenticationResponseText.description: Authentication response for the 3-D Secure transaction. It is used to determine whether or not the customer has been authenticated by the card issuer. It must be included in the final authorization request. For example: eJzVWFmzosgSfudXdPQ8Gt1sbkzYRhQ7KCjI/sYOsimgoL/+lp7Tp5c5t2d67tMw8yv/WqiluJXS8WyyVFEQT28qz.

SecurePayerAuthenticationInstructions.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions
SecurePayerAuthenticationInstructions.description: A set of Data returned from the Directory Server/ACS containing the PAReq and the ACS URL that enable to cardholder to authenticate. Applicable for 3D Secure Version V 1.0. A container of enrolment information of the Payment Card e.g. Verified by Visa.

authenticationTrxIdentifier.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions.Authentication Transaction Identifier
authenticationTrxIdentifier.description: Unique 3D Secure transaction reference number assigned by Access Control System (ACS). For example: Qzl3WVc1TVpXNW5kR2crUEcxbGMzTmhaMlZK WkQ1UVFWSmxjUzB4TWpnNUSXcKTmprNU5EWThMMjFsYzNOaFoyVkpRDQ4TDAxRVBqd3ZVVEr. Note: This is typically required for ACS systems that support Status Query.

merchantDataText.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions.Merchant Data Text
merchantDataText.description: Containing merchant state data that must be returned to the merchant.

payerAuthenticationRequestText.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions.Payer Authentication Request Text
payerAuthenticationRequestText.description: Authentication request for the 3-D Secure transaction. When sending the customer's browser to the card issuer's ACS, the system will need to include the PaReq in the HTTPS POST. For example: eJzVWFmzosgSfudXdPQ8Gt1sbkzYRhQ7KCjI/sYOsimgoL/+lp7Tp5c5t2d67tMw8yv/WqiluJXS8WyyVFEQT28qz.

redirectionUrlUri.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions.Redirection URL URI
redirectionUrlUri.description: 3DS Access Control System URL. Note: This is the URL of the Issuing Bank's Access Control Server (ACS), to which the cardholder needs to be re-directed. The browser should simply redirect to this URL.

terminationUrlUri.title: Secure Payer Authentication Instructions.Termination URL URI
terminationUrlUri.description: URL to which the user will be directed to at the conclusion of 3D secure authentication. For example: http://ba.com/paymentResultSuccess.

SecurePayerAuthenticationInstructions.re.title: Each Secure Payer Authentication Instructions must have one and only one Response Parameters
SecurePayerAuthenticationInstructions.re.description: An information related to how response results should be returned.

SecureProgram.title: Secure Program
SecureProgram.description: A container of enrolment information of the Payment Card e.g. Verified by Visa.

enrollmentStatusText.title: Secure Program.Enrollment Status Text
enrollmentStatusText.description: 3D Secure Program Enrollment Status. For example: CardNotEnrolled, CardEnrolled, CardMayBeEnrolled, Unknown.

securePaymentProgramName.title: Secure Program.Secure Payment Program Name
securePaymentProgramName.description: Name of the secure payment program. For example: Verified by Visa.

SecurityControlNumber.title: Security Control_ Number
SecurityControlNumber.description: The security number of the security control.

SecurityControlSeqNumber.title: Security Control Sequence_ Number
SecurityControlSeqNumber.description: The sequence number of the security control.

SecurityScreeningInstructionCodeEnum.title: Security Screening Instruction Code
SecurityScreeningInstructionCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA recommended practice RP 1745 Attachment a screening instruction codes Valid Values: DEF - Default level of screening applies.; NON - No screening required conditional to applicable regulations.; PRE - Selected for increased level of screening; SEL - Selected for increased level of screening.

SecurityScreeningStatusCode.title: Security Screening Status_ Code
SecurityScreeningStatusCode.description: The security screening status code of the bag status

SecurityScreeningStatusCodeEnum.title: Security Screening Status Code
SecurityScreeningStatusCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA recommended practice RP 1745 Attachment a baggage security screening result codes Valid Values: CLR - Cleared, bag is cleared according to applicable regulations; REJ - Rejected, bag is rejected due to detected weapons, explosives or other dangerous devices; UCL - Unclear, bag is unclear due to indeterminate screening result

SegmentSecurityControl.title: Segment Security Control
SegmentSecurityControl.description: A set of principles or procedures according to which something is done on a particular segment of travel.

authorityToLoadInd.title: Segment Security Control.Authority To Load Indicator
authorityToLoadInd.description: Authority to load indicator of the security control. An authority security control is an official permission; sanction from a security context.

authorityToTransportInd.title: Segment Security Control.Authority To Transport Indicator
authorityToTransportInd.description: Authority to transport indicator of the security control. An authority security control is an official permission; sanction from a security context.

bagRemovalRequestIdentifier.title: Segment Security Control.Bag Removal Request Identifier
bagRemovalRequestIdentifier.description: A request by the airline to unload a loaded bag, Should be set with the authorization to load set to NO.

containerSealedInd.title: Segment Security Control.Container Sealed Indicator
containerSealedInd.description: Indicator of whether a container is sealed.

screeningInstructionCode.title: Segment Security Control.Screening Instruction Code
screeningInstructionCode.description: Screening Instruction of the security control. Security instruction control is a security control or a direction or order in a security context.

tagActiveInd.title: Segment Security Control.Tag Active Indicator
tagActiveInd.description: Indicator of whether the tag is active for use in all segments. The Tag becomes Active at the moment when the bag is accepted by the baggage system at the airport and bag is accepted from the security point of view.

SegmentSecurityControl.seqNumber.title: Segment Security Control.Sequence Number
SegmentSecurityControl.seqNumber.description: Sequence number of the security control.

SegmentSecurityControl.bagSegment.title: Each Segment Security Control must is refering to one and only one Segment Security
SegmentSecurityControl.bagSegment.description: A movement of a bag over a Dated Operating Segment.

SegmentServiceOffer.title: Segment Service Offer
SegmentServiceOffer.description: An offer that applies to a particular segment of travel.

baggageCabinType.title: Each Baggage Cabin Type Segment Service Offer may supplies one and only one Baggage Cabin Type Segment Service Offer
baggageCabinType.description: A classification of aircraft compartments offering a specific range and level of services. For example: business class, economy.

paxCabinType.title: Each Passenger Cabin Type Segment Service Offer may supplies one and only one Passenger Cabin Type Segment Service Offer
paxCabinType.description: A classification of aircraft compartments offering a specific range and level of services. For example: business class, economy.

seatIdentifier.title: Segment Service Offer.Seat Identifier
seatIdentifier.description: Seat number of this service offer. Not filled in when jump seat, which is identified through the Baggage Segment Exception.

SegmentServiceOffer.bagSegment.title: Each Segment Service Offer must have one and only one Service Offer
SegmentServiceOffer.bagSegment.description: A movement of a bag over a Dated Operating Segment.

SellerFollowUpAction.title: Seller Follow Up Action
SellerFollowUpAction.description: A seller followup action following involuntary change means a subsequent action required to an Order Item after a schedule change.

actionInd.title: Seller Follow Up Action.Action Indicator
actionInd.description: Action indicator at Order Item level with the following possible value. A 'true' value is returned when the follow-up action has not been completed. Absense of the indicator (or blank) means that there is no pending action.

actionTimeLimitDateTime.title: Seller Follow Up Action.Action Time Limit Date Time
actionTimeLimitDateTime.description: Point in date and time until the seller is allowed to take any FollowUpAction regarding an Order Item after a schedule change.

airlineContactUri.title: Seller Follow Up Action.Airline Contact URI

consequenceOfInactionCode.title: Seller Follow Up Action.Consequence Of Inaction Code
consequenceOfInactionCode.description: Impact of not taking any action by the seller after a schedule change by the airline. Allowable values: Auto-acceptance by airline, Auto-cancellation by airline.

sellerFollowUpActionCode.title: Seller Follow Up Action.Seller Follow Up Action Code
sellerFollowUpActionCode.description: A seller followup action following involuntary change at OrderItem level. Possible values: Accept Reshop, with ability to add optional FareWaiver Cancel, with ability to add optional FareWaiver Contact Airline with the ability to include an option URL for the contact details.

SellerFollowupActionCodeEnum.title: Seller Followup Action Code
SellerFollowupActionCodeEnum.description: Seller Followup Action Code Valid Values: Accept - Accept; Cancel - Cancel, with ability to add optional FareWaiver; Contact Airline - Contact Airline with the ability to include an option URL for the contact details.; Reshop - Reshop, with ability to add optional FareWaiver

Service.title: Service
Service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

accountingCode.title: Service.Accounting Code
accountingCode.description: Grouping of services might be mapped to RFIC.

accountingSubCode.title: Service.Accounting Sub Code
accountingSubCode.description: Service identifier might be mapped to RFISC.

bookingStatusCode.title: Service.Booking Status Code
bookingStatusCode.description: Indicates the current status of a Service booking.

componentService.title: Each Compound Service may be broken down into one or more Compound Services
componentService.description: At time of Order Creation, an Offered Service can become multiple services within the Order Item as the service is broken down per segment and passenger.

compoundService.title: Each Compound Service may be grouped together as one and only one Component Service
compoundService.description: At time of Order Creation, an Offered Service can become multiple services within the Order Item as the service is broken down per segment and passenger.

deliveryCode.title: Service.Delivery Code
deliveryCode.description: Grouping of services on delivery aspects.

deliveryMilestoneCode.title: Service.Delivery Milestone Code
deliveryMilestoneCode.description: Records an event in the lifecycle of a service delivery that may or may not occur independently of a change of service status. For example: passenger boarded, passenger accepted airside, bag loaded or offloaded. Exploratory functionality.

deliveryProvider.title: Each Service may be fulfilled by one and only one Delivery Provider
deliveryProvider.description: An entity responsible for delivery of a good or Service. ---------- An organization responsible for delivery of a good or Service.

deliveryStatusCode.title: Service.Delivery Status Code
deliveryStatusCode.description: Indicates the current status of a Service delivery.

deliveryStatusDescText.title: Service.Delivery Status Description Text
deliveryStatusDescText.description: To allow passing information in addition to Service Delivery Status.

dependeeService.title: Each Dependent Service may depend on one and only one Dependent Service

Service.typeText.description: Information about the type of service.

Service.actionCode.title: Service.Action Code

availableSeat.title: Each Available Seat Serice Association may offers one and only one Available Seat Serice Association

flightServicePaxSegment.title: Each Flight Service may is delivered as one and only one Flight Service
flightServicePaxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

nonFlightServicePaxSegment.title: Each Non-flight Service may is associated with one and only one Non-flight Service
nonFlightServicePaxSegment.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

ServiceAssociations.paxJourney.title: Each Flight Service may is offered as one and only one Flight Service
ServiceAssociations.paxJourney.description: A collection of segments which satisfies transportation of a passenger for a given origin and destination.

ServiceBookingStatusCodeEnum.description: The possible status of a booking of a service item. Valid Values: CONFIRMED - Inventory owner confirms he is able to provide the Service.; REQUESTED - OM requests the Service from the Inventory owner.

ServiceBundle.title: Service Bundle
ServiceBundle.description: A set of services offered for sale as a single service.

maximumServiceQty.title: Service Bundle.Maximum Service Quantity
maximumServiceQty.description: Maximum number of service definitions that may be selected from those in the bundle.

ServiceCriteria.description: A reason for Issuance Group and Subgroup code(s) that specify the requested categories of Optional Services to be returned in the results.

includeInd.title: Service Criteria.Include Indicator
includeInd.description: When TRUE, specified service should be included in search results. When FALSE, exclude shopping results including the specified service.

ServiceDefinition.title: Service Definition
ServiceDefinition.description: A description and characteristics of a non-flight product or service that can be separately sold and delivered. E.g. bag, seat, meal on a flight.

owner.title: Each Service Definition may is defined by one and only one Carrier
owner.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

serviceBundle.title: Each Service Definition may can be one and only one Service Bundle
serviceBundle.description: A set of services offered for sale as a single service.

serviceCode.title: Service Definition.Service Code
serviceCode.description: Airline specific service code which can be associated with the Reason for Issuance Sub Code. Sample implementer encoding: XLEG for Extra Leg Room Seat XBAG for Extra Bag

serviceDefinitionIdentifier.title: Service Definition.Service Definition Identifier
serviceDefinitionIdentifier.description: Uniquely Identifies a Service Definition within the context of one message.

ServiceDefinition.name.title: Service Definition.Name
ServiceDefinition.name.description: Service name. For example: Lounge Pass.

ServiceDefinition.service.title: Each Service Definition may describe one or more Services
ServiceDefinition.service.description: An instance of a specific flight or Service Definition as it has been offered (and eventually ordered and consumed) in the context of a specific Offer and/or Order.

ServiceDefinition.desc.title: Each Service Definition must be associated with at least one Descriptions
ServiceDefinition.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

ServiceDefinition.transportServiceLeg.title: Each Service Definition may have one or more Inflight Services
ServiceDefinition.transportServiceLeg.description: A section of a transport service from one station to the next.

ServiceDeliveryStatusCode.title: Service Delivery Status_ Code
ServiceDeliveryStatusCode.description: Represents the current status of a service delivery item

ServiceDeliveryStatusCodeEnum.title: Service Delivery Status Code
ServiceDeliveryStatusCodeEnum.description: Shows the possible statuses of a service delivery item. Valid Values: DELIVERED - Service has been successfully delivered.; EXPIRED - Service is no longer available for delivery. Service purchased with an associated time limit for consumption and Service was never claimed. Service having been at least Confirmed is no longer available as the Customer did not claim the Service within a specific time period, as dictated by the Airline.; FAILED TO DELIVER - Service could not be delivered due to Airline's or provider limitations.; IN PROGRESS - The DP is in the process of delivering the Service. There is a universal concept that the 'In progress' status may block any further financial transactions; e.g. refund; NOT CLAIMED - The Service has not been claimed by the Passenger for reasons as a result of Passenger action or inaction. e.g. Passenger no-show, etc.; READY TO DELIVER - Provider is in a position to start delivery of the Service.; READY TO PROCEED - OM is in a position to allow a DP to prepare the Service. Customer is entitled to receive the Service. This is typically a trigger for ORA to begin accounting process.; REMOVED - Service was deleted.; SUSPENDED - Delivery of the Service is suspended as a result of an Airline decision. Can only revert back to the previous status. Exception is that Suspended may go to Removed. This status may be used in case of fraud detection.; UNABLE TO DELIVER - It is not possible for the DP to deliver a Service. This could be for reasons of availability, legal or regulatory constraint.

ServiceFeature.title: Service Feature
ServiceFeature.description: A Bilaterally agreed mechanism to deliver service specific information to the Seller as defined by the Airline. This defines a further level of definition for a service taxonomy code. e.g meal (TC 03F0) -> breakfast(03F1) - eggs(03F2),toast(03F3)

codesetCode.title: Service Feature.Codeset Code
codesetCode.description: Defines the codeset code that is being used in each entry related to the specified codeset defined.

codesetNameCode.title: Service Feature.Codeset Name Code
codesetNameCode.description: Defines the codeset that is being used in each entry to define the codeset code and the associated value text.

ServiceFeature.valueText.title: Service Feature.Value Text
ServiceFeature.valueText.description: Textural description associated to the codeset code for a given defined codeset.

ServiceStatusCode.title: Service Status_ Code
ServiceStatusCode.description: Represents the current status of a service item

ServiceStatusCodeEnum.title: Service Status Code
ServiceStatusCodeEnum.description: The statuses of a service item. Valid Values: CONFIRMED - Delivery provider (cabin crew) is in a position to start delivery of the Service.; DELIVERED - Service delivery successfully completed by the Delivery Provider.; EXPIRED - The service was delivered partially; FAILED TO DELIVER - Delivery of the service failed. For example, the passenger was denied boarding.; IN PROGRESS - Service delivery by delivery provider is in progress.; LOCKED - Order Management system blocked the Delivery Provider from Delivering the Service previously Ordered or the Service Delivery was interrupted. The delivery may resume in the future.; NOT CLAIMED - Customer did not claim the service delivery as expected by the Delivery Provider (e.g. no show).; READY TO DELIVER - Provider is in a position to start delivery of the service.; READY TO PROCEED - Airline is in a position to start delivery of the Service, or in a position to allow a Delivery Provider to prepare the service; REMOVED - Service delivery successfully completed by the Delivery Provider to the passenger on-board.; REQUESTED - Service is ready to be ordered from the Delivery Provider. (I.e. it has not been ordered as yet!).; SUSPENDED - Delivery provider was successfully informed about the service he has to deliver.

ServiceTaxonomy.description: An informational object used in the context of the Industry Service Category Taxonomy to define a Service to the Seller or to request a collection of Services from an Airline.

serviceFeature.title: Each Service Taxonomy may be further defined by one or more Service Features

ServiceTaxonomy.aLaCarteOfferItem.title: Each Service Taxonomy may define one and only one A La Carte Offer Item
ServiceTaxonomy.aLaCarteOfferItem.description: A given offer item may be defined by Service taxonomies. e.g 03EA WIFI, 03F0 Meal etc which will apply at the offer level

netClearanceAmount.title: Settlement Data.Net Clearance Amount
netClearanceAmount.description: Funds to be cleared as a result of the payment commitment, the selected payment method, and the date when the funds must be remitted. It is the amount the Clearance Payer must pay to the Clearance Payee on a given Remittance Date taking into consideration any funds due to the Clearance Payer by the Clearance Payee as a result of the same payment commitment.

oraNetPayableAmount.title: Settlement Data.ORA Net Payable Amount

oraNetReceivableAmount.title: Settlement Data.ORA Net Receivable Amount

remittanceDate.title: Settlement Data.Remittance Date

SettlementData.cash.title: Each Settlement Data must have one and only one Cash
SettlementData.cash.description: A payment that is collected by the agent and settled between the Airline and the agent. Refer to IATA Resolution 728 Attachment A for full details.

baggagePricingCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one and only one Baggage Pricing Criteria
