cabinTypeCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one and only one Cabin Type
cabinTypeCriteria.description: A classification of aircraft compartments offering a specific range and level of services. For example: business class, economy.

fopCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one or more Payment Methods
fopCriteria.description: A form of procedure for the payment of goods or services, plus any transactional information specific to the payment method other than the amount.

paymentCardCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one or more Payment Card Criterias
paymentCardCriteria.description: A set of Payment card specific filter criteria for shopping requests, including card issuer type and identification number.

promotionCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one and only one Promotion

seatCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one or more Seats

specialNeedsCriteria.title: Each Shopping Criteria may is part of one and only one Special Service

tripPurposeCode.title: Shopping Criteria.Trip Purpose Code

ShoppingCriteria.programCriteriaSet.title: Each Shopping Criteria may supplies one or more Program Criteria Sets
ShoppingCriteria.programCriteriaSet.description: A set of Discount program specific filter criteria for shopping requests.

ShoppingResponse.title: Shopping Response

SpecialLoadLimitation.title: Special Load Limitation
SpecialLoadLimitation.description: A limitation of the quantity of a specified special load for a specific hold or position.

specialLoadLimitationSpecialLoadCode.title: Special Load Limitation.Special Load Limitation Special Load Code

SpecialLoadLimitation.maximumQty.description: Maximum quantity of the specified special load for the nominated Position/hold.

specialServiceCode.title: Special Service.Special Service Code

SpecialService.qty.description: A quantity is a counted number of non-monetary units, possibly including fractions.

maximumFlapsSettingValue.title: STAB Table.Maximum Flaps Setting Value
maximumFlapsSettingValue.description: Maximum value of the Flaps Setting range to which the specific stabilizer trim table applies.

maximumMacPercent.title: STAB Table.Maximum MAC Percent
maximumMacPercent.description: Maximum value of the %MAC range to which the specific stabilizer trim table applies.

maximumThrustRatingValue.title: STAB Table.Maximum Thrust Rating Value
maximumThrustRatingValue.description: Maximum value of the Thrust Rating range to which the specific stabilizer trim table applies.

minimumFlapsSettingValue.title: STAB Table.Minimum Flaps Setting Value
minimumFlapsSettingValue.description: Minimum value of the Flaps Setting range to which the specific stabilizer trim table applies.

minimumMacPercent.title: STAB Table.Minimum MAC Percent

minimumThrustRatingValue.title: STAB Table.Minimum Thrust Rating Value
minimumThrustRatingValue.description: Minimum value of the Thrust Rating range to which the specific stabilizer trim table applies.

stab.title: Each STAB Table must contains at least one STABs
stab.description: A stabilizer Trim Setting. The required position of the horizontal stabilizer depending on the aircrafts weight and center of gravity (%MAC/RC).

stopOverLocation.title: Each Stop Over Restrictions may has one or more Stop Over Locations

supplementaryInfoRequirementSupplementar.description: Supplementary Information item code. For example: Ballast fuel, Basic Index, Center of Gravity Limits - LAW, Fuel Density, LDM.

breakdown.title: Each Surcharge may have one or more Fees

SurfaceTransportIdentifier.title: Surface Transport_ Identifier

SurfaceTransportVehicle.title: Surface Transport Vehicle

carriageMediumCode.title: Surface Transport Vehicle.Carriage Medium Code
carriageMediumCode.description: Code of the carriage medium, that is, the type of transport vehicle.

surfaceTransportIdentifier.title: Surface Transport Vehicle.Surface Transport Identifier
surfaceTransportIdentifier.description: Identifier of the surface transport vehicle.

TailAssignment.actionCode.title: Tail Assignment.Action Code

addlTaxCode.title: Tax.Additional Tax Code

appTypeCode.title: Tax.Application Type Code

TaxiFuelProcedure.taxiFuelBurnOrder.description: A tank order for taxi fuel burn.

totalTaxAmount.title: Tax Summary.Total Tax Amount
totalTaxAmount.description: Total of all applicable tax amounts included in the price. If tax breakdowns are provided, this amount should match the sum of the tax breakdown amounts. Note: Tax information may be specified as a total tax amount, a total tax amount with associated tax breakdown or a combination of both.

TaxSummary.price.title: Each Tax Summary must be associated to one and only one Price
TaxSummary.price.description: An amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

TaxSummary.pricingParameter.title: Each Tax Summary must have one and only one Tax Exemption
TaxSummary.pricingParameter.description: A set of Pricing Parameters, including Simple Pricing, Award Travel, Auto Exchange, Override Currency and Tax Exemption.

TaxTypeCode.title: Tax Type_ Code
TaxTypeCode.description: Indicates the type of tax (e.g. Applied or Exempt).

TaxTypeCodeEnum.title: Tax Type Code
TaxTypeCodeEnum.description: Applied or Exempt Valid Values: Applied - Applied; Exempt - Exempt

Term.title: Term
Term.description: A condition under which an agreement is reached.

availablePeriod.title: Each Term must supplies one and only one Available Period
availablePeriod.description: An Earliest and Latest Period than an option is available or may be used.

orderingQty.title: Each Term must supplies one and only one Ordering Quantity

termIdentifier.title: Term.Term Identifier
termIdentifier.description: Unique identifier associated to a term instance.

Term.desc.title: Each Term may be described one and only one Description
Term.desc.description: An entity which is used to describe any connected entities.

Terminal.title: Terminal
Terminal.description: A departure and/or arrival building for aircraft, passengers or freight at a station for any transport mode.

iataTerminalCode.title: Terminal.IATA Terminal Code
iataTerminalCode.description: Code of the terminal infrastructure facility, as defined by IATA SSIM Appendix D. For example: '2W'.

Terminal.accessGate.title: Each Terminal may comprise one or more Access Gates
Terminal.accessGate.description: A gate that allows access to or exit from a path to a transport vehicle.

Terminal.checkInArea.title: Each Terminal may comprise one or more Check-In Areas
Terminal.checkInArea.description: A place provided where facilities exist enabling passengers and / or their luggage to be checked-in.

TerminalPier.title: Terminal Pier
TerminalPier.description: A raised structure, including bridge and building supports and walkways, typically supported by widely spread piles or pillars.

terminalPierIdentifier.title: Terminal Pier.Terminal Pier Identifier
terminalPierIdentifier.description: Identifier of the terminal pier infrastructure facility.

TerminalPierIdentifier.title: Terminal Pier_ Identifier
TerminalPierIdentifier.description: The terminal pier identifier of the infrastructure facility

TerminalSatellite.title: Terminal Satellite
TerminalSatellite.description: A section, open space, or building inside an airport terminal or at its periphery, providing access to the planes through gates.

terminalSatelliteIdentifier.title: Terminal Satellite.Terminal Satellite Identifier
terminalSatelliteIdentifier.description: Identifier of the terminal satellite infrastructure facility.

TerminalSatelliteIdentifier.title: Terminal Satellite_ Identifier
TerminalSatelliteIdentifier.description: The terminal Satellite identifier of the infrastructure facility

Text.title: Text
Text.description: Text is a character string such as a finite set of characters generally in the form of words of a language.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: An accountable document issued by or on behalf of a carrier which includes notices and the flight and passenger coupons.

connectedDocNumber.title: Ticket.Connected Document Number
connectedDocNumber.description: Ticket/ document number to which this document is connected.

docTypeCode.title: Ticket.Document Type Code
docTypeCode.description: Document type code as defined by PADIS 1001 (Document/ Message Name, coded).

exchReissueInd.title: Ticket.Exchange Reissue Indicator
exchReissueInd.description: When TRUE, the specified ticket/document number is on behalf of a document which has been exchanged or reissued.

presentCreditCardInd.title: Ticket.Present Credit Card Indicator
presentCreditCardInd.description: When TRUE, the credit/debit card used for purchase must be presented.

primaryDocInd.title: Ticket.Primary Document Indicator
primaryDocInd.description: When TRUE, this is the primary ticket/document number.

reportingTypeCode.title: Ticket.Reporting Type Code
reportingTypeCode.description: For billing and settlement purposes, each time a travel agent requests an airline to perform an action on a document (Issuance, Refund, Exchange), he needs to know how to reconcile this action (via BSP, ARC, directly by ORA, etc.).

routingCode.title: Ticket.Routing Code
routingCode.description: For EMD-A and EMD-S tickets with routing. Use 'D' if all board and off points are within the same country and 'I' if all board and of points are not within the same country. For EMD-S with no routing, do not use.

taxOnEmdInd.title: Ticket.Tax On EMD Indicator
taxOnEmdInd.description: When TRUE, a tax has been collected and is due to a local government from the validating carrier.

ticketFeeOwnerCode.title: Ticket.Ticket Fee Owner Code
ticketFeeOwnerCode.description: Airline code assigned to a carrier. Either ICAO-defined 3-character code or IATA-defined 2-character code.

ticketNumber.title: Ticket.Ticket Number
ticketNumber.description: Document number comprised of the airline code, form code, and serial number.

TicketDocInfo.title: Ticket Document Information
TicketDocInfo.description: An Information corresponding to a group of 1 to 4 Tickets for a single Origin Destination and a single Passenger.

bookingAgency.title: Each Booking Agency Ticket Document Information may be booked by one and only one Booking Agency Ticket Document Information
bookingAgency.description: A private retailer or public service that provides travel and tourism related services to the public on behalf of suppliers such as activities, airlines, car rentals, cruise lines, hotels, railways, travel insurance, and package tours.

bookletQty.title: Ticket Document Information.Booklet Quantity
bookletQty.description: Number of booklets issued for a given ticket/ document set.

endorsementText.title: Ticket Document Information.Endorsement Text
endorsementText.description: Endorsement and restriction information applied for this set of ticket / document information.

originalIssueInfo.title: Each Ticket Document Information may supplies one and only one Ticket Issuance Information
originalIssueInfo.description: An issuing carrier and issuing location of a ticket.

pricingDate.title: Ticket Document Information.Pricing Date
pricingDate.description: Booked Itinerary Pricing Date. Note: This is the date the booked itinerary was priced.

pricingTime.title: Ticket Document Information.Pricing Time
pricingTime.description: Booked Itinerary Pricing Time. For example: 09:15

referencedOrder.title: Each Ticket Document Information may supplies one and only one Order
referencedOrder.description: A uniquely identified record of the agreement of one party with another to receive products and services under specified terms and conditions. Order supports the sale of a flexible range of airline products and services that are not necessarily Journey based (e.g. subscription services).

servicingAgency.title: Each Servicing Agency Ticket Document Information may be serviced by one and only one Servicing Agency Ticket Document Information
servicingAgency.description: A private retailer or public service that provides travel and tourism related services to the public on behalf of suppliers such as activities, airlines, car rentals, cruise lines, hotels, railways, travel insurance, and package tours.

ticketDocInfoPricingCountryCode.title: Ticket Document Information.Ticket Document Information Pricing Country Code
ticketDocInfoPricingCountryCode.description: Country code used to identify the country in which the booked itinerary was priced.

ticketDocInfoPricingLocationCode.title: Ticket Document Information.Ticket Document Information Pricing Location Code
ticketDocInfoPricingLocationCode.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

ticketRefIdentification.title: Each Ticket Document Information may supplies between zero and five Ticket Reference Identifications
ticketRefIdentification.description: An additional, identifying information used to identify a ticket.

TicketDocInfo.commission.title: Each Ticket Document Information may supplies one and only one Commission
TicketDocInfo.commission.description: A remuneration either an amount of money, or a set percentage of the value involved, paid to an agent in relations to a commercial transaction.

TicketIssuanceInfo.title: Ticket Issuance Information
TicketIssuanceInfo.description: An issuing carrier and issuing location of a ticket.

issueTime.title: Ticket Issuance Information.Issue Time
issueTime.description: Time that the document was originally issued.

ticketIssuanceInfoIataLocationCode.title: Ticket Issuance Information.Ticket Issuance Information IATA Location Code
ticketIssuanceInfoIataLocationCode.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

TicketIssuanceInfo.issuingCarrier.title: Each Ticket Issuance Information must supplies one and only one Carrier
TicketIssuanceInfo.issuingCarrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

TicketIssuanceInfo.issueDate.title: Ticket Issuance Information.Issue Date
TicketIssuanceInfo.issueDate.description: Date that the document was originally issued.

TicketRefIdentification.title: Ticket Reference Identification
TicketRefIdentification.description: An additional, identifying information used to identify a ticket.

refTypeCode.title: Ticket Reference Identification.Reference Type Code
refTypeCode.description: Type code of the reservation control system/reference. PADIS 9893.

Time.title: Time
Time.description: Time is a point in the 24 hour clock expressed in hours, minutes and seconds. It has no implicit reference to a time zone.

TippingLimit.title: Tipping Limit
TippingLimit.description: An aft limit on the position of the center of gravity of an aircraft depending on its weight to avoid tipping.

TippingLimit.weightMeasure.title: Tipping Limit.Weight Measure
TippingLimit.weightMeasure.description: Operating weight for which the tipping limit applies.

TippingLimit.indexValue.title: Tipping Limit.Index Value
TippingLimit.indexValue.description: Value of the tipping limit expressed in index units.

TippingLimitTable.title: Tipping Limit Table
TippingLimitTable.description: A set of related Tipping Limits.

tippingLimit.title: Each Tipping Limit Table must contains at least one Tipping Limits
tippingLimit.description: An aft limit on the position of the center of gravity of an aircraft depending on its weight to avoid tipping.

TransitStop.title: Transit Stop
TransitStop.description: A stop made by a vehicle such as an aircraft, train or bus on the way to the final destination.

boardingAllowedInd.title: Transit Stop.Boarding Allowed Indicator
boardingAllowedInd.description: Indicates if facilities are required to enable passengers to board.

changeOfGaugeInd.title: Transit Stop.Change Of Gauge Indicator
changeOfGaugeInd.description: Indicates a change of gauge will take place at this en-route stop.

disembarkingAllowedInd.title: Transit Stop.Disembarking Allowed Indicator
disembarkingAllowedInd.description: Indicates if facilities are required to enable passengers to disembark.

onGroundDurationTime.title: Transit Stop.On Ground Duration Time
onGroundDurationTime.description: Total elapsed time the aircraft is scheduled to remain on the ground during the en-route stop.

technicalStopOnlyInd.title: Transit Stop.Technical Stop Only Indicator
technicalStopOnlyInd.description: Indicates that the stop is for reasons other than the embarkation or disembarkation of passengers.

TransponderIdentifier.title: Transponder_ Identifier
TransponderIdentifier.description: Unique Transponder identifier, known as T = TID for Transponder identification.

TransportMeansCodeEnum.title: Transport Means Code
TransportMeansCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes used for the transportation mode service type. Possible statuses: Aircraft, Bus, Coach, Ferry, Train, Hotel, Cruise

TransportParkingPositionIdentifier.title: Transport Parking Position_ Identifier
TransportParkingPositionIdentifier.description: The parking position identifier of the infrastructure facility

TransportService.title: Transport Service
TransportService.description: A provision of carriage, predominately using aircraft, calling at one or more stations along a specific route.

administratingAirline.title: Each Transport Service must be provided by one and only one Airline
administratingAirline.description: An airline that decides to provide a transport service.

originDepDateTime.title: Transport Service.Origin Departure Date Time
originDepDateTime.description: Date in UTC of the scheduled departure from the station of origin.

transportServiceSegment.title: Each Transport Service may be provided by one or more Transport Service Segments
transportServiceSegment.description: When a service is not open to the public such as when a transportation vehicle is being re-located no segment is required.

TransportServiceLeg.title: Transport Service Leg
TransportServiceLeg.description: A section of a transport service from one station to the next.

arrivalStation.title: Each Inbound Transport Service Leg must finish at one and only one Inbound Transport Service Leg
arrivalStation.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

codesharedLeg.title: Each Codeshared Leg may share one and only one Codesharing Leg
codesharedLeg.description: A Codeshared Leg must be a Non-operating Transport Service Leg and the shared leg must be an Operating Transport Service Leg.

codesharingLeg.title: Each Codeshared Leg may be shared by one or more Codeshared Legs
codesharingLeg.description: A Codeshared Leg must be a Non-operating Transport Service Leg and the shared leg must be an Operating Transport Service Leg.

depStation.title: Each Outbound Transport Service Leg must start at one and only one Outbound Transport Service Leg
depStation.description: A location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

duplicatedLeg.title: Each Duplicated Leg may be fulfilled by one and only one Duplicate Leg
duplicatedLeg.description: A Duplicate Leg must be a Non-operating Transport Service Leg and the Duplicated Leg must be an Operating Transport Service Leg.

duplicateLeg.title: Each Duplicated Leg may fulfill one or more Duplicated Legs
duplicateLeg.description: A Duplicate Leg must be a Non-operating Transport Service Leg and the Duplicated Leg must be an Operating Transport Service Leg.

endTransportServiceSegment.title: Each End Transport Service Segment may end with one or more Inbound Transport Service Legs
endTransportServiceSegment.description: A section of a transport service between a board point and a subsequent off point.

inflightService.title: Each Transport Service Leg may contains one or more Service Definitions
inflightService.description: A description and characteristics of a non-flight product or service that can be separately sold and delivered. E.g. bag, seat, meal on a flight.

operationalInd.title: Transport Service Leg.Operational Indicator
operationalInd.description: Indicates if the transport service leg is an operational transport service leg and may therefore give rise to a flight leg, otherwise it is a non-operational leg.

scheduledArrivalDateTime.title: Transport Service Leg.Scheduled Arrival Date Time
scheduledArrivalDateTime.description: Scheduled date and time of arrival.

scheduledDepDateTime.title: Transport Service Leg.Scheduled Departure Date Time
scheduledDepDateTime.description: Scheduled date and time of departure.

startTransportServiceSegment.title: Each Start Transport Service Segment may start with one or more Outbound Transport Service Legs
startTransportServiceSegment.description: All legs of a segment must be for the sale transport service.

surfaceTransportVehicle.title: Each Transport Service Leg may supplies one and only one Surface Transport Vehicle
surfaceTransportVehicle.description: A means used for transporting people or goods, on land or water. For example: The Flying Scotsman train, The Edward Booth bus, The van with identity tag B72349W09274, The Titanic ship.

transportMeansCode.title: Transport Service Leg.Transport Means Code
transportMeansCode.description: Means of transport used to fulfill the transport service leg. For example: Aircraft, Train, Ferry, Bus, Coach.

TransportServiceLeg.flightLeg.title: Each Transport Service Leg may fulfill between zero and two Operational Legs
TransportServiceLeg.flightLeg.description: If a technical stop for re-fueling is needed then there will be two flight Legs required to fulfill one transport service leg. Also, if a single flight under abnormal conditions, recognized before departure, cannot go directly to its destination an additional leg may be required.

TransportServiceLeg.tailAssignment.title: Each Transport Service Leg may gets one or more Tail Assignments
TransportServiceLeg.tailAssignment.description: An assignment of a well-identified aircraft to a dated operating flight leg

TransportServiceLeg.operatingCarrier.title: Each Transport Service Leg must be fulfilled by a transport vehicle operated by one and only one Transport Service Leg
TransportServiceLeg.operatingCarrier.description: Demoralized, for simplicity, by traversing the model to find the Operating Carrier whether the operating carrier is an airline or train company or any other mode of transport operator.

TransportServiceLegStatusCode.title: Transport Service Leg Status_ Code
TransportServiceLegStatusCode.description: The states of a Transport Service Leg.

TransportServiceLegStatusCodeEnum.title: Transport Service Leg Status Code
TransportServiceLegStatusCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes that are operationally time significant. This provides the current status of a transport service leg Supported codesets: 2005 and 9750 Possible statuses: Scheduled, Planned, Estimated, Actual, Check-in open, Flight Closed

TransportServiceSegment.title: Transport Service Segment
TransportServiceSegment.description: A section of a transport service between a board point and a subsequent off point.

containsFunnelFlightInd.title: Transport Service Segment.Contains Funnel Flight Indicator
containsFunnelFlightInd.description: Indicates if the segment contains a funnel flight.

dayVariationCount.title: Transport Service Segment.Day Variation Count
dayVariationCount.description: Difference in days between the day of departure in local time and the day of arrival in local time. For example: -1 for previous day, 0 for same day, 1 for next day.

iataTicketlessInd.title: Transport Service Segment.IATA Ticketless Indicator
iataTicketlessInd.description: Indicates that the segment will not have a ticket that conforms to IATA Resolutions but may have an alternative ticket.

paxPreScanningInd.title: Transport Service Segment.Passenger Pre Scanning Indicator
paxPreScanningInd.description: Indicates if the segment is subject to at least one passenger pre-screening program such as the US TSA 'Secure Flight' passenger prescreening program.

stopsCount.title: Transport Service Segment.Stops Count
stopsCount.description: Number of times the aircraft makes a scheduled transit stop between the origin and destination stations.

TransportServiceSegmentStatusCode.title: Transport Service Segment Status_ Code
TransportServiceSegmentStatusCode.description: The states of a Transport Service Segment.

TransportServiceSegmentStatusCodeEnum.title: Transport Service Segment Status Code
TransportServiceSegmentStatusCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes that are operationally time significant. This provides the current status of a transport service segment. Supported codesets: 2005 and 9750 Possible statuses: Scheduled, Planned, Estimated, Actual, Check-in open, Flight Closed

TransportServiceStatusCode.title: Transport Service Status_ Code
TransportServiceStatusCode.description: The states of a Transport Service.

TransportServiceStatusCodeEnum.title: Transport Service Status Code
TransportServiceStatusCodeEnum.description: These elements target codes that are service type significant. This provides the current status of a transport Service Type Supported codesets: 2005 and 9750 Possible statuses: Scheduled, Planned, Estimated, Actual, Check-in open, Flight Closed

TransportVehicleParkingPosition.title: Transport Vehicle Parking Position
TransportVehicleParkingPosition.description: A recognized location where a transport vehicle may halt and stay temporarily in order to allow loading, offloading and / or servicing such as refueling and turn around.

transportVehicleParkingPositionIdentifie.title: Transport Vehicle Parking Position.Transport Vehicle Parking Position Identifier
transportVehicleParkingPositionIdentifie.description: Identifier of the transport vehicle parking position. For example: 'C102'.

TransportVehicleParkingPosition.aircraft.title: Each Transport Vehicle Parking Position may be used by one or more Aircraft Departures
TransportVehicleParkingPosition.aircraft.description: A preparation of an aircraft for departure including acquiring baggage, checking in passengers, loading baggage and cargo onto the aircraft and preparing the aircraft up to when it is ready to depart the stand to begin the leg.

TransportVehicleParkingPosition.aircraft.title: Each Transport Vehicle Parking Position may be used by one or more Aircraft Arrivals
TransportVehicleParkingPosition.aircraft.description: A handling of the arrival of an aircraft from passenger disembarkation, baggage unloading and reuniting passengers with their luggage.

TravelAgency.title: Travel Agency
TravelAgency.description: A private retailer or public service that provides travel and tourism related services to the public on behalf of suppliers such as activities, airlines, car rentals, cruise lines, hotels, railways, travel insurance, and package tours.

agencyIdentifier.title: Travel Agency.Agency Identifier
agencyIdentifier.description: Unique Agency Seller ID. For example: CTRV.

bookingAgencyTicketDocInfo.title: Each Booking Agency Ticket Document Information may book one or more Booking Agencies
bookingAgencyTicketDocInfo.description: An Information corresponding to a group of 1 to 4 Tickets for a single Origin Destination and a single Passenger.

pseudoCityIdentifier.title: Travel Agency.Pseudo City Identifier
pseudoCityIdentifier.description: An identifier for a corporate user of a computer reservation system (CRS) or global distribution system (GDS), typically a travel agency. Also known as Office ID.

servicingAgencyTicketDocInfo.title: Each Servicing Agency Ticket Document Information may service one or more Servicing Agencies
servicingAgencyTicketDocInfo.description: An Information corresponding to a group of 1 to 4 Tickets for a single Origin Destination and a single Passenger.

travelAgencyAccreditation.title: Each Travel Agency may be accredited with one or more Travel Agency Accreditations
travelAgencyAccreditation.description: An IATA Accreditation of a travel agency.

TravelAgency.name.title: Travel Agency.Name
TravelAgency.name.description: Agency name. For example: Carson Travel.

TravelAgencyAccreditation.title: Travel Agency Accreditation
TravelAgencyAccreditation.description: An IATA Accreditation of a travel agency.

iataAccreditationCode.title: Travel Agency Accreditation.IATA Accreditation Code
iataAccreditationCode.description: Provides information regarding agency accreditation (reference PADIS codeset 9972).

TravelAgencyTypeCode.title: Travel Agency Type_ Code
TravelAgencyTypeCode.description: Additional BDT to specify travel agency type codes.

TravelAgencyTypeCodeEnum.title: Travel Agency Type Code
TravelAgencyTypeCodeEnum.description: Agency/ Agent Identification Type. Valid Values: OnlineTravelAgency - OnlineTravelAgency; TravelAgency - TravelAgency; TravelManagementCompany - TravelManagementCompany

TravelAgent.title: Travel Agent
TravelAgent.description: A private retailer or public service individual that provides travel and tourism related services to the public on behalf of suppliers such as activities, airlines, car rentals, cruise lines, hotels, railways, travel insurance, and package tours.

actualLocationCode.title: Travel Agent.Actual Location Code
actualLocationCode.description: A 3-character IATA airport/city code of the agent initiating the request.

travelAgencyTypeCode.title: Travel Agent.Travel Agency Type Code
travelAgencyTypeCode.description: Agency/ Agent Identification Type. For example: B - Booking Agent.

travelAgentIdentifier.title: Travel Agent.Travel Agent Identifier
travelAgentIdentifier.description: Booking and Servicing Agent information ID. For example: 98417900 Note: The ID correlates to the specified ID Type.

TravelAgent.cash.title: Each Travel Agent must have one and only one Cash
TravelAgent.cash.description: A payment that is collected by the agent and settled between the Airline and the agent. Refer to IATA Resolution 728 Attachment A for full details.

TrimTypeCodeEnum.title: Trim Type Code
TrimTypeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Trim Type Code BDT. Valid Values: Cabin Area - Cabin area trim; Class trim - Class trim; Seat row - Seat row trim

TripPurposeCodeEnum.title: Trip Purpose Code
TripPurposeCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the trip purpose code Type BDT. Valid Values: Business - Business; BusinessAndLeisure - BusinessAndLeisure; Leisure - Leisure; Other - Other; Unknown - Unknown

Uld.title: ULD
Uld.description: A Unit Load Device is a load carrying device which interfaces directly with aircraft loading and restraint systems and meets all restraint requirements without the use of supplementary equipment. Examples include containers, pallets and pallet nets.

commodityCode.title: ULD.Commodity Code
commodityCode.description: Used with ULDs to segregate bags for efficient load and unload from the aircraft and subsequent ground operations. Recommended codes are listed in AHM240. Airlines who wish to use their own codes may do so. For example: 'BY' for Economy Bags.

uldIdentifier.title: ULD.ULD Identifier
uldIdentifier.description: Identifier of the ULD marked on the ULD label document. For example: AKE0001XH.

UldCompatibility.title: ULD Compatibility
UldCompatibility.description: A permission to load a ULD (ULD type) on a specific hold location (bay or pallet position) with possible weight limitation.

compatibleInd.title: ULD Compatibility.Compatible Indicator
compatibleInd.description: Indicates it is permitted to load the ULD on the bay.

UldCompatibility.restrictedWeightMeasure.title: ULD Compatibility.Restricted Weight Measure
UldCompatibility.restrictedWeightMeasure.description: Restrictive weight where a ULD is permitted in a Bay/Position, but with a maximum weight that is lower than the maximum weight specified for the ULD.

UldIdentifier.title: ULD_ Identifier
UldIdentifier.description: The ULD identifier of a ULD.

UldLoadPosition.title: ULD Load Position
UldLoadPosition.description: A subdivision of a containerized/palletized compartment.

uldLoadPositionIdentifier.title: ULD Load Position.ULD Load Position Identifier
uldLoadPositionIdentifier.description: Identifies a possible ULD position within the aircraft, using one of the patterns described in AHM505. For example: A, BR, CDL, E3, 13,22L, 32P, 413, 1112O. May contain compartment number, row position, left-to-right position in a row.

UldLoadPosition.lateralArmFromMeasure.title: ULD Load Position.Lateral Arm From Measure
UldLoadPosition.lateralArmFromMeasure.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the left hand edge of the Bay/Position. Enter values as negative.

UldLoadPosition.lateralArmToMeasure.title: ULD Load Position.Lateral Arm To Measure
UldLoadPosition.lateralArmToMeasure.description: Linear dimension from the aircraft centerline to the right hand edge of the Bay/Position. Enter values as positive.

UldLoadPosition.missingRestraintRule.title: Each ULD Load Position may use one or more Missing Restraint Rules
UldLoadPosition.missingRestraintRule.description: A restriction on weight applicable when one or more locks are inoperable or missing.

UldLoadPosition.volumeMeasure.title: ULD Load Position.Volume Measure
UldLoadPosition.volumeMeasure.description: Total volume of the ULD Load Position.

UldLoadPosition.bayGrouping.title: Each ULD Load Position may be used by one or more Bay Groupings
UldLoadPosition.bayGrouping.description: A grouping of ULD positions (Stack/String) used as a method of maximizing the ULD capacity of a lower hold by not using intermediate locks.

UldLoadPositionIdentifier.title: ULD Load Position_ Identifier
UldLoadPositionIdentifier.description: Specifies a ULD Load Position identifier.

UldType.title: ULD Type
UldType.description: A way of grouping of Unit Load Devices (ULD's) with the same dimension, weights and limitations. Is identified by ULD Type Code (eg AKE, PAG, etc.) and optional owner and/or serial number or range of serial numbers.

uldTypeBeginSerialNumberCode.title: ULD Type.ULD Type Begin Serial Number Code
uldTypeBeginSerialNumberCode.description: Individual serial number or first serial number when defining ULD serial number ranges.

uldTypeCode.title: ULD Type.ULD Type Code
uldTypeCode.description: ULD Type Code (Identifier). For example: AKE, PAG.

uldTypeEndSerialNumberCode.title: ULD Type.ULD Type End Serial Number Code
uldTypeEndSerialNumberCode.description: Last serial number when defining ULD serial number ranges. Leave blank when defining individual serial numbers.

uldTypeOwnerCode.title: ULD Type.ULD Type Owner Code
uldTypeOwnerCode.description: Owner specific identifier where ULD owner utilizes non-IATA standard ULD codes.

UldType.defaultInd.title: ULD Type.Default Indicator
UldType.defaultInd.description: Indicates that the ULD type is the default type, i.e. when serial number and/or owner code do not match this data will be applied to any ULD of that type. To be used during load planning.

Uri.title: URI
Uri.description: A string of characters used to identify a resource. Such identification enables interaction with representations of the resource over a network, typically the World Wide Web, using specific protocols.

UuidIdentifier.title: UUID_ Identifier
UuidIdentifier.description: Globally Unique identifier Type code defined as RFC 4122 UUID (version 4) G = RFC UUID unique id

Value.title: Value
Value.description: A value is the concept of worth in general that is assigned or is determined by measurement, assessment or calculation.

VariationForWeightsCode.title: Variation For Weights_ Code
VariationForWeightsCode.description: Specifies the name for Variation for Weights.

VariationForWeightsCodeEnum.title: Variation For Weights Code
VariationForWeightsCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Variation for weights names. Valid Values: Charter - Charter; Domestic - Domestic; Flight - Flight; International - International; Long haul - Long Haul; Route - Route; Short haul - Short haul; Standard - Standard

Visa.title: Visa
Visa.description: An official entry in a Passport or other Travel Document made by an official of a government to indicate that the bearer has been granted authority to enter or re-enter the country or region concerned.

enterBeforeDate.title: Visa.Enter Before Date
enterBeforeDate.description: Date at which the visa expires and is no longer a valid entry document.

entryQty.title: Visa.Entry Quantity
entryQty.description: Number of entries permitted by the visa into the host country.

stayDuration.title: Visa.Stay Duration
stayDuration.description: Duration permitted of the Passenger's stay in the visa host country (in days).

visaIdentifier.title: Visa.Visa Identifier
visaIdentifier.description: Visa ID value. For example: NY122345.

Visa.country.title: Each Visa may is valid for entry one and only one Country
Visa.country.description: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

VolumeMeasure.title: Volume_ Measure
VolumeMeasure.description: A numeric value determining a volume along with the specified unit of measure.

VolumeUnitCodeEnum.title: Volume Unit Code
VolumeUnitCodeEnum.description: List of Volume Unit Codes. Subset of UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Valid Values: CMQ - Cubic Centimeter; FTQ - Cubic Foot; INQ - Cubic Inch; MTQ - Cubic Meter

Voucher.title: Voucher
Voucher.description: A document that entitles the holder to a discount or that may be exchanged for goods or services.

voucherIdentifier.title: Voucher.Voucher Identifier
voucherIdentifier.description: Voucher ID or Number. For example: XX12345.

WeightAllowance.title: Weight Allowance
WeightAllowance.description: A baggage weight allowance with application information.

WeightMeasure.title: Weight_ Measure
WeightMeasure.description: A numeric value determining a weight along with the specified unit of measure.

WeightTypeCodeEnum.title: Weight Type Code

redressCase.description: A registration of an individual with a country's redress program.

InventoryReference.title: Superclass of InventoryGuarantee, OrderItem.
InventoryReference.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property inventoryGuaranteeIdentifier.

inventoryGuaranteeIdentifier.title: Inventory Guarantee.Inventory Guarantee Identifier
inventoryGuaranteeIdentifier.description: Unique Inventory Guarantee ID. For example: INVREF123456, 68E0-675C. Note: This is a unique identifier issued by an Airline to reference that inventory for a specified offer will be guaranteed as available for a period.

JourneyCriteriaPreference.title: Superclass of JourneyDistanceCriteria, JourneyDurationCriteria.
JourneyCriteriaPreference.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property prefCode.

prefCode.title: Journey Distance Criteria.Preference Code
prefCode.description: Level of preference requested. For example: Preferred, Required, or Exclude.

DiscountedItem.title: Superclass of KeyValueProperty, Price.
DiscountedItem.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property discount.

discount.title: Each Key Value Property must have one and only one Discount Context
discount.description: A deduction from the price amount, made in advance of its payment.

LanguageCodesetAssociation.title: Superclass of LangUsage, Metadata.
LanguageCodesetAssociation.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property codesetMetadata.

codesetMetadata.title: Each Language Usage must have one and only one Codeset Metadata

LanguageInformation.title: Superclass of LangUsage, TravelAgent.
LanguageInformation.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property langCode.

langCode.title: Language Usage.Language Code
langCode.description: Language Code representation. Notes: 1. Language code. For example: en, en-US 2. Encoding Schemes: ISO 639-1 Code OR Microsoft National Language Support (NLS) Code 3. Supports ISO 639-1 (two alpha character) neutral language encoding indicated by a name such as 'en' for English. 4. Supports MNLS geographically specific language encoding indicated by a name that includes both locale and country/region information. For example, the locale English (United States) has the language name 'en-US'

UnitMeasure.title: Superclass of LengthMeasure, LiquidVolumeMeasure, Measure, VolumeMeasure, WeightMeasure.
UnitMeasure.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property unitCode.

UnitMeasure.unitCode.title: Length_ Measure.Unit. Code
UnitMeasure.unitCode.description: The length unit code of measure.

BayLockContainer.title: Superclass of Lock, UldLoadPosition.
BayLockContainer.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property bayLock.

bayLock.title: Each Lock may be materialized by one or more Bay Locks
bayLock.description: A Lock used by a ULD Position.

LoyaltyProgramStructure.title: Superclass of LoyaltyProgram, LoyaltyProgramAccount.
LoyaltyProgramStructure.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property tier.

tier.title: Each Loyalty Program may offer one or more Loyalty Program Tiers
tier.description: A level of loyalty that can be assigned to a customer having accrued or been awarded sufficient credits, earned through trade with the Loyalty program owner or their partners, providing the customer with a range of defined benefits. ------------Propose A status assigned to a customer having accrued or been awarded sufficient credits to reach the qualification threshold, earned through trade with the Loyalty program owner or their partners, providing the customer with a range of defined benefits.

LoyaltyTransaction.title: Superclass of LoyaltyProgramAccount, PaymentMethod.
LoyaltyTransaction.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property loyaltyRedemption.

loyaltyRedemption.title: Each Loyalty Program Account may be allocated one or more Loyalty Redemptions
loyaltyRedemption.description: A form of payment by which the customer uses a virtual currency of a Loyalty Program Account (such as air miles) in exchange for goods or services.

WeightRestrictions.title: Superclass of MaximumWeights, MinimumWeights.
WeightRestrictions.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property lawMeasure.

WeightLimits.title: Superclass of MaximumWeights, MinimumWeights.
WeightLimits.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property towMeasure.

WeightLimits.towMeasure.title: Maximum Weights.TOW Measure
WeightLimits.towMeasure.description: Maximum weight permitted at take off.

TakeoffWeightLimits.title: Superclass of MaximumWeights, MinimumWeights.
TakeoffWeightLimits.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property txwMeasure.

txwMeasure.title: Maximum Weights.TXW Measure
txwMeasure.description: Maximum weight permitted prior to take off.

ZFWWeightSpecifications.title: Superclass of MaximumWeights, MinimumWeights.
ZFWWeightSpecifications.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property zfwMeasure.

zfwMeasure.title: Maximum Weights.ZFW Measure
zfwMeasure.description: Maximum weight permitted for the Zero Fuel condition.

WeightRestrictionIssue.title: Superclass of MissingLockRestriction, MissingRestraintRule.
WeightRestrictionIssue.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property restrictedWeightMeasure.

InventoryGuaranteeHolder.title: Superclass of Offer, Order, ShoppingResponse.
InventoryGuaranteeHolder.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property inventoryGuarantee.

inventoryGuarantee.title: Each Offer may have one and only one Inventory Guarantee
inventoryGuarantee.description: An Identification and time limit information for holding inventory in an Offer or Order.

MarketedEntity.title: Superclass of Offer, OrderItem.
MarketedEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property marketingCarrier.

marketingCarrier.title: Each Marketing Carrier must be owned by one and only one Marketed Offer
marketingCarrier.description: An organization operating transport vehicles for commercial purposes which offers transport services, both scheduled or non-scheduled, to the public for carriage of passengers and their baggage, mail and/or cargo and is certified for such purposes by an authority of the state in which it is established.

OwnershipEntity.title: Superclass of Offer, Order, OrderItem.
OwnershipEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property ownerTypeCode.

ownerTypeCode.title: Offer.Owner Type Code
ownerTypeCode.description: Indicates whether or not the owner of this Order is the ORA or POA.

PaymentCommitmentEntity.title: Superclass of Offer, Order, OrderItem, ServiceDefinition.
PaymentCommitmentEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property paymentTimeLimitDateTime.

paymentTimeLimitDateTime.title: Offer.Payment Time Limit Date Time
paymentTimeLimitDateTime.description: A date/time by which payment commitment is required for a given Order Item. For example: PaymentTimeLimitDateTime: '2018-01-01T12:00:00Z' shows a static payment commitment date/time for a given Order Item.

PricedEntity.title: Superclass of Offer, Order.
PricedEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property totalPrice.

totalPrice.title: Each Offer may have one and only one Price
totalPrice.description: An amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

NetworkEntity.title: Superclass of Offer, Order.
NetworkEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property webAddressUrl.

webAddressUrl.title: Each Offer may have one and only one Network Address
webAddressUrl.description: A virtual address in an IT network.

OrderAmendmentEntity.title: Superclass of OfferItem, Remark, TicketDocInfo.
OrderAmendmentEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property orderAmendment.

orderAmendment.title: Each Offer Item must have one and only one Order Amendment
orderAmendment.description: An Order amendment information and action type.

PriceGuaranteeEntity.title: Superclass of OfferItem, OrderItem, PriceQuote, ServiceDefinition.
PriceGuaranteeEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property priceGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.

priceGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.title: Offer Item.Price Guarantee Time Limit Date Time
priceGuaranteeTimeLimitDateTime.description: Length of time the price of an offer item is guaranteed. In the absence of the price guarantee time limit, the price is not guaranteed. Note: Upon expiry, the price may no longer be guaranteed and either a new shopping process should begin, or the offer should be repriced resulting in a new Offer. Should the price guarantee time limit extend beyond Order creation (or change), the remaining length of time persists into the corresponding Order Item. At Order creation (or change) the airline can increase the remaining length of time beyond the original time limit should they wish to. Where a price guarantee time limit is applied, there is no guarantee that related inventory is guaranteed by the airline.

StopOverApplicableEntity.title: Superclass of OfferItem, StopOverLocation.
StopOverApplicableEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property stopOverRestrictions.

stopOverRestrictions.title: Each Offer Item may apply to an one and only one Stop Over Restrictions
stopOverRestrictions.description: A multi flight offer item my have stopover restrictions.

TimeLimitedEntity.title: Superclass of Order, OrderItem, ServiceDefinition.
TimeLimitedEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property bilateralTimeLimit.

bilateralTimeLimit.title: Each Order may be limited by one or more Bilateral Time Limits
bilateralTimeLimit.description: A bilaterally agreed limitation or restriction of time.

BookingEntity.title: Superclass of Order, Org, PaxGroup, Service, TicketDocInfo.
BookingEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property bookingRef.

bookingRef.title: Each Order may supplies one or more Booking References
bookingRef.description: A location in a database where to find a booking.

OrderMetadata.title: Superclass of Order, OrderItem, Remark.
OrderMetadata.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property creationDateTime.

creationDateTime.title: Order.Creation Date Time
creationDateTime.description: Date time by which the order is created. For example: 2018-09-05T15:52:01Z.

PaymentDeadline.title: Superclass of Order, OrderItem, ServiceDefinition.
PaymentDeadline.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property depositTimeLimitDateTime.

depositTimeLimitDateTime.title: Order.Deposit Time Limit Date Time
depositTimeLimitDateTime.description: Date by which a deposit must be paid for an order. For example: 2015-01-13T13:59:38Z .

OrderCriteriaReference.title: Superclass of Order, Pax, ShoppingCriteria.
OrderCriteriaReference.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property existingOrderCriteria.

existingOrderCriteria.title: Each Order must have one and only one Existing Order Criteria
existingOrderCriteria.description: A References to Orders that were created from Offers that have already been purchased, booked and/or are being held for a Passenger.

OrderCompletionDeadline.title: Superclass of Order, OrderItem, ServiceDefinition.
OrderCompletionDeadline.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property namingTimeLimitDateTime.

namingTimeLimitDateTime.title: Order.Naming Time Limit Date Time
namingTimeLimitDateTime.description: Time by which an Order must be completed with individual passenger names. For example: 2015-01-13T13:59:38Z.

VersionedEntity.title: Superclass of Order, Policy.
VersionedEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property versionNumber.

versionNumber.title: Order.Version Number
versionNumber.description: Version of the Order used to track the evolution of an Order and the changes made to it.

TransactionLink.title: Superclass of Order, OrderItem.
TransactionLink.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property webAddressUri.

webAddressUri.title: Order.Web Address URI
webAddressUri.description: Deep linking into another site to complete the transaction. For example: to bring the customer directly to a page to continue with a purchase of a specific offer.

TicketingTimeLimitEntity.title: Superclass of OrderItem, ServiceDefinition.
TicketingTimeLimitEntity.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property ticketingTimeLimitDateTime.

ticketingTimeLimitDateTime.title: Order Item.Ticketing Time Limit Date Time
ticketingTimeLimitDateTime.description: Time by which passengers must secure tickets (or other accountable documents) for confirmed reservation as agreed with the airline. For example: 2015-01-13T13:59:38Z. Note: Passengers meet this requirement by purchasing a ticket (or other accountable document) which indicates the reserved services, or by having previously issued documents revalidated or reissued to reflect the reservation.

GalleyLogistics.title: Superclass of PantryDistribution, PotableWaterDistribution.
GalleyLogistics.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property totalWeightMeasure.

totalWeightMeasure.title: Pantry Distribution.Total Weight Measure
totalWeightMeasure.description: Total weight of galley equipment, food, service items etc. regardless of location.

PassengerJourney.title: Superclass of PaxSegment, TransportServiceLeg.
PassengerJourney.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property paxLeg.

paxLeg.title: Each Passenger Segment must contains at least one Passenger Legs
paxLeg.description: A transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Leg.

SecureAuthenticationContainer.title: Superclass of PaymentCard, ResponseParameters.
SecureAuthenticationContainer.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property securePayerAuthenticationInstructions.

securePayerAuthenticationInstructions.title: Each Payment Card may supplies one and only one Secure Payer Authentication Instructions
securePayerAuthenticationInstructions.description: A set of Data returned from the Directory Server/ACS containing the PAReq and the ACS URL that enable to cardholder to authenticate. Applicable for 3D Secure Version V 1.0. A container of enrolment information of the Payment Card e.g. Verified by Visa.

TransactionRule.title: Superclass of PaymentInfo, Remark.
TransactionRule.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property priceVarianceRule.

priceVarianceRule.title: Each Payment Information may amount is subject to one and only one Price Variance Rule
priceVarianceRule.description: A Price Variance rule supports specifying Payment Processing Rules, including payment failure. Acceptable amount and/or percentage of the total amount by which the Order item price can vary. Example: 20 USD, 2 Percent.

TransactionDetail.title: Superclass of PaymentMethod, Remark.
TransactionDetail.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property otherPaymentMethod.

otherPaymentMethod.title: Each Payment Method may supplies one and only one Other Payment Method
otherPaymentMethod.description: A non-standard form of payment which may be used in exchange for goods or services.

SecurePaymentProcessing.title: Superclass of PaymentTrx, PostalAddress.
SecurePaymentProcessing.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property paymentAddressVerification.

paymentAddressVerification.title: Each Payment Transaction may contains one and only one Payment Address Verification
paymentAddressVerification.description: A Secure Payment-related Processing information, including AVS/ CVV Verification Results and Secure Payment Processing Results.

TelecommunicationInfo.title: Superclass of Phone, SalesTaxRegistration.
TelecommunicationInfo.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property countryDialingCode.

countryDialingCode.title: Phone.Country Dialing Code
countryDialingCode.description: Numeric telephone dialing prefixes for the member countries of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). Note: The phone number can be put unstructured into the phone element or can be put structured into country dialing code, area code, phone number and extension.

LocationInformation.title: Superclass of PostalAddress, SalesTaxRegistration.
LocationInformation.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property postalCode.

LocationDetails.title: Superclass of PostalAddress, SalesTaxRegistration.
LocationDetails.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property streetText.

streetText.title: Postal Address.Street Text
streetText.description: Street name and number. For example: Main Street, 100 Main Street.

PotableWaterSystem.title: Superclass of PotableWaterDistribution, PotableWaterTank.
PotableWaterSystem.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property potableWaterDistributionElement.

potableWaterDistributionElement.title: Each Potable Water Distribution may be contained by one or more Potable Water Distribution Elements
potableWaterDistributionElement.description: A specific allocation in a potable water distribution.

FinancialElement.title: Superclass of Price, Tax.
FinancialElement.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property curConversion.

curConversion.title: Each Price may have one or more Currency Conversions
curConversion.description: A result of converting one currency into another currency. E.g. local currency to USD, air miles to monetary.

NetworkDevice.title: Superclass of Printer, Scanner.
NetworkDevice.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property networkAddress.

networkAddress.title: Each Printer must be refering to one and only one Network Address
networkAddress.description: A virtual address in an IT network.

UldCompatibilityAssignment.title: Superclass of Remark, UldLoadPosition, UldType.
UldCompatibilityAssignment.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property uldCompatibility.

uldCompatibility.title: Each Remark may have one and only one ULD Compatibility

SeatingService.title: Superclass of Service, ServiceAssociations.
SeatingService.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property selectedSeat.

selectedSeat.title: Each Service may deliver one and only one Seat On Leg
selectedSeat.description: A sitting place for a passenger or crew in a cabin compartment on a Dated Operating Leg.

ServiceLinkage.title: Superclass of Service, ServiceDefinition.
ServiceLinkage.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property serviceAssociations.

serviceAssociations.title: Each Service must is one and only one Service Associations
serviceAssociations.description: A reference to the details of this Service. May include either Passenger Journeys, a Service Definition, or a Selected Seat.

PassengerSegmentReference.title: Superclass of ServiceAssociations, StopOverLocation.
PassengerSegmentReference.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property paxSegmentRefIdentifier.

paxSegmentRefIdentifier.title: Service Associations.Passenger Segment Reference Identifier
paxSegmentRefIdentifier.description: Reference to a Passenger Segment ID within this message.

reasonForIssuanceCode.description: Reason For Issuance Code. For example: A (Air Transportation), C (Baggage), E (Airport Services), F (Merchandise), G (In-flight Services). Refer to PADIS Codeset for data element 4183 - Special Condition.

ServiceClassification.title: Superclass of ServiceCriteria, ServiceTaxonomy.
ServiceClassification.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property taxonomyCode.

taxonomyCode.title: Service Criteria.Taxonomy Code
taxonomyCode.description: Used for defining a product or service within the Shared Industry Taxonomy or bilaterally.

ServiceBookingDetails.title: Superclass of ServiceDefinition, SpecialService.
ServiceBookingDetails.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property bookingInstructions.

bookingInstructions.title: Each Service Definition may be further defined by one and only one Booking Instructions
bookingInstructions.description: An Optional service booking instructions to include SSR, OSI and upgrade Method.

CollectionPoint.title: Superclass of Station, Tax.
CollectionPoint.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property collectionPointTax.

collectionPointTax.title: Each Station may be used for one or more Collection Point Taxs
collectionPointTax.description: A Tax data breakdown by collection point for XF (Passenger Facility Fee) and ZP (federal tax segment) taxes.

TransportServiceLegConnection.title: Superclass of Station, TransportServiceSegment.

inboundTransportServiceLeg.description: A section of a transport service from one station to the next.

TransportServiceLegCollection.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property outboundTransportServiceLeg.

outboundTransportServiceLeg.title: Each Outbound Transport Service Leg may be the start of one or more Departure Stations
outboundTransportServiceLeg.description: A section of a transport service from one station to the next.

RefundableChargeDetails.title: Superclass of Surcharge, TaxSummary.
RefundableChargeDetails.description: Superclass created to serve as a domain for property allRefundableInd.

allRefundableInd.title: Surcharge.All Refundable Indicator

collectionInd.title: Tax.Collection Indicator
collectionInd.description: When true, this tax must be collected.
